lead.en: Track where a brand appears in AI answers country by country on a zoomable choropleth world map shaded by visibility, share of voice, or sentiment beside a ranked region list.
lead.zh: 在可按大洲缩放的世界地图与右侧国家排行榜上，同步检视品牌在各国 AI 回答中的可见度、声量占比与正面情感度。

rule.en: Use Left/Right across tabs, periods, and measures; Up/Down/Home/End in the region list to highlight countries on the map with their breakdown card; Enter to zoom to a continent and Enter again for World.
rule.zh: 用左右键切换顶部标签、统计周期与指标，在地区列表中按上下键或 Home/End 联动高亮地图国家与详情浮窗，按 Enter 缩放至对应大洲或返回全球视图。

when: AI search and answer-engine analytics showing in which countries a brand is cited, how much share of voice it holds, and how sentiment varies regionally.
Country-level metrics that benefit from simultaneous choropleth world map shading and ranked tabular comparison on desktop and web.
not: Time-series channel charts over days or months – use AnalyticsScreen.
Decorative static continent illustrations without per-country metrics.
en.apiLead: BrandRegionsScreen owns interactive tab/period/measure switchers, multi-select filter menus, a 175-country SVG choropleth map with polygon hit-testing, continental zoom presets, loading skeletons, and empty states.

props.name: new
props.description: Construct BrandRegionsScreen inside AppShell with Northwind navigation, 16 ranked countries, and interactive world map.

props.name: with_regions
props.description: Supply custom ISO-3166 numeric country rows with visibility, share of voice, sentiment, and period deltas.

props.name: with_zoom / with_shading
props.description: Choose World, Americas, Europe, or Asia viewport framing and value-proportional vs. single-tone shading.

props.name: with_loading / with_empty

props.name: EventEmitter
props.description: Typed GPUI events emitted on navigation, tab/period/measure/zoom changes, filter updates, CSV export, and answer drilldown.

motion: Pointing at or focusing any country lights up both the map polygon and ranked row while softly dimming peer countries and revealing the metric card; Theme::reduced_motion disables sweeps and pulses.
Responsive breakpoints stack the ranked country panel cleanly below the map on narrower viewports.

Keep ElementId values stable across renders so keyboard focus, scroll offsets, and popover anchors preserve user state.

when: 构建 AI 搜索与答案引擎地域洞察页，按国家展示品牌提及可见度、声量份额与正面情感变化。
需要在同一界面同时阅读等值线世界地图色阶分布与高精度国家排名列表的桌面及 Web 应用。
not: 展示按天或按月变化的时间序列折线看板 —— 请使用 AnalyticsScreen。
无国别数值映射的纯装饰性静态地图插画。
zh.apiLead: BrandRegionsScreen 内置顶部洞察标签栏、周期与多维筛选菜单、支持精确多边形悬停命中的 175 国矢量地图、大洲缩放配置、加载骨架呼吸与空状态。

props.name: with_zoom / with_shading

props.name: with_loading / with_empty
props.description: 在数据加载或尚无回答样本时展示呼吸式灰色地图骨架或空状态提示。

motion: 悬停或键盘聚焦任一国家时双向高亮地图版块与列表行并显示指标卡片，加载态地图柔和呼吸；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时保持静止。
窄屏断点下右侧国家排行榜自动平稳切换至地图下方纵向排布。

跨帧保持稳定的 ElementId，确保键盘焦点、滚动位置与弹出菜单锚点状态稳定。

title.zh: AI 提问与关键词探索

lead.en: Explore what people ask AI assistants – type a prompt on a drifting atmospheric hero to inspect related search volumes, run single or bulk prompt analysis, and browse popular and trending keywords.
lead.zh: 在流动极光渐变首屏中输入提问或网页地址，实时查看联想搜索热度、单条或多行批量提及率分析，并对比热门与升降趋势关键词。

rule.en: Use Up/Down in the field to step through relevant searches, Enter to pick or analyse (Cmd+Enter in Bulk analysis), Escape to dismiss suggestions, and Left/Right to toggle Prompts/Page or Rising/Falling.
rule.zh: 在输入框中按上下键切换联想提问，Enter 选中分析（批量模式下 Cmd+Enter 提交全部行），Esc 收起联想，左右键切换模式与涨跌榜单。

when: AI search and answer-engine analytics tools showing what people prompt ChatGPT and other assistants, monthly volume, and brand mention share.
Search-first research homes that pair a calm atmospheric composer hero with side-by-side popular and trending keyword lists across native desktop and WASM web.
not: Conversational multi-turn chat threads with an assistant itself – use AssistantHomeScreen or AgentChatScreen.
Multi-series time-series telemetry dashboards – use AnalyticsScreen.
en.apiLead: PromptExplorerScreen owns the drifting hero surface, combobox editor, bulk line mode, completion listbox, analysis breakdown table, loading skeletons, and empty states while emitting typed PromptExplorerEvent values.

props.name: new
props.description: Construct PromptExplorerScreen framed inside AppShell with Northwind navigation and canonical keyword datasets.

props.name: with_prompts / with_popular / with_rising / with_falling
props.description: Supply custom autocomplete suggestions, popular keywords, and rising/falling 12-month sparkline lists.

props.name: with_bulk_analysis
props.description: Start with multi-line Bulk analysis enabled so each line is analysed together on Cmd+Enter.

props.name: with_loading / with_empty
props.description: Render synchronized keyword row skeletons or recovery empty states while keeping the prompt composer interactive.

props.name: EventEmitter
props.description: Typed GPUI events emitted on sidebar navigation, mode/trend switches, prompt analysis runs, and result dismissal.

motion: Blue, cyan, and lavender hero light layers drift on independent loops and fade seamlessly into the page background before the keyword card starts; Theme::reduced_motion freezes the backdrop.
Completion suggestions join seamlessly beneath the composer card and analysis rows rise smoothly above the keyword columns.
ai: Import from kui::components::prompt_explorer::PromptExplorerScreen (library) or crate::ui::components::prompt_explorer::PromptExplorerScreen after running kui add prompt-explorer.
Keep ElementId values stable across renders so keyboard focus, scroll offsets, and inline Editors preserve user state.

when: 构建 AI 搜索与答案引擎洞察工具，展示用户在 ChatGPT 等助手中的提问热度、月度变化与品牌提及占比。
使用同一套 Rust + GPUI 源码在原生桌面端与 WASM Web 端交付搜索优先的关键词研究首页。
not: 直接与 AI 助手进行多轮对话的聊天界面 —— 请使用 AssistantHomeScreen 或 AgentChatScreen。
多维时间序列营收图表看板 —— 请使用 AnalyticsScreen。
zh.apiLead: PromptExplorerScreen 内置动态光影首屏、多模式输入编辑器、实时联想下拉框、批量行分析结果表、骨架屏与空状态，并通过强类型 PromptExplorerEvent 与宿主通信。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建内嵌于 AppShell（Northwind 导航预设）的完整提问探索屏幕。

props.name: with_prompts / with_popular / with_rising / with_falling
props.description: 自定义搜索自动补全词库、左侧热门关键词与右侧 12 个月趋势迷你折线列表。

props.name: with_bulk_analysis
props.description: 默认开启多行批量分析模式，支持每行一条提问并通过 Cmd+Enter 批量分析。

props.name: with_loading / with_empty
props.description: 在数据加载或尚无追踪记录时展示同步骨架行或空状态，同时保持输入框可用。

props.name: EventEmitter
props.description: 在侧栏导航、模式与涨跌切换、提问分析提交及清空结果时发出强类型事件。

motion: 蓝色、青色与淡紫三层体积光按独立周期柔和漂移，并在关键词卡片上方平滑过渡至页面底色；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时保持静止。
搜索联想面板与输入框自然衔接，分析结果卡片在关键词双栏上方轻盈浮现。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::prompt_explorer::PromptExplorerScreen 导入；执行 kui add prompt-explorer 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::prompt_explorer::PromptExplorerScreen 导入。
跨帧保持稳定的 ElementId，确保键盘焦点、滚动位置与行内编辑器输入状态不丢失。

lead.en: Swap content with a soft-focus blur while the box glides smoothly to the measured size of what comes next.
lead.zh: 在内容切换时以柔和模糊叠化新旧图层，并驱动外框平滑过渡至新内容的实测尺寸。

rule.en: Only the active incoming copy stays interactive while leaving layers remain inert; overflow clips only during the swap and reduced motion switches instantly.
rule.zh: 仅当前新内容参与交互，退场副本保持静默；仅在过渡期间裁剪溢出，开启减少动效时立即切换。

when: Button labels and inline status indicators that morph in place—such as Publish -> Publishing… -> Published.
Step cards, release notes, or helper panels that swap copy of varying length without a jarring layout jump.
not: Full-page route transitions between top-level application workspaces.
High-frequency live counters or prices updating many times per second.
en.apiLead: BlurCrossfade measures incoming layout bounds during prepaint and drives critically-damped Slide springs alongside multi-tap soft-focus crossfades.

props.name: new
props.type: (impl Into<ElementId>, impl Into<SharedString>, impl IntoElement) -> Self
props.description: Wrap content keyed by content_key; changing the key starts a blur crossfade and size glide.

props.name: from_fn
props.type: (impl Into<ElementId>, impl Into<SharedString>, impl Fn(&mut Window, &mut App) -> AnyElement) -> Self
props.description: Supply a repeatable view closure so both outgoing and incoming layers blur and cross-fade simultaneously.

props.name: with_duration_ms
props.description: Swap and container size-morph duration in milliseconds.

props.name: with_blur_px
props.description: Peak soft-focus blur spread in pixels at the outer ends of the transition.

props.name: with_morph
props.description: Glide Height only, Both width and height (for inline buttons), or None.

motion: Leaving content blurs, expands slightly (1.0 -> 1.02), and fades over 0.8x duration while incoming content sharpens in from 0.98 along cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.0, 0.36, 1.0).
Rapid consecutive changes keep only the latest leaving copy on screen while Slide springs preserve instantaneous velocity; Theme::reduced_motion swaps immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::blur_crossfade::{BlurCrossfade, BlurMorph} (library) or crate::ui::components::blur_crossfade::{BlurCrossfade, BlurMorph} after running kui add blur-crossfade.
Use BlurCrossfade::label(id, state_key, text) inside buttons for one-line width+height label morphing.

when: 原地变形的按钮文案与行内状态提示，例如 Publish -> Publishing… -> Published。
切换不同长度的更新日志、步骤说明或提示面板，避免生硬的布局跳动。
not: 顶层页面或大型工作区之间的整页路由跳转。
每秒高频跳动的实时计数器或行情报价。
zh.apiLead: BlurCrossfade 在预绘制阶段测量新内容自然尺寸，并以临界阻尼 Slide 弹簧同步驱动容器尺寸与多采样柔焦叠化。

props.name: new
props.type: (impl Into<ElementId>, impl Into<SharedString>, impl IntoElement) -> Self
props.description: 按 content_key 包装当前内容；key 变化时触发模糊叠化与尺寸平滑过渡。

props.name: from_fn
props.type: (impl Into<ElementId>, impl Into<SharedString>, impl Fn(&mut Window, &mut App) -> AnyElement) -> Self
props.description: 传入可重放构建闭包，使退场副本与进场内容同时呈现多采样高斯柔焦叠化。

props.name: with_duration_ms
props.description: 内容叠化与容器尺寸过渡的持续毫秒数。

props.name: with_blur_px
props.description: 过渡首尾两端的最大模糊半径（像素）。

props.name: with_morph
props.description: 选择仅平滑过渡高度（Height）、同时过渡宽高（Both，适合按钮）或不缩放外框（None）。

motion: 旧内容在 0.8 倍时长内柔和模糊并微幅外扩（1.0 -> 1.02）淡出，新内容沿 cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.0, 0.36, 1.0) 从 0.98 收敛清晰浮现。
连续快速切换时仅保留最近一次退场层且弹簧速度平滑衔接；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时立即完成内容切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::blur_crossfade::{BlurCrossfade, BlurMorph} 导入；执行 kui add blur-crossfade 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::blur_crossfade::{BlurCrossfade, BlurMorph} 导入。
按钮行内动态文案可直接调用 BlurCrossfade::label(id, state_key, text) 获得宽高同步丝滑变形。

lead.en: Cut headline words from an ever-flowing four-blob liquid gradient whose color sweeps in from left to right on first view.
lead.zh: 将标题关键词雕琢于四色液态流动渐变之中，首次呈现时色彩由左向右丝滑扫入。

rule.en: Keeps real accessible text in layout while painting native GPUI glyph slices above it; freezes on the finished gradient when reduced motion is active.
rule.zh: 底层保留真实无障碍文本布局，表层切片绘制原生 GPUI 字形渐变；开启减少动效时定格展示完整渐变。

when: Highlighting a single payoff word or short brand phrase inside a hero headline.
Drawing warm visual focus to a key launch title without adding background chrome.
not: Multi-line body paragraphs where flowing color reduces reading comfort.
Repeating several animated gradient spans across the same screen.
en.apiLead: GradientText shapes words with GPUI's native TextSystem for exact baseline and kerning parity, sampling three orbiting radial blobs over a 100deg linear base.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a GradientText with tuned pink-to-violet light and dark mode palettes.

props.name: with_colors
props.description: Override the base start, base end, and two radial blob colors across both themes.

props.name: with_speed
props.description: Seconds per liquid color-flow cycle; pass 0.0 or with_paused(true) to freeze.

props.name: with_sweep
props.description: Wipe the liquid gradient in from left to right over 1100ms over the base ink.

props.name: with_font_size
props.description: Set headline glyph size to match surrounding typography.

motion: Three closest-side radial color blobs orbit smoothly across a 100deg two-color base loop while vertical ContentMask slices paint native glyphs without baseline drift.
An 1100ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0.0, 0.25, 1.0) horizontal wipe reveals the gradient from left to right and can be replayed on demand; Theme::reduced_motion shows the finished gradient standing still.
ai: Import from kui::components::gradient_text::GradientText (library) or crate::ui::components::gradient_text::GradientText after running kui add gradient-text.
Match with_font_size, with_line_height, and with_font_weight to the surrounding headline row for seamless inline alignment.

when: 首页大标题中需要承载品牌气质的核心点睛词或短语。
在不增加背景边框负担的前提下，为关键发布标题注入温润流动焦点。
not: 长篇正文段落（流动渐变会降低连续阅读清晰度）。
同一屏幕内同时高亮多处流光文字。
zh.apiLead: GradientText 直接调用 GPUI 原生字形排版引擎以确保字距与基线严丝合缝，并在 100° 线性底色上合成三团环绕漂移的径向光斑。

props.name: new
props.description: 使用针对浅色与深色模式分别调校的粉紫四色渐变创建流光文字。

props.name: with_colors
props.description: 自定义起止底色与两团游走径向光斑色值（同时覆盖浅色与深色模式）。

props.name: with_speed
props.description: 单次液态色彩流动周期秒数；传 0.0 或调用 with_paused(true) 可定格。

props.name: with_sweep
props.description: 首次展示或重播时，在 1100ms 内从左向右扫入渐变色。

props.name: with_font_size
props.description: 设置字号以与外层主标题保持一致。

motion: 三组径向色斑沿平滑闭环轨迹在双色斜向底纹上缓慢游走，通过纵向裁剪切片绘制原生 GPUI 字形，与同行文字零基线偏差。
扫入阶段沿 cubic-bezier(0.65, 0.0, 0.25, 1.0) 在 1100ms 内从左向右擦除底色并支持随时重播；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时直接静止呈现完整渐变。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::gradient_text::GradientText 导入；执行 kui add gradient-text 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::gradient_text::GradientText 导入。
与同行文字混排时，将 with_font_size、with_line_height 与 with_font_weight 设为与父标题一致即可完美对齐。

lead.en: Tilt a showcase card in 3D perspective toward the pointer with a soft radial glare and a gentle overshoot spring back.
lead.zh: 随指针方位在三维透视空间内平滑倾斜卡片，伴随柔和径向高光追随与回弹阻尼复位。

rule.en: Purely visual hover motion that adds no extra tab stops; inner keyboard focus lifts the card slightly, touch input skips tilt, and reduced motion restricts hover to shadow depth.
rule.zh: 纯视觉悬停增强且不增加额外焦点停靠；内部元素获焦时卡片微幅抬升，触控输入不触发倾斜，开启减少动效时仅保留阴影变化。

when: Hero membership passes, subscription badges, product highlights, or featured collectible objects that should feel tangible on hover.
Single focal showcase cards with concise metadata.
not: Dense multi-card grids where simultaneous 3D tilting creates visual noise.
Form-heavy cards packed with text inputs and long paragraphs.
en.apiLead: TiltCard projects rounded card geometry, KUI Pro membership artwork (or custom child views), opposing shadows, and clipped specular glare through a 3D pinhole camera.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a TiltCard defaulting to the KUI Pro membership card at 340x214px.

props.name: with_max_tilt
props.description: Maximum pitch and yaw tilt angle in degrees.

props.name: with_glare
props.description: Enable or disable the pointer-following soft radial specular glare.

props.name: with_scale
props.description: Scale factor applied while the pointer hovers over the card.

props.name: with_perspective
props.description: Camera perspective distance in pixels—smaller values produce stronger foreshortening.

motion: Pointer moves drive snappy 140ms hover springs (omega = 24, damping = 0.90) across pitch, yaw, 1.02x scale, opposing drop shadow offset, and clipped radial glare.
Leaving the card switches to a 700ms underdamped spring (damping = 0.56) that settles back to flat rest with a soft overshoot while preserving instantaneous velocity.
ai: Import from kui::components::tilt_card::TiltCard (library) or crate::ui::components::tilt_card::TiltCard after running kui add tilt-card.
Render the built-in KUI Pro membership showcase directly or pass custom card chrome via with_child / with_content.

when: 会员通行证、订阅权益卡、核心产品特写等需要赋予实体触感的单张焦点展示卡。
承载精炼元信息的英雄区视觉陈列对象。
not: 同屏密集排列的多卡片网格（多卡同时倾斜会产生视觉噪音）。
包含大量表单控件或长篇阅读文本的功能型卡片。
zh.apiLead: TiltCard 通过三维针孔透视相机实时投射圆角卡面、内置 KUI Pro 会员卡纹样（或自定义子视图）、反向动态投影与裁剪柔光高光层。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认 340x214px 尺寸与 KUI Pro 蓝紫渐变会员卡面的 3D 倾斜卡。

props.name: with_max_tilt
props.description: 横纵轴最大三维倾斜角度（度）。

props.name: with_glare
props.description: 开启或关闭随指针移动的柔和径向高光层。

props.name: with_scale
props.description: 指针悬停在卡片上方时的微缩放比例。

props.name: with_perspective
props.description: 三维透视相机距离（像素），数值越小透视近大远小感越强烈。

motion: 指针移动时以灵敏的 140ms 阻尼弹簧（omega = 24, damping = 0.90）实时驱动俯仰角、偏航角、1.02 倍微缩放、反向动态阴影与圆角内裁剪径向高光。
指针移出时切换为 700ms 欠阻尼弹簧（damping = 0.56），继承瞬时速度并伴随轻柔过冲平滑归位；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时关闭旋转与高光。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::tilt_card::TiltCard 导入；执行 kui add tilt-card 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::tilt_card::TiltCard 导入。
可直接使用默认 KUI Pro 会员卡演示，也可通过 with_child 或 with_content 承载自定义卡片内容。

lead.en: Render a glassy blue folder holding angled documents behind a frosted front pocket that tips open on hover.
lead.zh: 渲染收纳多份倾斜文档的半透明玻璃文件夹，悬停或聚焦时磨砂前袋平滑前倾展开。

rule.en: Exposed as an accessible image with a descriptive label; hover, focus, or click tips the pocket open and respects reduced motion.
rule.zh: 以带语义描述的无障碍图像呈现；悬停、键盘聚焦或点击均可展开前袋，并在开启减少动效时即时切换。

when: Feature cards for file storage, uploads, workspaces, or knowledge bases, and calm bento-grid illustrations above short copy.
Document empty states that benefit from a tactile, translucent folder cue.
not: Listing real interactive user files—the inner sheets use decorative placeholder lines.
Micro-icons below 48px where frosted glass blur and paper lines collapse.
en.apiLead: GlassFolder owns spring-driven hover/focus/pinned-open state, custom glass tint derivation, loading skeletons, and empty states while emitting typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a GlassFolder holding three angled documents behind a sky-blue frosted pocket.

props.name: with_color
props.description: Customize the folder back color, frosted pocket gradient, and ambient drop shadow.

when: Hero sections for AI assistants, chat workspaces, and writing tools where a living interactive scene outperforms a video loop.

not: Production multi-line chat composers with attachments—use MentionInput or AI chat screens for full conversation workflows.
Compact mobile cards narrower than 360px where full 6-row keyboard legends become tiny.
en.apiLead: GlowKeyboard owns human-rhythm demo playback, physical and pointer keycap synchronization, Gaussian wave-plume rasterization, loading skeletons, and empty states while emitting typed events.

when: AI 产品首页 Hero 区域或多模型能力特性卡，直观传递前沿模型自由切换体验。
贴靠版心右侧或下沿排版的视觉场景，借助右缘与底缘透明渐隐自然融入背景。
not: 紧凑表单内的真实下拉触发器——真实表单输入请使用 Select 或 Combobox。
宽度不足 320px 的狭小卡片区域。

motion: 每次停留结束后，0.52s 临界阻尼 Slide 弹簧驱动玫粉渐变高亮带与对勾同步平滑滑向下一行。
基于真实 Alpha 遮罩将卡片右边缘、底边投影及末尾行自然消融于任意浅色或深色宿主背景；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时固定在初始选中行。

跨帧保持稳定的 ElementId，确保键盘焦点与弹簧位置状态连续。

lead.en: Render three rounded S-curve branches carrying pastel light pulses from a single source node into Gmail, Slack, and Notion tiles.
lead.zh: 展示单一触发源通过三条平滑圆角曲线向 Gmail、Slack 与 Notion 卡片传输柔和彩色光脉冲。

rule.en: Hover or click any destination tile to focus its branch and trigger an immediate pulse; click the top source node to broadcast pulses down all three channels; reduced motion holds the resting pastel glow.
rule.zh: 悬停或点击任意目标卡片可聚焦该分支并立即触发光脉冲；点击顶部源节点可同步向三条通道广播脉冲；开启减少动效时固定在静态柔光态。

when: Feature cards or workflow sections showing one agent trigger fanning out across email, chat, and workspace docs.
Integration or automation callouts where staggered multi-channel delivery reads clearer than a plain icon list.
not: Interactive webhook routing editors or live channel permission settings—use IntegrationsScreen or ConnectorSetup instead.
Lists of ten or more integrations where a grid directory scans faster.
en.apiLead: OutreachBranches owns Bezier branch geometry, 4-layer tapered gradient pulses, split tile-perimeter light wraps, interactive branch focus/burst triggers, loading skeletons, and empty states.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an OutreachBranches scene fanning out into Gmail, Slack, and Notion tiles.

props.name: with_channels
props.description: Customize the left, center, and right destination channel tiles.

props.name: with_label
props.description: Override the accessible image description announced to assistive technologies.

props.name: with_focused_branch
props.description: Highlight a specific branch index (0..3) and gently dim sibling branches.

props.name: with_playing
props.description: Enable or pause the staggered 3.4s light pulse cycle.

motion: Four nested gradient-tapered pulse layers travel down the left, center, and right Bezier curves on a staggered 3.4s cycle (0s, 0.95s, 1.85s offsets).

As each pulse reaches its destination tile, the light splits cleanly around both halves of the rounded card perimeter and softly illuminates the tile; Theme::reduced_motion stands still with the center tile rim and ambient glow visible.
ai: Import from kui::components::outreach_branches::OutreachBranches (library) or crate::ui::components::outreach_branches::OutreachBranches after running kui add outreach-branches.
Keep ElementId values stable across renders so interactive branch focus and burst animations stay continuous.

when: 展示单一智能体触发器同步分发至邮件、即时通讯与知识库文档的功能卡片或工作流区块。
相比静态图标罗列，更能直观传达自动化多渠道触达节奏的集成展示位。
not: 用于配置真实 Webhook 路由或渠道授权——交互式配置请使用 IntegrationsScreen 或 ConnectorSetup。
需要一次性平铺十余个应用图标的生态目录场景。
zh.apiLead: OutreachBranches 内置贝塞尔分支路径、四层渐变锥形光脉冲、卡片双侧环绕光效、分支悬停/点击瞬时触发、加载骨架屏与空状态。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认连接 Gmail、Slack 与 Notion 三张应用卡片的分发插画。

props.name: with_channels
props.description: 自定义左、中、右三个目标通道的图标与名称。

props.name: with_label
props.description: 自定义供无障碍辅助技术朗读的场景描述。

props.name: with_focused_branch
props.description: 指定高亮某一条分支索引（0..3），并轻度弱化其余分支。

props.name: with_playing
props.description: 开启或暂停 3.4s 错峰光脉冲循环。

motion: 四层叠合渐变光束按 3.4s 周期错峰（0s、0.95s、1.85s）沿左、中、右贝塞尔分支顺滑下行。
脉冲抵达目标卡片顶部时沿圆角边框分流环绕至底边并点亮卡片柔光；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时保持中心柔光与边框高亮静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::outreach_branches::OutreachBranches 导入；执行 kui add outreach-branches 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::outreach_branches::OutreachBranches 导入。
跨帧保持稳定的 ElementId，确保分支聚焦态与点击触发脉冲平滑衔接。

lead.en: Render a slim floating agent progress capsule with a twinkling pixel mark, report title, percentage readout, step subtitle, and ambient under-glow.
lead.zh: 渲染纤薄悬浮的智能体任务进度胶囊，包含闪烁像素徽标、报告标题、百分比读数、步骤副标题与柔和彩色底光。

rule.en: Self-playing product scene with optional controlled progress via with_progress(Some(ratio)) or static pose via with_playing(false); reduced motion freezes step cycling and shimmer.
rule.zh: 默认自动循环演示各阶段进度，亦可通过 with_progress(Some(ratio)) 受控驱动或通过 with_playing(false) 定格；开启减少动效时停止轮播与微光。

when: AI feature cards or hero callouts illustrating how an autonomous agent works through a multi-step report in the background.
Compact marketing blocks that need a living status indicator without embedding a full console screen.
not: Real file-upload progress bars or deterministic byte counters—use Progress or RunInspector for live operational telemetry.
Stacking several animated pills directly on top of one another.
en.apiLead: ProgressPill owns step cadence timing, subtitle slide-fade transitions, mirrored 3×3 agent pixel shimmer, right-fading capsule chrome, tri-color under-glow, loading skeletons, and empty states.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a ProgressPill with "Q3 revenue report", "Analyst", and three default report steps.

props.name: with_title
props.description: Set the primary task or report title on the top row.

props.name: with_name
props.description: Set the agent name prefix shown before the active step subtitle.

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Override the ordered step subtitles cycled through during playback.

props.name: with_progress
props.description: Pin an explicit progress ratio (0.0..=1.0) instead of auto-advancing on the internal timer.

motion: Advances through each step on a 2.6s hold, sliding and crossfading the active step subtitle into place while ticking the percentage readout and gliding a sheen across the 3.5px progress bar.
The circular 3×3 mirrored pixel avatar twinkles while a blue-violet-pink under-glow breathes softly beneath the right-fading capsule; Theme::reduced_motion holds a calm static pose.
ai: Import from kui::components::progress_pill::ProgressPill (library) or crate::ui::components::progress_pill::ProgressPill after running kui add progress-pill.
Use with_agent("research") or another seed string to deterministically vary the 3×3 mirrored pixel mark.

when: 在 AI 功能卡片或首页展示区直观演示后台智能体分步撰写报告的运行过程。
空间紧凑、无需嵌入完整控制台但希望呈现灵动状态反馈的产品插画位。
not: 真实文件上传进度条或精确字节计数反馈——真实运行遥测请使用 Progress 或 RunInspector。
在同一局部区域密集堆叠多个发光进度胶囊。
zh.apiLead: ProgressPill 内置分步停留计时、副标题滑入淡变、3×3 镜像像素头像闪烁、右侧渐隐胶囊表面、三色呼吸底光、骨架屏与空状态。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认标题为“Q3 营收报告”、智能体为“分析师”的三步进度胶囊。

props.name: with_title
props.description: 设置顶部主行的任务或报告标题。

props.name: with_name
props.description: 设置步骤副标题前展示的智能体名称。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 自定义依次轮播的步骤描述文案列表。

props.name: with_progress
props.description: 传入受控进度比例（0.0..=1.0）以接管内置自动计时器。

motion: 默认每步停留 2.6s，切换时副标题向上轻柔滑入并伴随百分比步进与 3.5px 进度条流光扫过。
左侧圆形 3×3 对称像素徽标持续微光律动，胶囊下方蓝紫粉三色柔光缓慢呼吸，右侧边缘平滑渐隐融入背景；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时保持静态定格。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::progress_pill::ProgressPill 导入；执行 kui add progress-pill 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::progress_pill::ProgressPill 导入。
可通过 with_agent("research") 传入不同标识字符串以生成确定性的对称像素徽标。

lead.en: Render an animated product workflow scene where a client task branches via rounded connectors and light pulses into subtasks, notes, and assigned roles.
lead.zh: 展示客户任务通过圆角连接线与流动光脉冲分支至子任务叠卡、客户备注及项目角色卡片的完整产品场景。

rule.en: Hover or click any card to highlight its incident branches, or click Replay (or press R or Space) to replay the staggered build-in and hand drag-and-drop sequence; reduced motion settles immediately.
rule.zh: 悬停或点击任一节点卡片可高亮关联分支，点击右上角重播胶囊（或按 R / 空格键）可重放逐级建卡与手势拖入回弹动画；开启减少动效时直接呈现终态。

when: Feature sections explaining how clients, tasks, subtasks, notes, and teammate/agent roles connect inside your workspace.
Landing pages where a proportional product diagram communicates workflow hierarchy faster than paragraphs of copy.
not: Editable node-graph canvases where users wire arbitrary DAGs—use ProjectFlow as an illustrative product scene.
Containers narrower than 320px where scaled card labels become too small to scan comfortably.
en.apiLead: ProjectFlow scales a 2312 × 1644 workflow artboard proportionally, owning radial dot-grid rendering, rounded #82BCFF connectors, traveling pulses, tech-stack badges, interactive node focus, and replay choreography.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a ProjectFlow scene ready in its complete branching layout with live connector pulses.

props.name: with_client_name
props.description: Customize the client organization name shown next to the Kense mark on the top card.

props.name: with_task_title
props.description: Customize the heading inside the central task card.

props.name: with_auto_intro
props.description: Automatically play the 5.6s staggered card build-in and hand drag-in sequence on mount.

props.name: with_playing
props.description: Control whether sky-blue light pulses travel continuously along all five branches.

motion: In steady state, luminous sky-blue pulses glide along all five rounded #82BCFF connectors from Client through Task into Client Notes, Subtasks, Project Manager, and UX Designer.

Triggering replay() builds cards sequentially and drags the stacked Subtasks deck in along a dashed Bezier guide with a soft drop bounce before handing off to continuous pulses; Theme::reduced_motion shows the settled state right away.
ai: Import from kui::components::project_flow::ProjectFlow (library) or crate::ui::components::project_flow::ProjectFlow after running kui add project-flow.
Client cards render the Kense mark from crate::primitives::kense_mark alongside person and agent avatars from pro_chrome.

when: 用于产品功能区直观阐释客户、主任务、子任务、备注与团队/智能体角色之间的协作拓扑。
落地页中以等比缩放动态场景替代冗长文字说明的工作流展示位。
not: 需要用户自由拖拽连线的可编辑流程图画布——本组件面向高保真产品演示场景。
宽度低于 320px 的超窄容器（等比缩放后卡片字号过小）。
zh.apiLead: ProjectFlow 基于 2312 × 1644 画板等比自适应缩放，内置径向点阵背景、#82BCFF 圆角折线、流动脉冲、技术栈图标组、节点聚焦高亮与一键重播编排。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认处于完整展开态并持续流动连接脉冲的项目协作场景。

props.name: with_client_name
props.description: 自定义顶部客户卡片中 Kense 徽标右侧展示的客户名称。

props.name: with_task_title
props.description: 自定义中央核心任务卡片的标题文案。

props.name: with_auto_intro
props.description: 挂载时是否自动从零播放 5.6s 逐级建卡与手势拖入子任务动画。

props.name: with_playing
props.description: 控制五条连接分支上的天蓝色高光脉冲是否持续流动。

motion: 稳态下天蓝色柔光脉冲沿五条 #82BCFF 圆角分支连续流动，串联客户、网页设计任务、客户备注、子任务叠卡与项目经理/交互设计师。
触发 replay() 时依次滑入各级卡片，并沿虚线贝塞尔引导线由手势光标将子任务叠卡拖入落位、轻柔回弹后衔接到连续脉冲；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时直接定格终态。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::project_flow::ProjectFlow 导入；执行 kui add project-flow 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::project_flow::ProjectFlow 导入。
客户徽标统一使用 crate::primitives::kense_mark，成员与智能体头像复用 pro_chrome 原语。

lead.en: Render a dictation capture panel with a recessed waveform well, live speech rhythm bars, ticking timer, action controls, and living under-glow.
lead.zh: 渲染实时语音听写面板，内嵌下凹静音槽与起伏声波竖条、跳秒计时器、快捷键操作栏及呼吸彩色底光。

rule.en: Click the recording badge or press Space to pause or resume, click Done or press Enter to confirm, or click Cancel or press Escape to reset; reduced motion holds a calm still frame.
rule.zh: 点击录音状态或按空格暂停/继续，点击完成或按回车确认提交，点击取消或按 Esc 重置计时；开启减少动效时保持安静静态帧。

when: Voice-to-text, meeting note, or multimodal prompt sections showing how natural speech turns into structured input.
Interactive product previews where host audio metering can optionally drive loudness via set_loudness(...).
not: Multi-track DAW timeline scrubbing or long-form podcast playback—use a dedicated media transport bar instead.
Tiny inline badges where the recessed waveform well and shortcut footer have no room to breathe.
en.apiLead: VoiceCapture owns speech-phrase harmonic bar modulation, pause-dot rendering, tabular M:SS timing, keyboard/click transport actions, right-fading card chrome, and tri-color under-glow.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a VoiceCapture dictation panel starting at 0:14 with live waveform motion.

props.name: with_start_seconds
props.description: Set the initial recording clock offset in seconds (14 formats as "0:14").

props.name: with_loudness
props.description: Scale simulated or host-metered waveform amplitude between 0.0 and 2.0.

props.name: with_bars
props.description: Supply a custom bar rhythm profile (values <= 3 render quiet 2×2px pause dots).

props.name: with_playing
props.description: Animate the waveform, recording dot, under-glow, and timer, or hold a still frame when false.

motion: Thin 2px vertical bars inside the recessed well rise and fall with natural speech cadence while quiet slots stay anchored as 2×2px dots.

The red recording indicator breathes gently as the tabular clock ticks upward and a blue-violet-pink under-glow drifts beneath the right-fading card; Theme::reduced_motion freezes all motion immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::voice_capture::VoiceCapture (library) or crate::ui::components::voice_capture::VoiceCapture after running kui add voice-capture.
Feed live microphone RMS levels at runtime with capture.update(cx, |v, cx| v.set_loudness(level, cx)).

when: 展示语音转文字、会议纪要或语音提示词输入体验的多模态产品区块。
既可自播放演示自然语流节奏、又可通过 set_loudness(...) 接入真实麦克风电平的交互预览。
not: 多轨音频剪辑时间轴或长播客播放控制条——此类场景请使用专用媒体控制器。
无法容纳下凹声波槽与底部快捷键提示的超小行内徽章。
zh.apiLead: VoiceCapture 内置自然语流谐波声波律动、停顿圆点渲染、等宽 M:SS 计时器、暂停/确认/取消键盘与鼠标交互、右侧渐隐面板及三色呼吸底光。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认从 0:14 起跳并带实时声波起伏的语音听写面板。

props.name: with_start_seconds
props.description: 设置初始录音秒数偏移（默认 14 显示为 "0:14"）。

props.name: with_loudness
props.description: 缩放模拟或宿主传入的语音响度倍率（范围 0.0..=2.0）。

props.name: with_bars
props.description: 自定义声波柱基准高度序列（小于等于 3 的槽位渲染为 2×2px 静音圆点）。

props.name: with_playing
props.description: 控制声波、录音圆点、底光与计时器是否运行；设为 false 时定格静态画面。

motion: 下凹静音槽内的 2px 纤细竖条按语音短语包络自然起伏，停顿间隙保留为安静的 2×2px 圆点。
红色录音指示点轻柔呼吸，等宽数字秒表逐秒递增，面板下方蓝紫粉三色底光缓慢流动且右侧边缘平滑渐隐；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时立即保持静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::voice_capture::VoiceCapture 导入；执行 kui add voice-capture 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::voice_capture::VoiceCapture 导入。
运行时可通过 capture.update(cx, |v, cx| v.set_loudness(level, cx)) 实时注入宿主音频采样响度。

lead.en: Render a Natural Earth continental world map with one elevated landmass, a traveling pastel coastline band, and an interactive continent switcher pill.
lead.zh: 渲染 Natural Earth 大洲世界地图，突出展示当前激活大洲、沿海岸线流动的粉彩光带及左上角交互切换胶囊。

rule.en: Click the top-left capsule switcher or use ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, Enter, and Escape keys to switch across all 6 continents; reduced motion freezes the coastline band in place.
rule.zh: 点击左上角胶囊选择器或使用上下方向键、Home、End、回车与 Esc 在六大洲间平滑切换；开启减少动效时海岸粉彩光带保持静止。

when: Regional availability, edge-network, compliance residency, or global market cards spotlighting one continent at a time.
Feature blocks where users can flip between North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania interactively.
not: Country-by-country choropleths, street-level pin drops, or Mercator tile zoom/pan—use a dedicated GIS map view instead.
Comparing fine numeric metrics across dozens of cities simultaneously.
en.apiLead: WorldMap caches crisp Natural Earth 1:110m merged-continent SVGs per theme and continent, pairing coastline arc-length light bands with an accessible keyboard-navigable pill listbox.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a WorldMap highlighting Continent::Europe with the top-left switcher pill enabled.

props.name: with_continent
props.description: Select the highlighted landmass (NorthAmerica, SouthAmerica, Europe, Africa, Asia, Oceania).

props.name: with_show_switcher
props.description: Show or hide the interactive top-left continent capsule switcher.

props.name: with_label
props.description: Override the accessible description announced for the map illustration.

props.name: with_playing
props.description: Control whether the pastel coastline shine travels continuously on its 14s loop.

motion: Switching continents fades the outgoing landmass out (0.32s) while settling the incoming continent from 0.94 to 1.0 scale around its geographic focal origin.

An outward pastel halo under the elevated continent silhouette and three stepped crisp strokes above it sweep continuously along the main coastline on a 14s loop; Theme::reduced_motion renders the static coastline shine immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::world_map::{Continent, WorldMap} (library) or crate::ui::components::world_map::{Continent, WorldMap} after running kui add world-map.
Listen to WorldMapEvent::ContinentChanged(continent) to synchronize adjacent regional copy, latency stats, or compliance badges.

when: 展示全球节点覆盖、数据合规驻留区域或分大洲市场重点的产品卡片。
允许访客在北美洲、南美洲、欧洲、非洲、亚洲与大洋洲之间交互切换的区域能力展示块。
not: 国家级热力分级图、街道级坐标打点或需要自由缩放平移的瓦片地图。
需要同时对比数十座城市精细数值指标的密集报表。
zh.apiLead: WorldMap 按明暗主题与大洲缓存高清晰度 Natural Earth 1:110m 合并大洲矢量轮廓，结合海岸弧长粉彩光带渲染与支持完整键盘导航的胶囊下拉列表。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认高亮欧洲（Continent::Europe）并启用左上角大洲切换胶囊的世界地图。

props.name: with_continent
props.description: 设置高亮显示的大洲（NorthAmerica、SouthAmerica、Europe、Africa、Asia、Oceania）。

props.name: with_show_switcher
props.description: 显示或隐藏左上角交互式大洲胶囊切换器。

props.name: with_label
props.description: 自定义地图插画的无障碍描述文案。

props.name: with_playing
props.description: 控制沿海岸线流动的珊瑚至矢车菊蓝粉彩光带是否按 14s 周期持续运行。

motion: 切换大洲时原高亮陆块在 0.32s 内柔和淡出，新选中大洲围绕其地理视觉中心由 0.94 平滑落位至 1.0 比例。
大洲剪影底层的柔和外发光晕与顶层的三段阶梯式粉彩海岸描边按 14s 周期沿主海岸线连续巡航；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时立即呈现静态海岸光带。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::world_map::{Continent, WorldMap} 导入；执行 kui add world-map 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::world_map::{Continent, WorldMap} 导入。
订阅 WorldMapEvent::ContinentChanged(continent) 即可同步更新周边区域的延迟指标、节点数量或合规说明。

lead.en: Showcase autonomous agents as slim vertical gradient panels flanking one wide open product workspace screen.
lead.zh: 以纤细纵向渐变侧板环绕中央展开的真实产品工作台界面，点击任一侧板即可平滑展开切换。

rule.en: Click any slim gradient panel or press Left and Right arrow keys to glide that agent open into the center showcase, and explore Runs, Tools, Context, and Settings inside the screen.
rule.zh: 点击任一渐变侧板或按左右方向键将其平滑展开至中央舞台，并在内部工作台切换运行、工具、上下文与设置。

when: Showing several agents, workflows, or product areas in an explorable feature section where one real product screen opens at a time.
not: Two or three options that read faster as a plain tab strip, or metrics people must compare side by side simultaneously.
en.apiLead: AgentGalleryBlock owns spring-driven panel widths, track centering, inline context editing, and miniature workspace tabs while emitting typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an interactive 7-panel agent gallery centered on Churn watch.

props.name: with_title
props.description: Override the section heading displayed above the panels.

props.name: with_subtitle
props.description: Override the descriptive subtitle under the heading.

props.name: with_items
props.description: Provide custom agent panels with two-color washes, KPIs, steps, skills, and guardrails.

props.name: with_default_index
props.description: Set which panel starts open in the center showcase.

motion: Selected side panels widen into the center showcase with a unified Slide width and track-centering spring while side artwork blooms to full saturation; reduced motion snaps transitions immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_gallery::AgentGalleryBlock (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_gallery::AgentGalleryBlock after running kui add agent-gallery.
Keep ElementId values stable across renders so panel springs, keyboard focus, and inline context input preserve state.

when: 在产品落地页或功能亮点区展示多个智能体、自动化工作流或产品模块，让用户逐一展开体验真实工作台。
not: 仅有两个或三个简单选项（普通标签切换更直观），或需要同时并排对比多项数据的场景。
zh.apiLead: AgentGalleryBlock 内置面板宽度弹簧过渡、轨道居中计算、行内上下文输入与迷你工作台分段切换，并向外发出强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认包含 7 个剧本智能体且中央展开“流失预警”的画廊区块。

props.name: with_title
props.description: 自定义画廊顶部的标题文案。

props.name: with_subtitle
props.description: 自定义标题下方的说明文案。

props.name: with_items
props.description: 传入自定义智能体列表，配置双色渐变、指标火花线、步骤、技能与安全护栏。

props.name: with_default_index
props.description: 指定初始在中央舞台展开的面板索引。

motion: 选中侧板通过统一的 Slide 宽度与轨道位移弹簧平滑展开至中央，悬停时侧板色彩饱和度柔和绽放；开启减少动效时直接切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_gallery::AgentGalleryBlock 导入；执行 kui add agent-gallery 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_gallery::AgentGalleryBlock 导入。
跨帧保持稳定的 ElementId，确保面板弹簧动画、键盘焦点与行内上下文编辑器状态不丢失。

lead.en: Browse, search, filter, and connect workspace integrations across categories with an interactive OAuth and API-key flow.
lead.zh: 按分类浏览、搜索与筛选工作区第三方集成，支持交互式 OAuth 授权与 API 密钥连接流程。

rule.en: Press / to search apps, pick a category or connection status filter, click Connect to grant OAuth scopes or paste an API key, and hover Connected pills to disconnect.
rule.zh: 按 / 搜索集成应用，切换左侧分类或右上角连接状态筛选，点击“连接”完成 OAuth 授权或填写 API 密钥，悬停“已连接”按钮可快速断开。

when: Building an integrations marketplace or workspace settings directory where teams connect and manage third-party SaaS tools.
not: Two or three static toggles that fit inline in general settings, or multi-hundred-item catalogs requiring server-side pagination.
en.apiLead: AppDirectoryBlock manages search, category pills, status filtering, live connected counts, and an OAuth / API-key connect dialog while emitting typed toggle events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an integrations directory preloaded with 18 SaaS apps and 11 categories.

props.name: with_apps
props.description: Supply custom integration definitions with vendor, categories, scopes, and connection state.

props.name: with_categories
props.description: Customize sidebar category entries alongside built-in Essentials and All apps.

props.name: with_title
props.description: Override the main heading inside the directory header.

props.name: with_status_filter
props.description: Filter initially by All, Connected, NotConnected, or VerifiedOnly.

motion: Category highlights glide via pro_pill_indicator, connected totals roll smoothly, and the filter menu and connect modal animate with KUI spring curves; reduced motion snaps state changes.
ai: Import from kui::components::app_directory::AppDirectoryBlock (library) or crate::ui::components::app_directory::AppDirectoryBlock after running kui add app-directory.
Subscribe to AppDirectoryEvent::Toggled to persist connection changes in your backend store.

when: 构建 SaaS 产品的集成市场或工作区设置页，让团队按分类检索、连接与断开第三方工具。
not: 仅有两三个开关的简单设置项，或需要服务端分页的数百项大型插件市场。
zh.apiLead: AppDirectoryBlock 内置搜索框、分类导航、状态筛选菜单、实时连接计数与 OAuth / API 密钥连接弹窗，并通过强类型事件同步连接状态。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认预置 18 款常用集成应用与 11 个分类的目录区块。

props.name: with_apps
props.description: 传入自定义集成列表，配置厂商、所属分类、授权范围与初始连接状态。

props.name: with_categories
props.description: 自定义除“精选必备”与“全部应用”之外的侧边栏分类项。

props.name: with_title
props.description: 自定义目录顶部的标题文案。

props.name: with_status_filter
props.description: 设置初始连接状态筛选（全部、已连接、未连接或官方认证）。

motion: 分类高亮通过 pro_pill_indicator 平滑滑移，已连接数量滚动更新，筛选菜单与授权弹窗遵循 KUI 弹簧曲线进退场；减少动效时即时完成切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::app_directory::AppDirectoryBlock 导入；执行 kui add app-directory 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::app_directory::AppDirectoryBlock 导入。
订阅 AppDirectoryEvent::Toggled 事件即可将集成连接与断开状态持久化至后端。

lead.en: Keep live client KPIs, reports, files, meeting recaps, and @-mentioned notes together in a switchable client workspace.
lead.zh: 在可切换的客户专属工作台中集中管理实时财务指标、分析报告、文件附件、会议纪要与 @引用笔记。

rule.en: Switch or create clients from the top-right menu, filter the timeline across All, Meetings, Emails, Files, and Notes, type @ to cite a report, and press Cmd+Enter to add context.
rule.zh: 通过右上角菜单切换或新建客户，按全部、会议、邮件、文件与笔记筛选时间线，输入 @ 引用报告并按 Cmd+Enter 发布上下文。

when: Building agency, advisory, accounting, or CRM workspaces where teams track per-client KPIs, decisions, files, and AI grounding context.
not: Raw audit logs with thousands of machine events that require server-side pagination and virtualized tables.
en.apiLead: ClientContextBlock coordinates client switching, rolling KPI metrics, report disclosures, search and type filters, and a rich note/file composer.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a client workspace preloaded with Northwind Logistics, Lumen Studio, and Vesper Bio.

props.name: with_clients
props.description: Supply custom client accounts with KPIs, reports, and chronological context entries.

props.name: with_active_client
props.description: Select which client workspace opens initially.

props.name: with_me
props.description: Set the author name and avatar initials used for newly added notes and files.

props.name: with_filter
props.description: Set the initial timeline type filter pill (All, Meetings, Emails, Files, or Notes).

motion: Client KPI readouts roll via pro_rolling_number, section and filter thumbs glide with pro_pill_indicator, and reports expand via pro_fold; reduced motion snaps transitions immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::client_context::ClientContextBlock (library) or crate::ui::components::client_context::ClientContextBlock after running kui add client-context.
Subscribe to ClientContextEvent::ContextAdded and ClientContextEvent::ClientCreated to sync timeline updates with your API.

when: 构建咨询机构、财务审计、客户成功或 CRM 工作区，按客户维度沉淀实时指标、会议纪要、文件与 AI 增强上下文。
not: 包含成千上万条底层机器日志、需要服务端虚拟滚动分页的原始事件表。
zh.apiLead: ClientContextBlock 统一管理客户切换与新建、滚动 KPI 卡片、可展开报告、多类型筛选胶囊以及支持 @引用与文件附件的编辑器。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 Northwind Logistics、Lumen Studio 与 Vesper Bio 三个客户档案的工作台区块。

props.name: with_clients
props.description: 传入自定义客户列表，包含 KPI 指标、分析报告与时间线记录。

props.name: with_active_client
props.description: 指定初始激活展示的客户工作区 ID。

props.name: with_me
props.description: 设置新增笔记与上传文件时显示的当前成员姓名与头像缩写。

props.name: with_filter
props.description: 设置初始时间线类型筛选胶囊（全部、会议、邮件、文件或笔记）。

motion: 切换客户时 KPI 数值通过 pro_rolling_number 平滑滚动，分栏与筛选滑块通过 pro_pill_indicator 滑移，报告详情通过 pro_fold 折叠展开；减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::client_context::ClientContextBlock 导入；执行 kui add client-context 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::client_context::ClientContextBlock 导入。
订阅 ClientContextEvent::ContextAdded 与 ClientContextEvent::ClientCreated 事件即可将新增记录同步至后端。

lead.en: Stack an invoice and its adjustable credit note like physical paper — pick lines to credit, edit amounts inline, and issue.
lead.zh: 以拟物叠纸形态呈现原账单与可调贷项通知单，支持按行勾选冲抵、行内修改金额并实时计算签发。

rule.en: Click the peeking back sheet or segmented switch to flip between Invoice and Credit note, check lines or edit amounts within each line subtotal, and click Issue credit note or Edit to undo.
rule.zh: 点击后方露出的纸张边缘或顶部分段开关切换原账单与贷项单，按行勾选或修改冲抵金额，点击“签发贷项通知单”完成冲抵并支持随时撤回。

when: Billing portals, SaaS admin consoles, and finance product showcases where operators inspect an invoice and issue partial or full credit notes.
not: Static print/PDF rendering pipelines or multi-page ledger invoices containing dozens of line items.
en.apiLead: InvoiceCreditBlock manages stacked-sheet springs, per-line credit checkboxes and clamped amount editors, multi-currency formatting, and live rolling tax/total math.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a stacked INV-2041 ($11,359.68) and CN-0117 billing document pair.

props.name: with_seller / with_buyer
props.description: Configure the From and To legal entity names and multi-line addresses.

props.name: with_lines
props.description: Supply billed items, grouped metered usage rows, or negative-rate discounts.

props.name: with_currency
props.description: Format amounts with currency symbols ("$", "€", "£", "¥") or ISO codes ("USD", "EUR", "JPY").

props.name: with_view
props.description: Choose whether Invoice or CreditNote starts in the foreground.

motion: Swapping documents glides the chosen sheet forward via Slide while tucking the sibling sheet behind; subtotal, tax, and adjustment totals roll live via pro_rolling_number and respect reduced motion.
ai: Import from kui::components::invoice_credit::InvoiceCreditBlock (library) or crate::ui::components::invoice_credit::InvoiceCreditBlock after running kui add invoice-credit.
Subscribe to InvoiceCreditEvent::Issued to record per-line CreditedLine allocations and tax-inclusive totals.

when: 构建计费门户、SaaS 财务管理后台或账单产品演示页，让团队核对原始发票并签发部分或全额贷项通知单。
not: 纯静态打印/PDF 导出模板，或包含数十行明细的长篇对账单。
zh.apiLead: InvoiceCreditBlock 内置叠纸弹簧翻转、按行冲抵复选框与限幅金额编辑器、多币种格式化以及实时滚动的税额与总额计算。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认包含 INV-2041（$11,359.68）与 CN-0117 的双层叠纸账单区块。

props.name: with_seller / with_buyer
props.description: 配置开票方（From）与收票方（To）主体名称及多行地址。

props.name: with_lines
props.description: 传入订阅项、分组按量计费项或负单价折扣行。

props.name: with_currency
props.description: 支持货币符号（"$"、"€"、"£"、"¥"）或 ISO 代码（"USD"、"EUR"、"JPY"）格式化。

props.name: with_view
props.description: 指定初始置于前景的单据页（原账单或贷项通知单）。

motion: 切换单据时通过 Slide 弹簧将目标纸张平滑推至前景并将另一张收拢于后方露出顶边，小计、税额与冲抵总额通过 pro_rolling_number 实时滚动；减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::invoice_credit::InvoiceCreditBlock 导入；执行 kui add invoice-credit 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::invoice_credit::InvoiceCreditBlock 导入。
订阅 InvoiceCreditEvent::Issued 事件即可获取每行 CreditedLine 分摊明细与含税冲抵总额。

lead.en: Anchor the top of an analytics workspace with three rolling trend cards, a period-over-period comparison chart, and a product focus card.
lead.zh: 以三张滚动指标趋势卡、本周期与上周期对比主图及重点产品聚焦卡构成仪表盘首屏。

rule.en: Switch date ranges (7d, 30d, 90d, 12m) to roll every figure together, filter segments inside the overview chart, and hover or press Left/Right to inspect daily values.
rule.zh: 切换周期（7d、30d、90d、12m）可同步滚动数字并变形曲线，在总览卡内按方案筛选，悬停或按左右方向键逐日检视数值。

when: Top-of-dashboard summaries for SaaS, billing, and AI usage where headline metrics, period comparison, and a featured plan react to one date range.
Interactive executive overviews placed above detailed data tables or event logs.
not: Deep single-metric drill-downs or static print exports that do not benefit from interactive scrubbing.
Part-of-whole funnel or ranking breakdowns—pair with MetricsDashboardBlock for ranked shares.
en.apiLead: KpiBoardBlock manages range and segment selection, series resampling animations, interactive day scrubbers, loading skeletons, and empty states while emitting typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a KpiBoardBlock preloaded with 7d, 30d, 90d, and 12m SaaS datasets.

props.name: with_default_range
props.description: Set the initial active period key on mount.

props.name: with_segments
props.description: Configure the segment filter pills inside the overview comparison card.

props.name: with_data
props.description: Provide custom headline stats, comparison series, and focus card datasets per range.

props.name: with_compare_label
props.description: Customize the comparison phrase displayed beside percentage change badges.

motion: Switching the range rolls every headline readout via pro_rolling_number while resampling and gliding sparklines and dashed/solid comparison curves across point counts.
Overview segment pills glide with pro_pill_indicator and only morph the overview chart; Theme::reduced_motion switches values and curves instantaneously.
ai: Import from kui::components::kpi_board::KpiBoardBlock (library) or crate::ui::components::kpi_board::KpiBoardBlock after running kui add kpi-board.
Non-finite series values count as 0.0 in totals while leaving clean line gaps, and a previous total of 0.0 omits misleading percentage badges.

when: SaaS、订阅计费与 AI 用量仪表盘顶部总览，使核心趋势卡、同比环比对比图与重点产品卡联动响应同一时间范围。
位于明细数据表或审计日志上方的交互式经营概览模块。
not: 单一指标深度下钻或无需指针交互的静态打印报表。
占比漏斗或排行榜拆分场景（排行榜拆分请使用 MetricsDashboardBlock）。
zh.apiLead: KpiBoardBlock 内置周期与分段切换、不同点数序列平滑插值、按日悬停游标、加载骨架屏与空状态，并通过强类型事件通知宿主。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 7d、30d、90d、12m 四档周期数据的 KPI 看板模块。

props.name: with_default_range
props.description: 设置初始激活的时间范围标识。

props.name: with_segments
props.default: 全部 / 专业版 / 团队版
props.description: 配置总览对比卡内的分段筛选胶囊。

props.name: with_data
props.description: 按周期键注入自定义趋势卡、对比序列与重点产品卡数据。

props.name: with_compare_label
props.description: 自定义百分比涨跌徽标旁的对比说明文案。

motion: 切换时间范围时通过 pro_rolling_number 滚动所有标题数值，并对不同长度的折线序列重采样平滑过渡。
总览卡内分段胶囊采用 pro_pill_indicator 弹簧滑动且仅更新当前对比图；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::kpi_board::KpiBoardBlock 导入；执行 kui add kpi-board 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::kpi_board::KpiBoardBlock 导入。
非有限数值在汇总时按 0.0 计入并在折线中自动留白；上周期总量为 0 时自动隐藏涨跌百分比徽标。

lead.en: Collaborate with a multi-agent team in real time—follow their conversation, steer active plan steps, and monitor shared context tokens side by side.
lead.zh: 与多智能体团队实时并肩协作：左侧追踪对话并发送引导指令，右侧同步勾选执行计划与共享上下文容量。

rule.en: Pick an agent chip to highlight both its messages and its plan steps, press @ in the composer to target an agent, click file chips to preview artifacts, and press Esc to clear focus.
rule.zh: 点击顶部智能体标签可同时高亮其对话与所属步骤，在输入框按 @ 指定接收对象，点击文件胶囊预览产物，按 Esc 恢复全览。

when: Active multi-agent workspaces where users steer teammates mid-run, answer questions inline, and watch plan steps tick off beside shared context.
Human-in-the-loop orchestration consoles that pair agent handoffs with token budget visibility.
not: Post-mortem inspection of a single completed trace—use AgentRunDetailScreen instead.
Simple single-agent one-on-one chat threads that have no multi-step plan or shared context.
en.apiLead: LiveSessionBlock coordinates agent filtering across stream and plan, @mention steering, artifact modal previews, and live context compaction with typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a LiveSessionBlock preloaded with Orchestrator, Researcher, and Writer collaboration turns.

props.name: with_task
props.description: Set the task heading displayed on the plan card and accessible region.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Configure the participating agents and their model badges.

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Supply the ordered team plan with per-step agent assignments.

props.name: with_context
props.description: Configure or hide the shared context window card below the plan.

motion: Picking an agent chip glides the selection pill and dims unrelated messages and plan steps simultaneously; active steps sweep a subtle highlight via pro_shimmer_text.
Working agents animate diagonal pixel waves via pro_agent_avatar and token counts roll via pro_rolling_number; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous sweeps.
ai: Import from kui::components::live_session::LiveSessionBlock (library) or crate::ui::components::live_session::LiveSessionBlock after running kui add live-session.
Below 820px container width, the plan and shared context cards stack cleanly underneath the scrollable conversation stream.

when: 多智能体实时执行工作台：用户可在运行途中发消息纠偏、回答确认请求，并同步查看步骤勾选与上下文占用。
需要直观展示“哪位智能体负责哪一步”以及共享文件 Token 消耗的人机协同界面。
not: 已完成单次运行的事后深度回放（请使用 AgentRunDetailScreen）。
无需多步计划或共享上下文窗口的单智能体简单问答对话框。
zh.apiLead: LiveSessionBlock 联动管理对话流与计划步骤的智能体聚焦筛选、@提及定向发送、附件弹窗预览与上下文压缩，并通过强类型事件回调宿主。

props.name: new

lead.en: Present a complete sales overview where clickable KPI cards switch the central area-or-bars trend chart above ranked product and channel shares.
lead.zh: 以可点击切换主图指标的 KPI 统计卡、支持面积/柱状与同比对比的趋势图及商品与渠道排行条构成经营总览。

rule.en: Click KPI cards to switch the active metric, toggle Week / Month / Quarter, switch between Area and Bars, flip Compare to previous period, and hover or press Left/Right to scrub days.
rule.zh: 点击 KPI 卡片切换主图指标，切换周/月/季时间段，在面积折线与柱状图间切换，开启上周期对比，悬停或按左右键逐日读取数值。

when: Storefront, SaaS, and business overviews where one interactive trend chart driven by KPI tabs communicates more clearly than four cramped mini-charts.
Dashboards pairing time-series revenue and order velocity with top-product and acquisition-channel share bars.
not: High-cardinality OLAP pivot tables with hundreds of dimensions.
Displaying a single standalone counter without time-series context.
en.apiLead: MetricsDashboardBlock manages period slicing across 180-day histories, KPI tab selection, area/bar rendering, previous-period comparison, and export feedback.

motion: Selecting a KPI card brings it to full contrast while dimming sibling cards, rolling figures smoothly, and morphing the trend line or growing bar columns.
Period and chart-type pills glide via pro_pill_indicator while product and channel share bars spring via pro_spring_f32; capsule Compare switch preserves radius.full.

when: 电商、SaaS 与业务经营总览：由顶部 KPI 选项卡驱动一张高精度趋势主图，比堆叠多张小图更清晰。
同时关注时间序列（营业额、订单量、客单价、退款率/转化率）与热销商品、渠道占比的看板。
not: 包含数百个维度的复杂多维透视表下钻场景。
无需趋势与排行榜支撑的单一静态统计数字。
zh.apiLead: MetricsDashboardBlock 自动对 180 天历史序列切分本周期与同比上周期，联动 KPI 选项卡、面积/柱状切换、对比开关与导出确认。

时间段与图表类型切换采用 pro_pill_indicator 弹簧滑块，商品与渠道占比条通过 pro_spring_f32 弹性伸缩，对比胶囊开关保留 radius.full。

容器低于 640px 时 KPI 卡片重排为 2×2 网格且排行榜纵向堆叠；低于 460px 时时间段切换器自动撑满宽度。

lead.en: Monitor every agent from one home screen—what happened since you looked on top, who runs under whom on the left, and what needs your decision on the right.
lead.zh: 一屏掌控全部智能体：顶部呈现离线期间事件波峰，左侧展示主从编队拓扑，右侧集中处理待审批与重试卡片。

rule.en: Filter All / Running / Needs you / Failed across all three sections at once, hover curve dots to spotlight an agent, and approve, answer, or retry directly from any card.
rule.zh: 通过顶部统一筛选器联动过滤三块区域，悬停曲线事件点聚光对应智能体，并在卡片内直接完成批准、回答或重试。

when: Home dashboards for multi-agent products where users check morning recaps, inspect lead-to-worker hierarchies, and clear human-in-the-loop blockers.
Teams running several orchestrators concurrently that need one unified status filter.
not: Step-by-step trace debugging of a single agent run—use AgentRunDetailScreen instead.
Flat pools of hundreds of ungrouped workers without supervisor hierarchy.
en.apiLead: MissionControlBlock synchronizes its unified status filter and inline Approve / Answer / Retry / Dismiss actions across the recap curve, fleet tree, and inbox queue.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a MissionControlBlock with 7 canonical agents (3 running, 3 needing attention, 1 failed).

props.name: with_default_filter
props.description: Set the initial unified status filter (All, Running, NeedsYou, Failed).

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Provide supervisor agents and nested sub-agents with tasks, tools, asks, and errors.

props.name: with_events
props.description: Supply milestone peaks plotted along the Since you looked curve.

props.name: with_window_labels
props.description: Customize the start and end time labels beneath the recap curve.

motion: Active supervisor-to-worker links animate traveling light pulses via pro_connector_pulse while hovering a recap peak opens its lead tree and dims unrelated cards.
Answering or retrying an item updates the curve, fleet badges, inbox queue, and filter counts in lockstep while keeping the inbox lane height stable.

when: 多智能体产品首页：一屏查看离线期间发生了什么、谁在调度哪些子智能体、以及哪些事项等待人工拍板。
同时运行多组主管智能体并需要统一状态筛选器的团队协作台。
not: 单次智能体运行的深度调用链排障（请使用 AgentRunDetailScreen）。
未经分组的数百个扁平工作节点列表。
zh.apiLead: MissionControlBlock 将顶部状态筛选与卡片内批准、选择回答、重试、忽略动作实时同步至事件曲线、编队树与待办队列，并派发强类型事件。

ai: 库模式从 kui::components::mission_control::MissionControlBlock 导入；执行 kui add mission-control 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::mission_control::MissionControlBlock 导入。
容器低于 840px 时右侧待处理队列下移堆叠；低于 560px 时子智能体自动缩进内嵌于主管卡片下方。

lead.en: Place every agent on one shared clock—recap peaks since you looked on top, live Gantt swimlanes with handoff links on the left, and pending approvals on the right.
lead.zh: 在同一时钟轴上统览全部智能体：顶部呈现事件波峰，左侧展示带交接连线的甘特泳道，右侧集中处理待办审批。

rule.en: Use the unified filter to narrow all three sections together, hover curve peaks to spotlight an agent's lane, click any task block for details, and approve or retry inline.
rule.zh: 使用统一筛选器同步收敛三块面板，悬停波峰圆点聚光对应泳道，点击甘特块展开详情，并在卡片内直接批准或重试。

when: Multi-agent operations homes where teams care about exact temporal overlap, handoff timing, and live 'now' progress alongside human approvals.
Twin temporal view of MissionControlBlock when sequence and duration matter more than tree depth.
not: Inspecting one agent's internal prompt and token trace—use AgentRunDetailScreen instead.
Hundreds of ungrouped concurrent jobs without pagination or rollup.

when: 关注多智能体并行时段重叠、跨轨交接时机与“now”实时推进进度，并需同步处理审批的指挥首页。
作为 MissionControlBlock 的时间轴孪生视图，突出先后顺序与任务耗时。
not: 单次智能体运行的内部 Prompt 与工具帧级排障（请使用 AgentRunDetailScreen）。
未经聚合的数百条并发流水。

容器低于 850px 时待处理队列自动移至泳道下方；低于 520px 时左侧智能体栏收窄为紧凑像素头像，确保 390px 移动端甘特条清晰可读。

lead.en: Compare up to four subscription tiers with a capsule monthly/yearly switcher, rolling prices, quota rows, and a collapsible feature comparison matrix.
lead.zh: 提供带胶囊形月付/年付切换器、滚动价格数字、配额摘要与可折叠完整功能对比表的独立定价区块。

rule.en: Use Left/Right or Enter/Space on the capsule switcher to toggle Monthly and Yearly (-20%), click Start free trial to select a plan, and fold per-card details or the full comparison matrix below.
rule.zh: 使用左右方向键或回车切换月付与年付（-20%），点击试用按钮选择档位，并可独立展开卡片详情或底部完整对比表。

when: Presenting a product pricing section with up to three or four subscription tiers, annual discount switching, and progressive feature disclosure.
not: Single one-time purchases that do not need recurring billing toggles or multi-tier quota comparisons.
en.apiLead: PricingPlansBlock owns billing-cycle state, rolling price transitions, per-card detail disclosures, and the cross-tier comparison table while emitting typed selection events.

when: 在产品落地页或升级弹窗中展示三至四个订阅档位、年付折扣切换、配额对比及渐进展开的功能列表。
not: 无需周期计费切换或多档配额对比的单次买断商品卡片。

跨帧保持稳定的 ElementId，确保键盘焦点与价格弹簧状态连续。

lead.en: Answer revenue questions inline with KPI cards, pointer-brushable YoY trend curves, regional stacked bars, and Q4 forecast cones without an outer app shell.
lead.zh: 无需外层应用壳即可嵌入页面的对话式营收分析区块，内置 KPI 卡片、可框选追问的同比趋势图、区域堆叠柱状图与预测锥。

rule.en: Drag across weeks on a trend or forecast chart (or click a stacked bar) to open an inline follow-up prompt scoped to that exact slice; press Escape to clear.
rule.zh: 在趋势图或预测图上横向拖选周区间（或点击任一区域堆叠柱），即可打开针对该局部数据的追问输入框；按 Esc 取消。

when: Embedding a conversational finance, BI, or revenue assistant directly inside your own page layout without wrapping it in AppShell.
not: Full multi-thread workspaces that need a persistent chat sidebar and right-hand ledger inspector — use AiChatRevenueScreen instead.

lead.en: Inspect a multi-agent run on one screen with top rollup metrics, a live orchestrator-to-sub-agent tree, miniature call duration bars, and inline error traces.
lead.zh: 在单屏内总览多智能体运行的汇总指标、编排器调用树、卡片内微型耗时条及行内可重试错误详情。

rule.en: Click an agent card to scope the top numbers to its subtree, click any call bar row to unfold its arguments or error trace inline, and press Retry on failed tool calls.
rule.zh: 点击智能体卡片将顶部指标聚焦至该子树，点击任意微型调用行在原位展开参数或红色错误堆栈，并可直接点击重试。

when: Debugging or monitoring a live multi-agent orchestration where delegation structure, per-agent calls, token costs, and failed tool steps belong on one screen.
not: Single-agent runs with hundreds of flat spans — use a full-width trace waterfall instead.
en.apiLead: RunInspectorBlock computes subtree rollups, paints live pulsed connectors between agent cards, and unfolds call payloads inline while emitting typed events.

lead.en: Sort sprint tasks across Backlog, Todo, In Progress, and Done with search, label filter chips, a compact switch, inline quick-add, and a slide-over detail drawer.
lead.zh: 跨 Backlog、Todo、In Progress 与 Done 四列管理迭代任务，内置搜索、标签筛选、胶囊紧凑开关、列内速建与侧滑详情抽屉。

rule.en: Drag cards between columns or use arrow/status controls, click + in any column to quick-add a task, filter by label chips or search, and click any card to open the detail drawer.
rule.zh: 在列间拖拽卡片或点击状态按钮移动任务，点击列底 + 号原位新建卡片，按标签或关键词过滤，点击任意卡片滑出右侧详情面板。

when: Embedding a standalone sprint, launch, or triage board inside a product workspace without requiring an outer navigation shell.
not: Backlogs of thousands of unpaginated issues — paginate or filter on the server before passing tasks to the board.
en.apiLead: TaskBoardBlock manages column ordering, pointer drag-and-drop, Editor-backed search and inline quick-add, compact density, and a slide-over inspector while emitting typed change events.

not: 未经服务端分页过滤的数千条超大规模工单列表。

跨帧保持稳定的任务编号与 ElementId，确保搜索框焦点、拖拽状态与已打开抽屉不丢失。

lead.en: Stream grounded assistant answers with horizontal source cards, inline citation previews, version switching, feedback tags, and related follow-ups.
lead.zh: 呈现带横向来源卡片、行内引用悬停预览、多版本切换、反馈标签与关联追问的流式 AI 回答。

rule.en: Hover or focus any [1] citation chip to preview its source excerpt and light up its card, switch versions with 1/2, rate with thumbs up/down, or click Replay stream.
rule.zh: 悬停或聚焦 [1] 引用胶囊可预览来源摘要并点亮对应卡片，通过 1/2 切换生成版本、评价反馈或点击重播流式输出。

when: Assistant answers grounded in workspace docs, Slack threads, or web searches where users verify claims before acting.
Research, support, and knowledge-base surfaces needing copyable citations, regeneration history, and structured feedback.
not: Casual one-line chat bubbles that do not cite external sources.
Static post-hoc quote verification where unfolding verbatim passages per source is primary—use CitedAnswer instead.
en.apiLead: AiAnswer parses markdown-lite paragraphs, bullet lists, bold spans, and 1-based [1,2] citations while managing streaming, version history, and typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an AiAnswer preloaded with 5 workspace sources, 2 answer versions, citations, and follow-ups.

props.description: Set the heading displayed above the horizontal source strip.

props.name: with_sources
props.description: Supply numbered sources with brand icons, URLs, and preview snippets.

props.name: with_versions
props.description: Provide multiple generated passes navigable via the 1/N switcher and Regenerate.

props.description: Begin immediately in the Reading -> Writing token stream with a Stop button.

props.name: with_framed
props.description: Wrap the answer in an elevated 10px card or render chromeless inside a parent thread.

motion: Streaming sequences Reading shimmer (pro_shimmer_text) into word-by-word token arrival with a pulsing accent caret; citation popovers enter via pro_presence.
Thumbs-down feedback unfolds reason tags via pro_fold and version switches micro-glide via pro_view_transition; Theme::reduced_motion reveals text immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::ai_answer::AiAnswer (library) or crate::ui::components::ai_answer::AiAnswer after running kui add ai-answer.
Out-of-range citation numbers in [n] markup are safely ignored so hallucinated indices never render broken chips.

when: 连接了工作区文档、Slack 讨论或联网搜索的 AI 助手回答，方便用户在决策前核查依据。
需要一键复制带编号参考文献、重新生成多版本对比及收集差评原因的研究与知识库产品。
not: 不含任何外部知识源的普通闲聊气泡。
以逐句双向高亮核验原文段落为核心的静态检视场景（请使用 CitedAnswer）。
zh.apiLead: AiAnswer 自动解析分段、无序列表、粗体与 1 起始的 [1,2] 引用标记，内置流式输出控制、多版本历史及强类型事件。

点踩后通过 pro_fold 展开原因标签，切换版本通过 pro_view_transition 平滑微移；开启减少动效时直接呈现完整文本。

超出 sources 长度的 [n] 标记会被安全忽略，防止模型幻觉产生断链胶囊。

lead.en: Compose rich AI prompts with a multiline editor, provider-branded model popover, live voice waveform dictation, connected app switches, file chips, and inline tool approval.
lead.zh: 集多行编辑器、多模型切换浮层、实时语音波形听写、应用连接开关、文件附件胶囊与工具审批横幅于一体的 AI 输入框。

rule.en: Press Enter or Cmd+Enter to send (Shift+Enter for a newline), click + to attach files, toggle GitHub/Linear/Slack/Notion/Drive in Connected apps, or tap the mic for voice dictation.
rule.zh: 按 Enter 或 Cmd+Enter 发送（Shift+Enter 换行），点击 + 添加附件，在底部开关已连应用，或点击麦克风进入实时语音听写。

when: Primary prompt input for AI assistants and autonomous agents that attach files, switch models, and act across connected workspace tools.
Human-in-the-loop workflows where users approve or deny pending MCP tool calls right above the message box.
not: Plain person-to-person messaging that only needs a single-line text field and send button.
Narrow side rails under 280px where model and app toolbars cannot breathe.
en.apiLead: ChatComposer wraps a multiline Editor with model, approval, folder, and app popovers, voice dictation waveform mode, attachment chips, and typed events.

Voice dictation streams confirmed and trailing words alongside a 14-bar live audio waveform; Theme::reduced_motion freezes continuous oscillation.

when: AI 助手与智能体工作台的主输入框，支持挂载文件、切换大模型并调用已连接的工作区应用。
需要在输入框上方内联审批或拒绝待执行 MCP 工具调用的人机协同流程。
not: 仅需单行文本框与发送按钮的普通即时通讯场景。
宽度不足 280px 的极窄侧栏空间。
zh.apiLead: ChatComposer 封装多行 Editor，内置模型、审批策略、工作目录与应用开关浮层、实时语音波形听写及强类型事件。

语音听写模式下逐词浮现草稿并伴随 14 柱实时音频波形律动；开启减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::chat_composer::ChatComposer 导入；执行 kui add chat-composer 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::chat_composer::ChatComposer 导入。
内部采用 InputMode::InlineMulti，按 Enter 直接发送，按 Shift+Enter 插入换行。

lead.en: Inspect RAG answers wired two-way to their sources—hovering a citation or source spotlights both ends, while clicking unfolds the quoted passage with matching phrases marked.
lead.zh: 将 AI 回答与参考来源双向绑定：悬停引用标记或来源行会同步点亮正文句子与来源卡，点击即在来源下方展开带高亮匹配词的原文段落。

rule.en: Hover or focus any [1] marker or source row to spotlight the matching claims in prose, click to unfold or fold its highlighted quote passage, and press Arrow keys or Esc to navigate.
rule.zh: 悬停或聚焦任一 [1] 标记或来源行即可双向高亮正文论据，点击展开或收起带关键词高亮的引用原文，支持方向键切换与 Esc 关闭。

when: Completed RAG, research, legal, or support answers where readers verify exact backing passages claim by claim.
Pairing sentence-level provenance counts ('5 of 6 sentences backed by a source') with verbatim quote inspection.
not: Answers that are still streaming token-by-token with regeneration and thumbs feedback—use AiAnswer instead.
Unstructured chat turns that have no retrieved passages.
en.apiLead: CitedAnswer links CitedSegment claims to numbered CitedSource rows by id, highlights shared phrases inside quotes, and emits typed preview and copy events.

motion: Hovering a citation chip or source row spotlights linked sentences while softly dimming uncited prose; clicking unfolds verbatim passages via pro_fold.
Footer tray captions crossfade via pro_view_transition when inspecting sources or copying quotes; Theme::reduced_motion snaps transitions cleanly.
ai: Import from kui::components::cited_answer::CitedAnswer (library) or crate::ui::components::cited_answer::CitedAnswer after running kui add cited-answer.
When CitedSource::highlight is empty, words of 5+ characters and numeric metrics shared with citing sentences are marked automatically.

when: RAG 检索增强、投研、法务或客服问答完成后，供用户逐句核对每条结论背后的原文出处。
需要直观展示“6 句中有 5 句具备来源支撑”并提供一键展开高亮引文与复制引文的场景。
not: 仍在逐字流式生成且需要多版本重新生成与点踩反馈的回答（请使用 AiAnswer）。
不包含检索文档段落的普通对话消息。
zh.apiLead: CitedAnswer 按 id 自动关联分句片段与编号来源，支持精确短语或自动关键词高亮，并通过强类型事件通知宿主。

motion: 悬停引用标记或来源卡时同步高亮关联句子并柔和淡化其余文本，点击来源行通过 pro_fold 平滑展开带标记的引用段落。
底栏统计摘要在悬停来源与复制引文时通过 pro_view_transition 微移切换；开启减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::cited_answer::CitedAnswer 导入；执行 kui add cited-answer 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::cited_answer::CitedAnswer 导入。
未显式传入 highlight 短语时，组件会自动标记引文中与被引用句共现的 5 字母以上词汇与数值指标。

lead.en: Compare and select LLMs with spring-animated Speed, Quality, and Cost meters, unfolding Extended thinking effort controls, and rolling latency and token pricing.
lead.zh: 在对话工具栏直观对比与切换大模型：悬停或按键浏览时平滑填充速度、质量与成本弹簧条，开启深度思考展开强度档位并实时滚动首字延迟与单价。

rule.en: Hover or press Up and Down across Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Auto to fill each row's Speed/Quality/Cost bars and roll tray stats; toggle Extended thinking to unfold Low/Medium/High effort.
rule.zh: 悬停或按上下方向键浏览模型即可动态填充速度/质量/成本弹簧条并滚动底栏延迟与价格，开启深度思考开关可展开低/中/高推理强度。

when: Chat composer toolbars where users trade off speed, reasoning depth, and per-million-token cost between prompts.
Pairing model selection with per-turn toggles like Extended thinking effort and Web search.
not: Catalogs of 50+ provider endpoints that require text filtering—use Combobox instead.
Full-page model configuration forms—use SettingsModelsScreen instead.
en.apiLead: ModelPicker coordinates listbox keyboard navigation, spring capability bars, capsule switches, effort radio segments, and rolling latency/cost readouts.

First-token latency and $/1M token price interpolate smoothly via pro_rolling_number while the Effort thumb glides via pro_pill_indicator; Theme::reduced_motion snaps changes.
ai: Import from kui::components::model_picker::ModelPicker (library) or crate::ui::components::model_picker::ModelPicker after running kui add model-picker.
Use with_side(ModelMenuSide::Top) when mounting inside a composer docked at the bottom edge of a viewport.

需要将模型选择与“深度思考强度”、“联网搜索”等随消息生效的开关组合在一起的场景。
not: 包含数十个模型端点、需要关键词搜索过滤的模型库（请使用 Combobox）。
管理 API 密钥与全局配额的完整设置页（请使用 SettingsModelsScreen）。

motion: 悬停或方向键聚焦任一模型时通过 pro_spring_bar 平滑充盈速度、质量与成本条，切换深度思考开关时通过 pro_fold 展开强度选择器。

嵌入页面底部的输入框时可调用 with_side(ModelMenuSide::Top) 让模型菜单向上展开。

lead.en: Display an AI assistant's live working trail with a ticking 0:08 timer, shimmering header, branded search source pills, progressive reasoning steps, and collapsible disclosure.
lead.zh: 展示 AI 助手的实时推理轨迹：配备 0:08 跳动计时器、流光标题、带品牌图标的检索来源胶囊、逐条浮现的思考步骤与折叠面板。

rule.en: Click the header to collapse or expand the timeline, hover brand source pills to preview URLs, click +3 more to reveal hidden sources, and use Done or Replay to inspect states.
rule.zh: 点击顶栏折叠或展开步骤时间线，悬停品牌来源胶囊预览链接，点击 +3 更多展开其余来源，通过完成或重播切换运行状态。

when: Multi-second AI search, reading, and synthesis runs where showing real-time progress and consulted sources builds user trust.
Collapsible chain-of-thought summaries above an assistant's final answer.
not: Sub-second requests where a subtle inline spinner avoids layout shift.
Deterministic file uploads with exact byte percentages—use Progress instead.
en.apiLead: ThinkingState sequences search and reasoning milestones on a live timer, renders branded source pills with overflow disclosure, and emits completion and replay events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a ThinkingState preloaded with 7 workspace search sources and 4 progressive reasoning milestones.

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Supply ordered Search and Step milestones revealed one by one.

props.name: with_done_label
props.description: Customize the final completion row label.

props.name: with_step_ms
props.description: Interval in milliseconds between consecutive reasoning steps.

props.name: with_completed
props.description: Start immediately in the finished Worked for 0:08 state when true.

motion: While active, the 3x3 pixel mark twinkles along AGENT_WAVE_MS, the header and current step sweep via pro_shimmer_text, and each arriving step glides 6px upward.
Clicking the header folds or unfolds the timeline via pro_fold and URL tooltips fade via pro_presence; Theme::reduced_motion settles all steps immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::thinking_state::ThinkingState (library) or crate::ui::components::thinking_state::ThinkingState after running kui add thinking-state.
Pair above AiAnswer or CitedAnswer so users can collapse the reasoning trail once the final response arrives.

when: 耗时数秒的 AI 检索、阅读与综合推理过程，通过实时展示已查来源与当前步骤建立用户信任感。
置于最终回答上方的可折叠思维链摘要面板。
not: 不足一秒即可返回的轻量请求。
拥有精确字节百分比的确定性上传或构建进度（请使用 Progress）。
zh.apiLead: ThinkingState 按实时计时器依次揭示检索与思考节点，内置品牌图标胶囊、+N 展开与完成/重播事件回调。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 7 个工作区检索来源与 4 个渐进推理步骤的 AI 思考面板。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 传入按顺序揭示的检索步骤（Search）与推理步骤（Step）。

props.name: with_done_label
props.description: 自定义全部步骤完成后的末尾节点文案。

props.name: with_step_ms
props.description: 相邻两个思考步骤之间的揭示间隔毫秒数。

props.name: with_completed
props.description: 传 true 时直接以“思考耗时 0:08”完成态挂载。

motion: 思考过程中 3x3 像素标志呈对角呼吸波纹，顶栏与当前激活步骤通过 pro_shimmer_text 流光扫过，新到达节点带 6px 柔和上浮。
点击顶栏通过 pro_fold 平滑折叠时间线，悬停来源通过 pro_presence 显示链接提示；开启减少动效时直接展示完整步骤。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::thinking_state::ThinkingState 导入；执行 kui add thinking-state 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::thinking_state::ThinkingState 导入。
可与下方的 AiAnswer 或 CitedAnswer 组合使用，在回答生成后收起推理轨迹。

lead.en: Embed a compact AI writing companion card with a drifting three-lobe color glow, quick rewrite chips, streaming replies, and live voice dictation.
lead.zh: 提供带柔和漂移三色光晕、快捷改写指令胶囊、逐词流式回复与实时语音听写波形的悬浮式 AI 写作助手卡片。

rule.en: Press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a newline, toggle Dictate for live waveform voice input, and Accept, Retry, or Copy any streamed draft; reduced motion stills the glow and shows replies immediately.
rule.zh: 按 Enter 发送、Shift+Enter 换行，点击麦克风开启实时语音听写波形，并支持对生成草稿执行采纳插入、重写或复制；开启减少动效时光晕保持静止并立即展示完整回复。

when: Inline AI writing helpers inside editors, CRMs, mail clients, or sidebars for polishing, shortening, warming tone, translating, and drafting replies.
Interactive product hero cards where visitors can try prompt chips and live voice dictation immediately.
not: Multi-turn research sessions with file attachments, tool traces, and model selectors—use AssistantHomeScreen or AgentChatScreen instead.
Headless background text transformations that do not need user review before insertion.
en.apiLead: WritingAssistant owns the drifting atmospheric glow, multiline Editor composer, simulated live dictation, word-by-word streaming, and Accept / Retry / Copy draft actions while emitting typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a WritingAssistant card with the default Quill persona and five quick rewrite chips.

props.name: with_name
props.description: Set the assistant display name beside the gradient sparkle mark.

props.name: with_tagline
props.description: Set the subtitle line beneath the assistant name.

props.name: with_greeting
props.description: Override the headline shown on the initial welcome state.

props.name: with_suggestions
props.description: Customize the quick suggestion chips that submit prompts on click.

props.name: with_responder
props.description: Provide custom draft generation for initial prompts and Retry variations.

props.name: with_speech_mode
props.description: Enable simulated live voice dictation or hide the microphone button.

motion: Three Gaussian-softened pink, violet, and blue lobes drift out of phase across the lower half and smoothly dim via Slide spring once a chat begins.
Listening mode breathes an outward accent ring around a three-bar live waveform while streaming dictated words into the Editor; replies stream word by word unless Theme::reduced_motion is enabled.
ai: Import from kui::components::writing_assistant::WritingAssistant (library) or crate::ui::components::writing_assistant::WritingAssistant after running kui add writing-assistant.
Subscribe to WritingAssistantEvent::Accepted to insert finalized copy directly into your host editor selection.

when: 嵌入文档编辑器、CRM、邮件客户端或侧边栏的轻量 AI 写作助手，用于润色、精简、柔化语气、多语翻译与快速拟稿。
需要在产品落地页提供真实可交互改写胶囊与语音输入体验的演示卡片。
not: 带附件上传、工具调用轨迹与模型配置的长对话工作台——请改用 AssistantHomeScreen 或 AgentChatScreen。
无需人工审阅确认即可静默替换文本的后台批处理任务。
zh.apiLead: WritingAssistant 内置三色漂移光晕、多行 Editor 输入框、实时语音听写模拟、逐词流式输出及采纳/重写/复制动作，并通过强类型事件通知宿主。

props.name: new
props.description: 使用默认 Quill 形象与五枚快捷写作胶囊创建写作助手卡片。

props.name: with_name
props.description: 设置顶部渐变星芒图标旁的助手名称。

props.name: with_tagline
props.description: 设置助手名称下方的副标题说明。

props.name: with_greeting
props.description: 自定义初始欢迎态主标题。

props.name: with_suggestions
props.description: 自定义欢迎态快捷指令胶囊列表。

props.name: with_responder
props.description: 注入自定义文稿生成闭包，支持首轮生成与多次重写变体。

props.name: with_speech_mode
props.description: 开启模拟实时语音听写或隐藏麦克风按钮。

motion: 粉、紫、蓝三团柔和光斑在卡片下半部错相缓慢漂移，进入对话态后经 Slide 弹簧平滑收敛亮度以保证阅读对比度。
听写态下麦克风外圈呼吸扩散高光环并驱动三柱实时声波，边听边将词句写入输入框；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时光晕静止且回复立即完整呈现。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::writing_assistant::WritingAssistant 导入；执行 kui add writing-assistant 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::writing_assistant::WritingAssistant 导入。
订阅 WritingAssistantEvent::Accepted 事件即可将用户确认的润色结果直接写回宿主编辑器选区。

lead.en: Search and run anything from one field—tool actions with brand logos and Cmd+1–Cmd+5 shortcuts, everyday commands with icons, and an AI prompt fallback.
lead.zh: 在单一搜索框中检索并执行全部工作区指令：带品牌图标与 Cmd+1–Cmd+5 快捷键的集成动作、日常页面导航及 AI 提问兜底。

rule.en: Use Up/Down/Home/End to navigate, Tab/Shift+Tab to jump between sections, Cmd+1–Cmd+5 to run top suggestions immediately, Enter to execute, and Esc to clear or close.
rule.zh: 支持上下方向键与 Home/End 逐行定位、Tab 跨分组跳转、Cmd+1–Cmd+5 直接触发顶部建议、Enter 执行当前项、Esc 清空或关闭。

when: A Cmd+K launcher that runs actions across connected SaaS tools (Gmail, Linear, GitHub, Slack, Notion, Google Calendar, HubSpot) and core workspace routes.
Keyboard-first workflows where power users jump to any page or trigger an AI command without touching the pointer.
not: Acting as the sole hidden navigation mechanism—keep primary workspace navigation visible alongside Cmd+K.
Menus with fewer than five total actions where plain toolbar buttons are faster to discover.
en.apiLead: CommandMenu owns the Combobox search Editor, case-insensitive substring highlighting, gliding pill indicator, Cmd+1–Cmd+5 shortcuts, and footer execution confirmation while emitting typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a CommandMenu populated with Suggestions, Share, General, and Go to groups.

props.name: with_groups
props.description: Supply custom command sections with brand logos, ProIcons, hints, and shortcut keycaps.

props.name: with_placeholder
props.description: Override the search field placeholder text.

props.name: with_auto_focus
props.description: Focus the Combobox search Editor automatically when mounted.

props.name: with_selected
props.description: Set the initially highlighted command row index.

motion: A critically damped Slide selection pill glides smoothly across section boundaries as keyboard focus or pointer hover moves.
Executing a command transitions the footer tray to a green check confirmation banner; Theme::reduced_motion snaps highlight and state changes immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::command_menu::CommandMenu (library) or crate::ui::components::command_menu::CommandMenu after running kui add command-menu.
Handle CommandMenuEvent::Run where id == "ask" to forward free-form search prompts directly to your workspace assistant.

when: 跨集成工具（Gmail、Linear、GitHub、Slack、Notion、Google Calendar、HubSpot）与核心页面的 Cmd+K 全局命令启动器。
面向键盘效率用户的无鼠标操作流，一键直达任意视图或触发 AI 快捷提问。
not: 充当唯一隐藏导航入口——主导航栏仍应保持可见。
总数少于五项的简单操作组（直接展示按钮更易发现）。
zh.apiLead: CommandMenu 内置 Combobox 搜索框、匹配字符高亮标记、跨组滑动高亮胶囊、Cmd+1–Cmd+5 快捷键与底栏执行回执，并通过强类型事件通知宿主。

props.name: new
props.description: 使用快捷建议、协作流转、常用操作与前往页面四组默认指令创建命令面板。

props.name: with_groups
props.description: 自定义命令分组、品牌图标、辅助说明与快捷键键帽。

props.name: with_placeholder
props.description: 自定义顶部搜索框占位提示文案。

props.name: with_auto_focus
props.description: 挂载后自动聚焦搜索输入框。

props.name: with_selected
props.description: 设置初始高亮的命令索引。

motion: Slide 临界阻尼弹簧驱动选中背景胶囊随上下方向键、Tab 或指针悬停在分组间顺滑游走。
执行命令后底栏平滑切换为绿色对勾确认提示；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时所有切换立即完成。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::command_menu::CommandMenu 导入；执行 kui add command-menu 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::command_menu::CommandMenu 导入。
