在 CommandMenuEvent::Run 中判断 id == "ask" 即可将自由输入的检索词直接交由 AI 助手回答。

lead.en: Browse and connect SaaS services inside a command menu—live search on top, grouped services on the left, and Workspace vs Personal OAuth tiles on the right.
lead.zh: 面向命令面板的双栏集成选择器：顶部即时搜索，左侧分组展示 SaaS 服务与连接状态点，右侧呈现团队工作区与个人账号双授权卡片。

rule.en: Press Up/Down to step across Connected and Available services, Enter to toggle connection, Cmd+/ to jump to search, Left Arrow in an empty search to go back, and Esc to clear or close.
rule.zh: 按上下键跨「已连接」与「可连接」分组移动，Enter 启停连接，Cmd+/ 聚焦搜索框，空搜索框下按左方向键返回上级，Esc 清空或关闭。

when: The integrations sub-page of a Cmd+K command menu or compact agent tool-connection dialog.
Workflows where users distinguish shared Workspace OAuth scopes from private Personal account scopes without leaving their current task.
not: Full-screen app marketplaces with dozens of categories and webhook logs—use IntegrationsScreen instead.
Settings forms with only two or three binary switches.
en.apiLead: IntegrationPicker owns the Combobox search Editor, Connected/Available partitioning, gliding selection pill, Kense + Service link banner, and dual Workspace/Personal OAuth scope toggles.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an IntegrationPicker with 10 SaaS services (Linear, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Stripe, Figma, HubSpot, Google Calendar, Vercel, Supabase).

props.name: with_app_name
props.description: Set the host product name shown in the detail heading (e.g. "Kense + Linear").

props.name: with_services
props.description: Replace the service list, OAuth scope strings, and initial Workspace/Personal states.

props.name: with_selected
props.description: Select the initially inspected service id.

props.name: with_back_button
props.description: Show or hide the leading Back button for nested command-menu pages.

motion: The row highlight pill glides smoothly across Connected and Available group headers via Slide spring, while the right detail pane micro-glides on service changes.
Connected services radiate a calm 2.8s concentric accent ring behind the Kense and brand tiles; Theme::reduced_motion pauses ring expansion and snaps transitions.
ai: Import from kui::components::integration_picker::IntegrationPicker (library) or crate::ui::components::integration_picker::IntegrationPicker after running kui add integration-picker.
Listen for IntegrationPickerEvent::ConnectionToggled { id, target, connected } to trigger Workspace or Personal OAuth flows.

when: Cmd+K 命令面板或智能体工具绑定弹窗中的「集成应用」子页面。
让用户在不离开当前上下文的情况下快速检索服务，并分别管理「团队工作区」与「个人账号」两类 OAuth 权限范围。
not: 包含大量分类筛选与 Webhook 日志的完整应用市场页面——请使用 IntegrationsScreen。
仅有两三项简单开关的基础列表。
zh.apiLead: IntegrationPicker 内置搜索框、已连接/可连接动态分组、跨组滑动高亮、Kense + 服务双图标连接头图以及工作区/个人双授权卡片。

props.name: new
props.description: 使用 Linear、Slack、GitHub、Notion、Stripe、Figma、HubSpot、Google Calendar、Vercel 与 Supabase 十款服务创建选择器。

props.name: with_app_name
props.description: 设置详情标题中的宿主产品名称（如 "Kense + Linear"）。

props.name: with_services
props.description: 自定义服务列表、OAuth 权限摘要及初始连接状态。

props.name: with_selected
props.description: 指定初始选中的服务标识。

props.name: with_back_button
props.description: 显示或隐藏顶部搜索栏左侧的返回按钮。

motion: 选中胶囊通过临界阻尼弹簧跨分组顺滑游走，右侧详情区随所选服务做轻量渐显位移。
已连接服务在双应用图标背后持续扩散柔和同心脉冲环；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时停止脉冲并立即完成切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::integration_picker::IntegrationPicker 导入；执行 kui add integration-picker 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::integration_picker::IntegrationPicker 导入。
订阅 IntegrationPickerEvent::ConnectionToggled { id, target, connected } 即可分别拉起工作区级或个人级 OAuth 授权流程。

lead.en: Build a SaaS billing phase — start date, duration, recurring products with billing timing, coupon discounts, minimum commitments, and live rolling totals.
lead.zh: 构建 SaaS 合同计费阶段——支持起止日期、持续周期、产品重复频率与预付/后付时机、优惠码折扣、最低消费承诺及实时滚动汇总。

rule.en: Edit the phase name or line prices inline, pick start dates and durations to recalculate recurring cycles, toggle in-advance vs. in-arrears timing, and add products, discounts, or minimums.
rule.zh: 行内编辑阶段名称与单价，选择开始日期和合同周期自动换算计费期数，切换期初预付或期末后付，并随时添加产品、优惠折扣或保底承诺。

when: CPQ quoting and enterprise contract builders assembling setup fees, recurring seats, support add-ons, discounts, and minimum spend commitments.
Subscription admin consoles configuring multi-cycle billing phases with day-one vs. full-phase financial previews.
not: Simple self-serve tier pickers—use PricingTable for consumer plan selection.
Metered per-unit tier tables with variable volume brackets.
en.apiLead: BillingSchedule owns inline phase and price Editors, an interactive Gregorian calendar picker, cadence and timing popovers, and live rolling first-invoice and phase-total math.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a billing schedule seeded with a Build-out phase, $4,999.00 setup fee, and 5 catalog products.

props.name: with_phase
props.description: Set the initial editable phase label shown in the summary header.

props.name: with_default_start
props.description: Configure the starting YYYY-MM-DD contract date.

props.name: with_duration
props.description: Choose Milestone, 1m, 3m, 6m, 12m, or 24m phase duration.

props.name: with_catalog / with_lines
props.description: Supply custom selectable products, coupon discounts, and minimum commitments.

motion: Popovers and the interactive calendar animate smoothly via pro_presence, end-date readouts transition with pro_view_transition, and First invoice and Phase total roll live via pro_rolling_number.
Enabling Theme::reduced_motion snaps menus and numeric updates immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::billing_schedule::BillingSchedule (library) or crate::ui::components::billing_schedule::BillingSchedule after running kui add billing-schedule.
Subscribe to BillingScheduleEvent::Changed for a complete BillingScheduleSnapshot including computed BillingTotals.

when: CPQ 报价单与企业级合同编排工具，将实施部署费、席位许可、技术支持、折扣券与最低消费承诺组合为计费阶段。
订阅管理后台在保存合同前同步预览首期账单金额与阶段总金额。
not: 面向自助用户的简单套餐选择卡片（请使用 PricingTable）。
按阶梯用量浮动单价的计量计费规则编辑器。
zh.apiLead: BillingSchedule 内置阶段名与单价行内编辑器、交互式公历选择器、计费周期与预付/后付浮层，以及实时滚动的首期账单与阶段总额计算。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置实施启动阶段、$4,999.00 部署费及 5 项可选产品目录的计费排期器。

props.name: with_phase
props.description: 设置摘要栏初始可编辑的计费阶段名称。

props.name: with_default_start
props.description: 配置 YYYY-MM-DD 格式的阶段开始日期。

props.name: with_duration
props.description: 选择里程碑结算或 1/3/6/12/24 个月合同持续期。

props.name: with_catalog / with_lines
props.description: 注入自定义可选产品、百分比优惠码及最低消费保底行。

motion: 日历、周期、重复频率及产品目录菜单通过 pro_presence 平滑展开收起，阶段结束日期通过 pro_view_transition 微移过渡，首期账单与阶段总额通过 pro_rolling_number 实时滚动。
开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时所有浮层与金额即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::billing_schedule::BillingSchedule 导入；执行 kui add billing-schedule 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::billing_schedule::BillingSchedule 导入。
订阅 BillingScheduleEvent::Changed 事件即可获取包含完整 BillingTotals 汇总结果的快照。

lead.en: Configure a connected SaaS integration — master sync switch, masked/revealable API key, live domain validation, timezone picker, and a dirty-state save bar.
lead.zh: 管理已连接的第三方 SaaS 服务——主同步开关、可显隐与重新生成的 API 密钥、实时校验域名输入框、可搜索时区选择器及未保存更改底栏。

rule.en: Flip the sync switch to fold settings away, reveal/copy/regenerate the API key, edit the site domain to test green/red validation, pick a timezone, and Save or Discard.
rule.zh: 拨动顶部开关折叠配置项，点击显隐、复制或重新生成 API 密钥，修改域名实时触发绿/红格式校验，选择时区并通过底部工具栏保存或放弃。

when: Per-connector configuration cards for commerce stores, payment gateways, analytics pipelines, and webhook destinations.
Settings forms that stage edits locally and require explicit confirmation via Discard / Save changes.
not: Multi-tab workspace settings suites spanning dozens of unrelated preferences—use AppShell with Settings preset instead.
Catalog browsing grids before a service is connected—pair with AppDirectory.
en.apiLead: IntegrationSettings manages draft vs. saved IntegrationValues, masked Password-mode Editors, live domain validation, searchable timezone popovers, and typed save/discard events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a connected Stripe store settings card with prefilled API key, domain, and Berlin timezone.

props.name: with_provider
props.description: Select the brand mark rendered inside pro_app_tile ("stripe", "slack", "github", "hubspot", etc.).

props.name: with_values
props.description: Seed initial enabled, api_key, site_url, and time_zone values.

props.name: with_time_zones
props.description: Provide custom selectable GMT/UTC time zone strings.

props.name: with_site_hint
props.description: Customize the helper caption shown below a valid site address.

motion: Pausing the integration folds all configuration sections cleanly via pro_fold, while dirty changes animate the Discard / Save changes bar in and out via pro_presence.
Capsule switch thumb physics follow DESIGN.md radius.full rules and respect Theme::reduced_motion.
ai: Import from kui::components::integration_settings::IntegrationSettings (library) or crate::ui::components::integration_settings::IntegrationSettings after running kui add integration-settings.
Subscribe to IntegrationSettingsEvent::Saved to persist validated IntegrationValues to your backend.

when: 电商平台、支付网关、数据仓库或 Webhook 连接器的单项服务配置卡片。
需要在本地暂存修改、校验通过后才允许确认保存或一键回滚的设置表单。
not: 包含数十个独立分组的大型全局设置中心（请使用 AppShell 的 Settings 预设）。
尚未连接服务前的应用市场浏览网格（请搭配 AppDirectory 使用）。
zh.apiLead: IntegrationSettings 内置草稿与已保存状态比对、支持掩码切换的密钥编辑器、域名实时语法校验、可搜索时区浮层及强类型保存/回滚事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 Stripe 店铺标识、掩码密钥、主域名与时区的集成设置卡片。

props.name: with_provider
props.description: 指定通过 pro_app_tile 渲染的服务品牌图标（如 "stripe"、"slack"、"github"、"hubspot"）。

props.name: with_values
props.description: 注入初始启用状态、API 密钥、站点域名与时区。

props.name: with_time_zones
props.description: 自定义时区下拉搜索列表中的可选时区。

props.name: with_site_hint
props.description: 自定义域名格式合法时输入框下方的辅助说明文案。

motion: 关闭顶部主开关时通过 pro_fold 平滑收起配置区；任一字段产生未保存修改时通过 pro_presence 滑出放弃/保存底栏。
胶囊开关严格遵循 DESIGN.md 圆角规范，并在开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::integration_settings::IntegrationSettings 导入；执行 kui add integration-settings 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::integration_settings::IntegrationSettings 导入。
订阅 IntegrationSettingsEvent::Saved 事件即可获取通过校验的完整 IntegrationValues。

lead.en: Pick saved prompt templates with {variable} slots — type straight into the sentence, watch the finished prompt assemble live below, and send once complete.
lead.zh: 支持 {variable} 行内槽位的提示词模板库——直接在句中芯片内输入变量，下方实时预览组装结果与预计 Token 数，填满后一键使用。

rule.en: Switch or search templates on the left, type into inline {variable} chips (Enter jumps to the next empty slot), inspect the live Preview, and click Copy or Use prompt.
rule.zh: 在左侧搜索或切换模板，直接在句中 {variable} 芯片内输入（按 Enter 跳至下一个未填槽位），查看下方实时预览，完成后点击复制或使用提示词。

when: AI workspaces, copilots, and chat sidebars where teams reuse structured prompts for release notes, summaries, debugging, and outreach.
Prompt pickers where fixed instructions frame 2–6 inline fill-in-the-blank variables.
not: Open-ended freeform writing with no repeating structure—use a plain chat composer.
Complex schemas with 10+ fields where a labeled vertical form is clearer than a sentence.
en.apiLead: PromptLibrary parses {variable} tokens into live per-slot Editors, retains typed values per template across switches, estimates token counts, and gates Use prompt on completion.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a prompt library seeded with Product, Notes, Debug, and Sales templates.

props.name: with_templates
props.description: Provide custom templates with {variable} placeholders and optional default values.

props.name: with_default_template
props.description: Choose which template opens initially on mount.

props.name: with_use_label
props.description: Customize the primary submit button label.

props.name: with_title
props.description: Set the heading displayed above the template list.

motion: Template selection glides via pro_pill_indicator while the sentence editor crossfades via pro_view_transition; edited variables flash softly in both the sentence and preview while token counts roll via pro_rolling_number.
Below 540px the sidebar stacks cleanly on top; Theme::reduced_motion disables transitions and flashes.
ai: Import from kui::components::prompt_library::PromptLibrary (library) or crate::ui::components::prompt_library::PromptLibrary after running kui add prompt-library.
Repeated {name} tokens in the same body synchronize automatically into one shared variable value.

when: AI 助手、研发 Copilot 与对话侧边栏中复用发布说明、会议纪要、报错解析与商务邮件等结构化提示词。
固定句式搭配 2–6 个行内填空变量的团队共享提示词库。
not: 无固定结构的自由对话输入场景。
超过 10 个复杂参数的配置场景（建议使用带标签的纵向表单）。
zh.apiLead: PromptLibrary 自动解析句中 {variable} 占位符并挂载行内编辑器，按模板独立记忆已填内容，实时估算 Token 数并在填满后解锁发送。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置产品、纪要、调试与商务四类模板的提示词模板库。

props.name: with_templates
props.description: 传入包含 {variable} 语法与默认值配置的自定义模板集合。

props.name: with_default_template
props.description: 设置初始选中的模板 ID。

props.name: with_use_label
props.description: 自定义右下角主操作按钮文案。

props.name: with_title
props.description: 自定义模板列表顶部的标题文案。

motion: 切换模板时左侧高亮胶囊通过 pro_pill_indicator 平滑滑动，右侧编辑区通过 pro_view_transition 微移淡入；输入时句中芯片与预览同步柔光高亮，Token 预估值通过 pro_rolling_number 滚动。
宽度低于 540px 时模板列表自动置于编辑区上方；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::prompt_library::PromptLibrary 导入；执行 kui add prompt-library 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::prompt_library::PromptLibrary 导入。
同一模板内重复出现的同名 {variable} 会自动双向同步为同一个变量值。

lead.en: Guide onboarding and workspace setup step by step — self-drawing check marks, directional slides, smooth height morphing, inline validation, and a celebratory finish.
lead.zh: 面向注册引导与初始化配置的多步向导卡——支持进度条填充与对勾自绘、方向性横滑、高度平滑过渡、行内校验抖动及完成庆贺态。

rule.en: Name the workspace (or clear it to test inline validation), add email chips with Enter/comma, switch plan cards with clicks or arrow keys, jump back via Edit, and Create or Reset.
rule.zh: 填写工作区名称自动生成访问路径（清空点击下一步可体验校验提示），输入邮箱回车生成标签，选择方案并在确认页支持一键跳回修改、完成创建与重置。

when: Workspace creation, project onboarding, and multi-stage provisioning flows where a single long form feels overwhelming.
Guided wizards ending in a review summary with jump-back Edit actions before committing.
not: Short two-field dialogs where a single form submits faster.
Non-linear preference pages where users jump freely in any order—use tabs or IntegrationSettings instead.
en.apiLead: StepperForm coordinates step validation, auto-slugified inputs, email tag chips, gliding plan cards, review summaries, and completion/reset lifecycle events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 4-step Workspace, Team, Plan, and Review onboarding wizard.

props.name: with_values
props.description: Pre-seed workspace name, slug, email invites, and selected plan.

props.name: with_initial_step
props.description: Open the wizard on a specific zero-based step index.

props.name: with_plans
props.description: Customize selectable plan cards on the Plan step.

props.name: with_submit_label
props.description: Customize the primary button label on the final review step.

motion: Finished steps draw stroke check marks progressively, panes slide horizontally in the travel direction via pro_step_transition while the viewport morphs height via Slide, and plan rings glide via pro_pill_indicator.
Invalid fields shake once and fold open error messages via pro_fold; Theme::reduced_motion disables animations cleanly.
ai: Import from kui::components::stepper_form::StepperForm (library) or crate::ui::components::stepper_form::StepperForm after running kui add stepper-form.
Subscribe to StepperFormEvent::Completed to receive the final validated StepperValues.

when: 工作区创建、新用户开通引导及多步资源编排向导，避免一次性展示过长表单。
需要在最终提交前提供汇总核对并支持点击“修改”跳回前序步骤的流程。
not: 仅包含两三个输入框的轻量表单。
允许任意无序跳转的常规设置面板。
zh.apiLead: StepperForm 统一管理分步校验、名称转 URL 别名、成员邮箱芯片、方案单选环、汇总复核与完成重置事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含工作区、团队、方案与确认四步流程的分步引导卡片。

props.name: with_values
props.description: 预置初始工作区名称、路径别名、邀请邮箱列表与订阅方案。

props.name: with_initial_step
props.description: 指定初始展示的步骤索引。

props.name: with_plans
props.default: 基础版 / 专业版 / 企业版
props.description: 自定义方案选择步中的可选套餐卡片。

props.name: with_submit_label
props.description: 自定义最后一步确认提交按钮的文案。

motion: 已完成步骤渐进绘制对勾并填充顶部进度条，前进/后退通过 pro_step_transition 按方向微滑并由 Slide 弹簧平滑过渡面板高度，方案选中框通过 pro_pill_indicator 滑动。
校验失败时输入框触发短促微震并通过 pro_fold 展开错误提示；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::stepper_form::StepperForm 导入；执行 kui add stepper-form 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::stepper_form::StepperForm 导入。
订阅 StepperFormEvent::Completed 事件即可获取最终校验通过的 StepperValues。

lead.en: Drop files in and watch them upload — fanning document sheets, colored type badges, smooth progress with time left, and errors with retry.
lead.zh: 支持多文件投递与进度追踪的拟物上传区——扇形展开纸张插画、彩色文件类型徽标、剩余时间预估及失败一键重试。

rule.en: Hover or preview-drag to fan out the document stack, click the dropzone or +PDF/+CSV/+PNG/+JSON chips to enqueue files, click Retry on failed rows, or remove and clear items.
rule.zh: 悬停或开启拖拽预览可扇形展开顶部文档卡片，点击上传区或 +PDF/+CSV/+PNG/+JSON 标签添加文件，支持单行失败重试、移除与清空。

when: Uploading documents, datasets, screenshots, and JSON manifests in knowledge bases, import wizards, and workspace attachments.
Multi-file upload flows where users track active progress, remaining seconds, completed items, and recoverable network failures.
not: Single avatar or company logo pickers where a compact thumbnail button is lighter.
Multi-gigabyte background sync daemons that belong in a persistent transfer drawer.
en.apiLead: Dropzone manages extension and byte-limit validation, Slide-driven sheet fanning, per-file progress springs, error shake feedback, and typed queue events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a dropzone seeded with PDF, CSV, PNG, and JSON upload rows.

props.name: with_accept
props.description: Restrict allowed extensions; non-matching files show an immediate error row.

props.name: with_max_size
props.description: Reject files exceeding max_size_bytes with a clear size-limit message.

props.name: with_hint
props.description: Override the accepted-formats and size-limit subtitle under the main prompt.

props.name: with_autoplay
props.description: Enable or pause automatic simulated upload progression on mount.

motion: Hovering or dragging fans the left PDF and right PNG sheets apart via Slide while lifting the center upload card; progress bars glide with pro_spring_f32 and footer counts shimmer via pro_shimmer_text.
Failed transfers emit a brief damped horizontal shake; Theme::reduced_motion disables animations and settles states immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::dropzone::Dropzone (library) or crate::ui::components::dropzone::Dropzone after running kui add dropzone.
Subscribe to DropzoneEvent::Changed to read completed UploadItem entries (`item.is_done()`).

when: 在知识库导入、数据表上传、工单附件与引导向导中上传文档、表格、图片与 JSON 配置。
同时上传多个文件并需直观区分已完成、传输中（含剩余时间）与失败可重试状态的场景。
not: 单个头像或品牌图标裁剪选择场景。
持续数十分钟的超大型后台同步队列。
zh.apiLead: Dropzone 内置后缀与文件体积校验、Slide 弹簧驱动的三联文档扇形展开、平滑进度条、失败抖动提示及强类型队列事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 PDF、CSV、PNG 与 JSON 四类示例队列的拖拽上传组件。

props.name: with_accept
props.description: 限定允许的文件扩展名，不匹配的文件自动进入错误提示行。

props.name: with_max_size
props.description: 设置单文件最大字节数，超出上限时显示体积超限原因。

props.name: with_hint
props.description: 自定义主标题下方的格式与大小限制说明文案。

props.name: with_autoplay
props.description: 控制挂载后是否自动推进模拟上传进度。

motion: 指针悬停或拖拽预览时通过 Slide 弹簧将左右 PDF/PNG 文档卡向外扇形展开并抬升中间上传卡，进度条通过 pro_spring_f32 平滑推进，底栏上传计数带流光扫掠。
失败行触发短促水平阻尼微震；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::dropzone::Dropzone 导入；执行 kui add dropzone 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::dropzone::Dropzone 导入。
订阅 DropzoneEvent::Changed 即可筛选已完成（`item.is_done()`）的文件列表。

lead.en: Slice and stack records interactively — Measure, Slice, and Segment pickers, spring-animated bars, hover tooltips, and a linked breakdown table.
lead.zh: 支持指标、横轴分组与堆叠维度自由切换的柱状拆分图——弹簧堆叠柱、悬停明细浮层及与柱图双向联动高亮的明细表。

rule.en: Switch Measure, Slice, or Segment pickers to re-stack bars, hover bars for breakdown tooltips, hover table rows or legend chips to highlight segments across all bars, and click chips to filter.
rule.zh: 切换统计指标、横轴分组或堆叠维度实时重排柱图，悬停柱体查看分项浮层，悬停下方表格行或图例胶囊跨柱高亮对应分段，点击图例可显隐过滤。

when: Sprint boards, support queues, and revenue ops reports showing how records split by status, priority, team, or region.
Self-serve analytics cards where readers pivot Measure, Slice, and Segment without leaving the page.
not: Continuous time-series trends—use KpiBoardBlock or trend charts instead.
High-cardinality dimensions with dozens of slices or segments.
en.apiLead: BreakdownChart aggregates flat BreakdownRecord items across arbitrary dimensions and measures, drives per-segment bar springs, and links hover/filter states with its breakdown table.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a BreakdownChart preloaded with the 212-task Sprint 24 Status × Priority × Team dataset.

props.name: with_records
props.description: Supply flat records with categorical fields and numeric metric values.

props.name: with_dimensions / with_measures
props.description: Define selectable slicing/stacking dimensions and count/sum measures.

props.name: with_default_slice / with_default_segment
props.description: Choose initial x-axis grouping and stack dimension (or "none").

props.name: with_table_mode
props.description: Display table rows grouped BySegment or BySlice.

motion: Re-slicing, changing measures, or toggling legend chips animates every stacked bar height smoothly via pro_spring_f32 while rolling headline totals via pro_rolling_number.
Table view pills glide via pro_pill_indicator and picker popovers enter via pro_presence; Theme::reduced_motion disables movement.
ai: Import from kui::components::breakdown_chart::BreakdownChart (library) or crate::ui::components::breakdown_chart::BreakdownChart after running kui add breakdown-chart.
Pass "none" to set_segment or with_default_segment to render unstacked single-series bars.

when: 研发迭代看板、工单队列与经营报表中按状态、优先级、团队或区域展示记录构成。
允许阅读者在卡片内自主切换指标、横轴维度与堆叠维度的交互式报表。
not: 连续时间序列趋势对比（请使用 KpiBoardBlock）。
包含数十个枚举值的超高基数维度。
zh.apiLead: BreakdownChart 对扁平 BreakdownRecord 实时多维聚合，驱动堆叠分段弹簧高度，并将图表悬停及图例过滤状态与下方数据表双向联动。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 212 条 Sprint 24 状态×优先级×团队数据集的多维堆叠拆分图。

props.name: with_records
props.description: 注入包含维度字段与数值指标的扁平记录列表。

props.name: with_dimensions / with_measures
props.description: 配置可选分组/堆叠维度以及计数或求和指标。

props.name: with_default_slice / with_default_segment
props.description: 指定初始横轴分组维度与堆叠维度（传 "none" 则取消堆叠）。

props.name: with_table_mode
props.description: 选择按拆分项（BySegment）或按横轴分组（BySlice）排列下方联动表。

motion: 切换维度、指标或显隐图例时通过 pro_spring_f32 平滑缩放每个堆叠分段高度，并通过 pro_rolling_number 滚动顶部汇总数字。
表格视图胶囊通过 pro_pill_indicator 滑动，选择器菜单通过 pro_presence 展开；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::breakdown_chart::BreakdownChart 导入；执行 kui add breakdown-chart 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::breakdown_chart::BreakdownChart 导入。
向 set_segment 或 with_default_segment 传入 "none" 即可切换为单色非堆叠柱状图。

lead.en: Split a total into ranked parts in one compact card — numbers roll, the proportion bar glides, and rows smoothly trade places when periods change.
lead.zh: 在紧凑卡片内将核心指标拆分为排序分项——切换周期时数值滚动、多段占比条平滑伸缩、各分项行按新名次上下换位。

rule.en: Switch 7d, 30d, and 90d (or use Left/Right keys) to watch channels trade ranks, and hover any row or bar segment to roll the big headline to that part's figure.
rule.zh: 点击 7d、30d、90d（或按左右方向键）观察各渠道按名次平滑换位，悬停任一行或占比段即可将大字号总额滚动为该分项数值。

when: Dashboard side-cards showing revenue by channel, tokens by model, usage by feature, or tickets by category.
Period-switching summaries where seeing which ranked item moved up or down matters at a glance.
not: Multi-dimensional pivot tables with separate Slice and Segment pickers—use BreakdownChart instead.
Long lists exceeding 7–8 items without grouping tail entries into "Other".
en.apiLead: CompactBreakdown preserves canonical part identities across periods so segment widths, rolling numbers, and vertical rank offsets animate cohesively.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a compact breakdown preloaded with 7d, 30d, and 90d channel revenue datasets.

props.name: with_default_period
props.description: Set the initial active period key on mount.

props.name: with_datasets
props.description: Provide custom period pills, parts, and period-over-period percentage deltas.

props.name: with_number_format
props.description: Configure currency or unit affixes and decimal precision for rolling readouts.

props.name: with_footer
props.description: Show or hide the bottom "Largest: <part>" summary bar.

motion: Period pills glide with pro_pill_indicator, headline and row figures roll via pro_rolling_number, bar segments keep their canonical slot while gliding widths via Slide, and ranked rows trade vertical y-offsets via Slide.
Hovering a part lifts its bar segment and rolls the headline to its share; Theme::reduced_motion switches instantly.
ai: Import from kui::components::compact_breakdown::CompactBreakdown (library) or crate::ui::components::compact_breakdown::CompactBreakdown after running kui add compact-breakdown.
Keep CompactPart::id stable across periods so rows slide to their new rank instead of snapping.

when: 仪表盘侧栏卡片展示渠道收入、模型 Token 消耗、功能模块活跃度或工单分类占比。
切换时间周期时需要直观呈现排名升降变化的紧凑总览卡片。
not: 需要同时切换指标、横轴分组与堆叠维度的复杂透视分析（请使用 BreakdownChart）。
超过 8 个以上未归并“其他”项的长列表。
zh.apiLead: CompactBreakdown 跨周期保持分项 ID 稳定，使分段占比条宽度、滚动数字与垂直排名位移同步平滑过渡。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 7d、30d、90d 三档渠道收入数据集的紧凑占比拆分卡。

props.name: with_default_period
props.description: 设置挂载时默认选中的周期标识。

props.name: with_datasets
props.description: 注入自定义周期选项、分项列表及环比涨跌幅百分比。

props.name: with_number_format
props.description: 设置滚动数值的前缀、后缀与小数位数。

props.name: with_footer
props.description: 显示或隐藏底栏“最大占比”摘要提示。

motion: 周期胶囊通过 pro_pill_indicator 弹簧滑动，大字总额与行内金额通过 pro_rolling_number 滚动，占比条按固定槽位由 Slide 伸缩宽度，排序行按新名次由 Slide 平滑交换纵向位置。
悬停任一分项时抬升对应色段并将顶部大数滚动为该分项值；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::compact_breakdown::CompactBreakdown 导入；执行 kui add compact-breakdown 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::compact_breakdown::CompactBreakdown 导入。
跨周期保持相同的 CompactPart::id 即可自动启用行名次上下换位弹簧动画。

lead.en: Summarize an A/B test in two lines and unfold on hover—cross-linked miniature chart, rolling metric switcher, confidence readout, and one-click winner confirmation.
lead.zh: 以两行紧凑摘要呈现 A/B 实验并在悬停时柔和展开，联动迷你对比图、滚动指标切换器、置信度读数与一键确认胜出方案。

rule.en: Hover or click to unfold the card, switch Conversion / Revenue / Retention to roll figures and bars together, hover a variant to inspect visitors and confidence, and click to pick a winner.
rule.zh: 悬停或点击展开卡片，切换转化率/收入/留存率使数值与进度条同步过渡，悬停变体查看样本量与置信度，点击选中并确认胜出方案。

when: A/B tests, prompt or model evaluations, and pricing experiments comparing two to five variants across shared metrics.
Lists of running experiments where detailed statistical lift should be one hover away and actionable.
not: Experiments with more than five variants where a full DataTable communicates more clearly.
Day-by-day cumulative time series where TrendChart or KpiChart shows when a variant pulled ahead.
en.apiLead: ExperimentCard coordinates measured-height pro_fold disclosure, cross-highlighted PathBuilder bars, pro_pill_indicator metric switching, rolling lift calculations, and winner confirmation.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an ExperimentCard preloaded with the 3-variant Signup button copy experiment.

props.name: with_metrics
props.description: Configure the metrics switcher, numeric formatting, and lower_is_better semantics.

props.name: with_variants
props.description: Supply variants with keys, baseline control flag, visitor counts, metric values, and confidence percentages.

props.name: with_trigger
props.description: Choose Hover disclosure (with click/keyboard pin) or Click-only toggle.

props.name: with_action_prefix
props.description: Customize the confirmation CTA label shown in the footer tray once a variant is selected.

motion: The header stays anchored while pro_fold smoothly reveals the comparison body and footer tray.
Switching metrics slides pro_pill_indicator, rolls all figures via pro_rolling_number, and springs head and row bars via pro_spring_f32; Theme::reduced_motion disables motion.
ai: Import from kui::components::experiment_card::ExperimentCard (library) or crate::ui::components::experiment_card::ExperimentCard after running kui add experiment-card.
Percentage lifts are measured against the variant marked with_control(true) (or the first variant); lower_is_better colors negative deltas green.

when: A/B 测试、提示词或模型评测、定价实验等需要在统一指标下对比 2–5 个方案的场景。
运行中实验列表：悬停即可检视显著性与提升幅度，并直接选定上线胜出方案。
not: 超过五个分组的多维矩阵对比（建议使用 DataTable）。
需要观察某方案何时反超的逐日时间序列曲线（建议使用 TrendChart 或 KpiChart）。
zh.apiLead: ExperimentCard 协调 pro_fold 自适应高度展开、PathBuilder 迷你柱状联动、pro_pill_indicator 指标切换、滚动涨幅计算与胜出方案确认。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置三分组 Signup button copy 实验数据的卡片。

props.name: with_metrics
props.description: 配置指标切换项、数值前后缀精度及越低越优（lower_is_better）语义。

props.name: with_variants
props.description: 提供包含字母标识、对照组标记、访客量、各指标数值与统计置信度的分组列表。

props.name: with_trigger
props.description: 选择悬停即展开（同时支持点击锁定）或仅点击展开。

props.name: with_action_prefix
props.description: 自定义选中方案后底栏右侧确认按钮的前缀文案。

motion: 卡片头部保持原位，通过 pro_fold 弹簧平滑展开对比行与底栏托盘。
切换指标时滑块经 pro_pill_indicator 滑动，数字经 pro_rolling_number 同步翻滚，柱高与进度条经 pro_spring_f32 过渡；减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::experiment_card::ExperimentCard 导入；执行 kui add experiment-card 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::experiment_card::ExperimentCard 导入。
涨跌幅以标记了 with_control(true) 的对照组为基准；开启 lower_is_better 时下降百分比自动计作绿色正向领先。

lead.en: Pair a rolling headline figure and delta badge with a multi-series line or area chart, interactive legend toggles, and a pointer-following crosshair tooltip.
lead.zh: 将滚动标题数值与涨跌徽标结合多序列折线/面积图、可切换图例胶囊与跟随指针的悬浮提示框。

rule.en: Hover across the plot or press Left / Right to inspect daily channel values, toggle series pills in the footer legend to roll the headline total, and switch between Line and Area.
rule.zh: 悬停图表或按左右方向键逐日检视各渠道数值，点击底栏图例胶囊开关序列并联动滚动总额，右上角可切换折线或面积模式。

when: Dashboards presenting one headline KPI alongside how two to six channels, plans, or pages moved day by day.
Compact executive cards that benefit from interactive series isolation and daily hover inspection.
not: Plotting more than six overlapping series where a ranked table or ModelUsage breakdown reads more clearly.
Hundreds of high-frequency points requiring pan-and-zoom windowing.
en.apiLead: KpiChart renders monotone-clamped smooth PathBuilder curves, spring-animated Y-axis rescaling, legend toggles, rolling headline totals, and edge-flipping crosshair tooltips.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a KpiChart preloaded with the 5-channel Revenue ($96.4k, +$7.9k) dataset.

props.name: with_series
props.description: Provide multi-line series with ids, labels, stroke colors, and per-day values.

props.name: with_delta
props.description: Show a green positive or red negative change badge next to the rolling headline figure.

props.name: with_style
props.description: Render crisp strokes (Line) or strokes with soft vertical gradient fills (Area).

props.name: with_default_index
props.description: Keep a chosen day's crosshair and tooltip open while the pointer is outside the plot.

motion: Series draw in from left to right on mount, while toggling legend pills springs series opacity and Y-axis scale via pro_spring_f32 and rolls the headline via pro_rolling_number.
Crosshair guides and ringed series dots glide between points and flip tooltip side automatically; Theme::reduced_motion snaps all changes.
ai: Import from kui::components::kpi_chart::KpiChart (library) or crate::ui::components::kpi_chart::KpiChart after running kui add kpi-chart.
At least one series always remains active when clicking legend pills so the axis and headline remain meaningful.

when: 在一个核心汇总指标下同时展示 2–6 个渠道、套餐或页面逐日走势的仪表盘卡片。
支持点击图例单独隔离序列并逐日悬停对比数值的紧凑分析卡片。
not: 超过六条高度重叠的曲线场景（建议使用排行榜或 ModelUsage 堆叠拆分）。
需要框选缩放的数百点高频监控时序。
zh.apiLead: KpiChart 基于 PathBuilder 绘制保单调平滑曲线，联动弹簧纵轴缩放、图例显隐切换、滚动总额与自动防裁切十字准星浮层。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置五渠道 Revenue（$96.4k，+$7.9k）数据的 KPI 图表卡。

props.name: with_series
props.description: 传入包含唯一 ID、名称、颜色与逐日数值的多条序列。

props.name: with_delta
props.description: 在主数值旁显示正向绿色或负向红色的环比增量徽标。

props.name: with_style
props.description: 选择纯折线（Line）或带柔和渐变面积填充（Area）的绘制样式。

props.name: with_default_index
props.description: 设置指针未悬停时默认高亮展示的数据点索引。

motion: 首次挂载时曲线自左向右平滑绘出；切换底栏图例时通过 pro_spring_f32 过渡序列透明度与纵轴刻度，并通过 pro_rolling_number 翻滚总额。
纵向准星与圆环数据点在相邻日期间轻快滑动，提示浮层自动左右翻转防溢出；减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::kpi_chart::KpiChart 导入；执行 kui add kpi-chart 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::kpi_chart::KpiChart 导入。
底栏图例至少保留一条激活序列，避免全部关闭导致坐标轴失焦。

lead.en: Visualize daily metered usage as blue-to-lilac gradient bars with a live growing bar for Today, a Real-time dot badge, per-day tool breakdowns, and rolling totals.
lead.zh: 以蓝至紫丁香柔和渐变柱呈现每日计量用量，配齐持续增长的今日实时柱、实时脉冲徽标、按日工具占比浮层与滚动汇总。

rule.en: Hover daily bars or press Left / Right / Home / End to inspect counts and whole-percentage tool shares, and trigger live bursts to grow Today's bar and roll period totals.
rule.zh: 悬停每日柱条或按方向键、Home/End 查看当日用量与整百工具占比，触发实时流量可观察今日柱生长并同步滚动总额。

when: Usage-based billing and metering cards for API calls, tokens, events, or compute minutes per day.
Dashboards where today's usage is still counting and hovering a day reveals its per-tool or per-model composition.
not: Comparing two overlapping series or period-over-period curves—use TrendChart instead.
Hundreds of ungrouped daily bars where weekly aggregation reads more cleanly.
en.apiLead: MeteringChart paints horizontal-to-vertical gradient bars, a live pulsing Today bar with Slide growth, largest-remainder 100% breakdown tags, and pro_rolling_number totals.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a MeteringChart preloaded with 21 days (Sep 1 – Sep 21) of API calls and per-tool breakdowns.

props.name: with_data
props.description: Supply daily counts (oldest first) and optional per-tool MeteringBreakdownPart lists.

props.name: with_totals
props.description: Configure rolling summary figures displayed directly under the card title.

props.name: with_live
props.description: Style the rightmost bar as Today with accent indigo fill, upward sheen, and Real-time badge.

props.name: with_breakdown_limit
props.description: Number of individual breakdown rows shown before folding smaller shares into Other.

motion: Historical bars rise left-to-right in an eased wave on mount while heights and the Y-axis ceiling spring via pro_spring_f32.
Today's live bar carries a gentle upward highlight sheen and live pulse dot; Theme::reduced_motion disables wave staggering, pulses, and sheen.
ai: Import from kui::components::metering_chart::MeteringChart (library) or crate::ui::components::metering_chart::MeteringChart after running kui add metering-chart.
Breakdown shares use largest-remainder rounding so whole percentages always sum to 100%.

when: 按量计费与资源计量场景：逐日展示 API 调用量、Token 消耗、事件数或运行时长。
今日仍在实时累加，且需要悬停查看单日内各工具或模型构成占比的卡片。
not: 需要叠加本周期与上周期对比曲线的场景（请使用 TrendChart）。
跨度数百天未按周聚合的密集柱状序列。
zh.apiLead: MeteringChart 绘制蓝至紫丁香渐变柱条、带流光脉冲与弹簧增长的今日实时柱、严格凑整 100% 的工具占比浮层及滚动汇总指标。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 21 天（Sep 1 – Sep 21）API 调用与工具占比明细的实时计量图。

props.name: with_data
props.description: 按时间正序传入每日用量及可选的工具构成明细（MeteringBreakdownPart）。

props.name: with_totals
props.description: 配置标题下方同步滚动的总金额与总事件数。

props.name: with_live
props.description: 将最右侧柱条标记为持续增长的今日实时柱，并启用 Real-time 徽标。

props.name: with_breakdown_limit
props.description: 悬浮卡片中单独列出的前 N 项工具数量，其余自动折叠进 Other。

motion: 挂载时柱条自左向右呈波浪升起，高度与纵轴上限经 pro_spring_f32 弹簧平滑过渡。
今日实时柱带有柔和上行流光与脉冲圆点；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时关闭波浪延迟与流光动画。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::metering_chart::MeteringChart 导入；执行 kui add metering-chart 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::metering_chart::MeteringChart 导入。
构成明细采用最大余数法取整，确保浮层内的整数百分比之和严格等于 100%。

lead.en: Break down AI usage by provider and model—one stacked bar per company in its signature hue, Tokens / Cost / Requests switching, hover model shares, and dynamic task filtering.
lead.zh: 按 AI 厂商与子模型拆分用量：每家厂商一列主题色深浅堆叠柱，支持 Token/费用/请求数切换、悬停检视模型占比及底部任务过滤。

rule.en: Switch Tokens, Cost, and Requests to morph stacked model segments while preserving rank order, and hover or arrow-walk any provider bar to inspect its models and filter Search / Analyze / Code / Test below.
rule.zh: 切换 Token、费用与请求数可平滑重排各模型段高度且保持排序不变；悬停或按方向键选中任一厂商柱即可查看子模型占比并联动过滤下方四类任务。

when: AI billing and observability pages comparing Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and DeepSeek usage side by side across tokens, spend, and requests.
Teams inspecting both model-tier mix (Sonnet vs. Opus, GPT-5 vs. mini) and workload intent (Search, Analyze, Code, Test).
not: Day-by-day usage trajectories over time—pair with MeteringChart or KpiChart.
Single-plan quota gauges or remaining credit bars—use UsageMeter instead.
en.apiLead: ModelUsage renders surface-mixed stacked segments per provider, a pro_pill_indicator measure switcher, side-anchored model share popovers, and dynamic largest-remainder task breakdowns.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a ModelUsage card preloaded with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and DeepSeek models and task splits.

props.name: with_companies
props.description: Provide AI companies with brand marks, signature colors, and per-model UsageAmounts and task maps.

props.name: with_default_metric
props.description: Select the initial measure shown on mount (Tokens, Cost, or Requests).

props.name: with_previous
props.description: Supply prior-period totals to compute the green/red percentage change badge.

props.name: with_task_kinds
props.description: Configure the task categories and colors displayed below the provider axis.

motion: Provider stacks rise sequentially on first paint and spring both column heights and internal model-segment shares via pro_spring_f32 when switching measures.
Hovering a column dims siblings, opens its model breakdown beside the bar, and rolls task percentages via pro_rolling_number; Theme::reduced_motion snaps changes.
ai: Import from kui::components::model_usage::ModelUsage (library) or crate::ui::components::model_usage::ModelUsage after running kui add model-usage.
Model stacking order is locked to the first measure so segments keep consistent shades across Tokens, Cost, and Requests.

when: 多模型团队的用量与账单面板：并排对比 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 与 DeepSeek 的 Token、花费与请求量。
同时洞察厂商内部旗舰与轻量模型配比，以及搜索、分析、编码、测试四类任务去向。
not: 按天连续变化的趋势观察（请搭配 MeteringChart 或 KpiChart）。
套餐总额度与剩余配额进度条（请使用 UsageMeter）。
zh.apiLead: ModelUsage 绘制与卡片底色自然混色的多段模型堆叠柱、弹簧胶囊维度切换器、防遮挡侧边模型浮层及联动过滤的任务占比网格。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek 四大厂商及任务明细的模型用量卡。

props.name: with_companies
props.description: 传入包含品牌图标、主题色、子模型三维度用量与任务拆分的厂商列表。

props.name: with_default_metric
props.description: 设置初始展示维度：Tokens、Cost 或 Requests。

props.name: with_previous
props.description: 提供上一周期三维度汇总以计算顶部涨跌幅徽标。

props.name: with_task_kinds
props.description: 自定义底部双列网格展示的任务类别与主题色。

motion: 堆叠柱在挂载时依次升起，切换统计维度时柱高与子模型分段占比经 pro_spring_f32 平滑变形。
悬停厂商柱时柔和淡化其余列、弹出侧边模型卡片并滚动下方任务百分比；开启减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::model_usage::ModelUsage 导入；执行 kui add model-usage 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::model_usage::ModelUsage 导入。
子模型自下而上的深浅色序锁定为首个维度的排序，切换维度时色阶与位置保持一致。

lead.en: Draw lines, gradient areas, grouped bars, or compact sparklines from the same series data—complete with dashed previous-period overlays, hover tooltips, and synchronized multi-chart day scrubbing.
lead.zh: 基于同一组序列无缝切换折线、渐变面积、柱状或迷你火花线，内置上周期虚线对比、悬浮检视框与多图同日联动游标。

rule.en: Switch Line, Area, and Bar or toggle 7D / 30D on the primary card, and hover or press Left / Right on any chart to scrub the exact same day across all four linked charts at once.
rule.zh: 在主卡上切换折线/面积/柱状或 7D/30D 周期，悬停或按方向键在任意子图上滑动即可在全部四张图表间同步对齐同一天。

when: Embedding a clean borderless chart inside your own card, KPI tile, or multi-panel analytics layout.
Comparing current vs. previous periods (with_previous(true)) or linking several charts so they scrub the same date together.
not: Overlapping more than six series where a ranked table or ModelUsage stacked breakdown is easier to scan.
Part-of-whole compositions at a single point in time—use ModelUsage instead.
en.apiLead: TrendChart renders standalone borderless plots (TrendChart::standalone) as well as the synchronized 4-chart AI spend showcase (TrendChart::new), handling series resampling, None gaps, dashed comparison overlays, and synced indices.

props.name: standalone
props.description: Create an unframed TrendChart to place inside any card, tile, or table row.

props.name: with_variant
props.description: Draw the same TrendSeries data as Line, Area, Bar, or a 40px Sparkline.

props.name: with_series
props.description: Supply current and previous-period series (None values leave clean line gaps).

props.name: with_zero
props.description: Anchor the Y-axis at zero, or pass false to zoom tightly around rate/average series.

props.name: with_controlled_index
props.description: Synchronize the highlighted day across multiple standalone TrendChart entities.

motion: Curves draw in from the left and bars grow from the baseline on mount, while range switches resample and glide points smoothly across different lengths.
Crosshairs, ringed dots, and popovers/tags glide across days via pro_spring_f32; Theme::reduced_motion disables sweeps and glides.
ai: Import from kui::components::trend_chart::TrendChart (library) or crate::ui::components::trend_chart::TrendChart after running kui add trend-chart.
Mark baseline series with .with_previous(true) to render dashed strokes in Line/Area mode and faint companion columns in Bar mode.

when: 在自定义卡片、统计砖或看板布局中嵌入无外框纯净趋势图。
叠加本周期与上周期对比（with_previous(true)），或让一排多张图表同日联动检视。
not: 同时绘制六条以上密集交叉折线的场景。
单一时刻的构成占比拆分（请使用 ModelUsage）。
zh.apiLead: TrendChart 同时提供无边框独立图表（TrendChart::standalone）与四图同日联动的 AI 支出展台（TrendChart::new），原生支持跨长度序列重采样、断点留白与虚线同比。

props.name: standalone
props.description: 创建不带自带卡片外框的独立趋势图，便于嵌入任意容器。

props.name: with_variant
props.description: 将同一组数据切换绘制为折线（Line）、渐变面积（Area）、分组柱状（Bar）或 40px 火花线（Sparkline）。

props.name: with_series
props.description: 提供支持缺失值留白（Option<f64>）与上周期标记的多条序列。

props.name: with_zero
props.description: 纵轴默认从 0 起算；设为 false 时针对均值或费率自动聚焦数据区间。

props.name: with_controlled_index
props.description: 由外部统一受控高亮索引，使多张独立 TrendChart 跨卡同步游标。

motion: 挂载时曲线自左向右绘出、柱条自零线生长；切换不同天数周期时自动重采样平滑变形。
纵向准星、光环圆点与悬浮标签经 pro_spring_f32 顺滑跟随；开启减少动效时即时落位。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::trend_chart::TrendChart 导入；执行 kui add trend-chart 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::trend_chart::TrendChart 导入。
为对比序列调用 .with_previous(true)，即可在折线/面积模式下自动渲染虚线并在柱状模式下渲染半透明伴随柱。

lead.en: Select single cells and rectangular ranges, edit values and tag pills in place, copy and paste TSV, undo or redo changes, and sort columns.
lead.zh: 支持单元格与矩形选区拖拽、就地编辑与标签选择、TSV 跨表复制粘贴、多步撤销重做及表头排序。

rule.en: Click and drag or use Shift+Arrow to select cell ranges, double-click or type to edit in place, press Cmd+C / Cmd+V for spreadsheet TSV copy-paste, and Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z to undo or redo.
rule.zh: 点击拖拽或按 Shift+方向键框选单元格区域，双击或直接输入原地编辑，按 Cmd+C / Cmd+V 进行电子表格 TSV 复制粘贴，按 Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z 撤销或重做。

when: Small-to-medium workspace tables for tools, vendors, budgets, and contacts that people edit directly in place.
Structured records moving back and forth between Excel or Google Sheets via tab-separated copy and paste.
not: Datasets with tens of thousands of virtualized rows—use DataGrid for virtual row scrolling and per-column filters.
Editing a single record with dozens of nested fields where a dedicated form is clearer.
en.apiLead: DataTable manages rectangular range selection, inline Editor and tag-picker sessions, TSV clipboard serialization, bounded undo/redo snapshots, row checkboxes, and column sorting.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an editable DataTable preloaded with the 5-row Design Stack dataset.

props.name: with_columns
props.description: Configure column keys, headers, icons, fixed widths, types (Title, Tag, Link, Number, Text), and tag options.

props.name: with_rows
props.description: Populate initial rows with stable ids, optional brand logos, and keyed cell values.

props.name: with_tag_tones
props.description: Assign Blue, Violet, Pink, Green, Amber, or Gray tones to tag text values.

props.name: with_editable
props.description: Keep range selection, sorting, and TSV copy while disabling edits, paste, clear, and row add/delete.

motion: Active cells and multi-cell ranges render crisp inset focus rings and perimeter borders, while checked rows morph the footer into bulk actions.
Theme::reduced_motion disables loading shimmer pulses and settles overlays immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::data_table::DataTable (library) or crate::ui::components::data_table::DataTable after running kui add data-table.
Numeric columns automatically group digits with commas and render negative numbers with a typographic minus sign (−4,200).

when: 工具清单、供应商台账、预算明细与联系人等需要原地直接修改的中小型业务表格。
经常与 Excel 或 Google Sheets 通过制表符（TSV）双向复制粘贴的结构化表格。
not: 数万行以上的超大虚拟滚动数据集（请使用带虚拟列表与列筛选器的 DataGrid）。
针对单条复杂记录的多字段录入场景（使用表单更清晰）。
zh.apiLead: DataTable 内置矩形选区、行内文本与标签选择器编辑、TSV 剪贴板读写、多步撤销重做栈、行复选框与列排序，并向宿主发送强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 5 行 Design Stack 示例数据的可编辑数据表。

props.name: with_columns
props.description: 定义列键名、标题、图标、列宽、列类型（Title、Tag、Link、Number、Text）及标签候选项。

props.name: with_rows
props.description: 传入包含稳定行 ID、可选品牌图标与各列取值的初始行集合。

props.name: with_tag_tones
props.description: 为不同标签文本映射蓝、紫、粉、绿、琥珀或中性灰色调。

props.name: with_editable
props.description: 设为 false 时保留框选、排序与复制能力，禁用编辑、粘贴、清空与增删行。

motion: 当前单元格与多格矩形选区呈现高对比内嵌焦点框与外框线，勾选行时底栏自动切换为批量操作工具条。
开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时关闭骨架屏脉冲并即时呈现弹层。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::data_table::DataTable 导入；执行 kui add data-table 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::data_table::DataTable 导入。
Number 类型列会自动添加千分位分隔符，并将负号格式化为排版减号（−4,200）。

lead.en: Unfold a quiet two-line project summary on hover—linking a segmented multi-arc progress ring, teammate avatar filters, subtasks, and an inline status picker.
lead.zh: 双行紧凑项目摘要卡片，悬停或点击安静展开——将分段子任务进度环、成员头像筛选器、子任务清单与行内状态选择器联动呈现。

rule.en: Hover or press Enter/Space to unfold, hover or click teammate avatars to spotlight their subtasks and ring arcs, click the status badge to switch On track / At risk / Off track / Completed, and press Esc to fold.
rule.zh: 悬停或按 Enter/空格展开卡片，悬停或点击成员头像聚光其名下子任务与圆弧分段，点击状态标签切换进展正常/存在风险/进度滞后/已完成，按 Esc 逐层收起。

when: Kanban boards, sidebar trackers, and sprint summaries where many projects sit side by side and subtask details should be one hover away.
Initiatives, deals, or agent runs where a compact status + ring summary hides 3–10 actionable subtasks.
not: Multi-tab project editors with long descriptions and comment threads—open a dedicated drawer or page instead.
Projects with more than 12 subtasks where individual ring segments become too small to point at.
en.apiLead: ProjectCard cross-links its multi-arc PathBuilder progress ring, pro_person_avatar filters, inline ProjectStatus picker, and animated subtask checkboxes while emitting typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a ProjectCard ("Onboarding flow", 5 subtasks across Mara, Jonas, and Priya, On track).

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: Supply subtasks; each renders one arc segment in the 32px ring and one checklist row.

props.name: with_status
props.description: Set the initial status badge (OnTrack, AtRisk, OffTrack, Completed).

props.name: with_members
props.description: Set overlapping header avatars matched against ProjectSubtask::assignee.

props.name: with_trigger
props.description: Choose Hover unfold or explicit Click/Keyboard toggle.

props.name: with_default_open
props.description: Start with the subtask list and footer tray expanded.

motion: The two-line header stays anchored while pro_fold smoothly unfolds the status strip, subtasks, and footer tray without shifting the card's top edge.
Hovering a subtask or ring segment springs its arc stroke from 3px to 4.25px and reveals the assignee avatar; hovering a teammate softly dims unrelated segments and rows.
ai: Import from kui::components::project_card::ProjectCard (library) or crate::ui::components::project_card::ProjectCard after running kui add project-card.
Ensure ProjectSubtask::assignee matches a name in with_members so avatar hover filtering cross-links cleanly.

when: 看板列、侧边栏概览或迭代面板中并排陈列多个项目，希望一悬停即可速览并勾选子任务。
适合拥有 3–10 个明确子步骤的项目、商机或智能体执行单。
not: 包含长篇文档、表单与评论流的重型项目详情——请打开独立抽屉或详情页。
子任务超过 12 项的场景（圆环单段过短不易指向，建议先按阶段归组）。
zh.apiLead: ProjectCard 将 PathBuilder 多段圆环、pro_person_avatar 成员筛选、行内状态选择器与渐进对勾子任务列表双向联动，并通过强类型事件通知宿主。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认项目卡片（「新用户引导改版」，含 5 项子任务与 3 位协作成员）。

props.name: with_tasks
props.default: 5 项子任务（已完成 3 项）
props.description: 设置子任务列表，每项对应 32px 进度环中的一段圆弧与一行复选框。

props.name: with_status
props.description: 设置初始项目状态（进展正常、存在风险、进度滞后、已完成）。

props.name: with_members
props.description: 设置顶栏叠放的协作成员头像列表。

props.name: with_trigger
props.description: 选择指针悬停自动展开（Hover）或仅点击/键盘展开（Click）。

props.name: with_default_open
props.description: 设置初始挂载时是否默认展开子任务面板。

motion: 双行头部原地锚定，经 pro_fold 向下平滑展开状态栏、子任务清单与底栏操作区。
悬停子任务或圆环分段时圆弧线宽从 3px 弹性增粗至 4.25px 并滑入负责人头像；悬停成员头像时柔和压暗其余任务。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::project_card::ProjectCard 导入；执行 kui add project-card 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::project_card::ProjectCard 导入。
请保持 ProjectSubtask::assignee 与 with_members 中的成员姓名一致，以确保头像悬停筛选与圆弧联动生效。

lead.en: Present a rolling KPI figure with directional change badges (supporting lower-is-better latency and error rates), inline or stacked sparklines, and whole-card link or tab targets.
lead.zh: 展示滚动核心数值与正负向涨跌徽标（支持越低越优的延迟与错误率）、堆叠或并排迷你图，以及整卡点击/跳转模式。

rule.en: Toggle 7D and 30D to roll all four figures and resample sparklines together, click any card to spotlight or activate it, and scrub across sparklines or bars for daily tags.
rule.zh: 切换 7D 与 30D 同步翻滚四张卡片数值并变形迷你图，点击任一卡片进行聚光或跳转，悬停迷你折线或柱条读取单日数值。

when: Top-of-dashboard KPI rows tracking spend, token throughput, p95 latency, or error rates against the prior period.
Clickable summary tiles that either navigate to a detail view (with_href) or pick which metric drives a larger chart (with_selected).
not: Standalone charts needing full Y/X axes and multi-series tooltips—mount TrendChart in its own card.
Comparing dozens of structured records across columns—use DataTable instead.
en.apiLead: StatCard supports both a standalone single-tile API (StatCard::single) and the 2x2 Usage showcase (StatCard::new) with rolling numbers, lower_is_better delta badges, and resampling sparklines.

props.name: single
props.type: (impl Into<ElementId>, impl Into<SharedString>, f64, &mut Context<Self>) -> Self
props.description: Create a standalone single KPI card with a label and rolling numeric value.

props.name: with_change
props.description: Display a green/red directional triangle and percentage change next to a comparison label.

props.name: with_lower_is_better
props.description: Color decreases green and increases red for latency, churn, or error-rate metrics.

props.name: with_spark
props.description: Embed an Area, Line, or Bars mini-chart with interactive daily hover tags.

props.name: with_layout
props.description: Place the mini-chart Stacked below the figure or Inline (44% width) to its right.

motion: Values and percentage deltas roll via pro_rolling_number while sparklines resample smoothly across point counts via PhaseClock.
Spotlighting one card in a set dims sibling cards smoothly via pro_spring_f32; Theme::reduced_motion disables rolling and interpolation.
ai: Import from kui::components::stat_card::StatCard (library) or crate::ui::components::stat_card::StatCard after running kui add stat-card.
Use StatCard::new(id, cx) for the 4-card Usage grid showcase or StatCard::single(id, label, value, cx) for an individual KPI tile.

when: 仪表盘顶部核心指标行：展示花费、Token 吞吐量、平均延迟或错误率及其环比变化。
整卡可点击跳转详情页（with_href）或作为选项卡聚光切换主图指标（with_selected）。
not: 需要完整纵横坐标轴与多序列悬浮详情框的独立大图（请使用 TrendChart）。
多字段横向对比数十条记录的场景（请使用 DataTable）。
zh.apiLead: StatCard 同时提供独立单卡构造（StatCard::single）与 2×2 Usage 联动展台（StatCard::new），内置滚动数字、反向优劣涨跌徽标与重采样迷你图。

props.name: single
props.type: (impl Into<ElementId>, impl Into<SharedString>, f64, &mut Context<Self>) -> Self
props.description: 创建包含标题与滚动数值的独立单张 KPI 指标卡。

props.name: with_change
props.description: 显示带上下三角箭头的红绿涨跌百分比徽标与对比周期文案。

props.name: with_lower_is_better
props.description: 开启后将下降渲染为绿色正向、上升渲染为红色告警（适用于延迟、流失率、错误率）。

props.name: with_spark
props.description: 嵌入支持按日悬停标签的面积、折线或柱状迷你图。

props.name: with_layout
props.description: 将迷你图置于数值下方（Stacked）或右侧 44% 栏宽并排对齐（Inline）。

motion: 核心数值与涨跌百分比经 pro_rolling_number 翻滚，迷你图在不同周期点数间经 PhaseClock 重采样平滑过渡。
选中聚光单卡时其余卡片经 pro_spring_f32 柔和降暗；开启减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::stat_card::StatCard 导入；执行 kui add stat-card 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::stat_card::StatCard 导入。
调用 StatCard::new(id, cx) 呈现四卡联动展台；调用 StatCard::single(id, label, value, cx) 创建独立单张卡片。

lead.en: Guide new workspaces through grouped onboarding milestones with a spring progress bar, progressive check drawing, smooth strikethroughs, and per-step actions.
lead.zh: 提供带弹簧进度条、完成计数、分组折叠面板、渐进式对勾绘制、平滑删除线与单步快捷按钮的悬浮初始化向导。

rule.en: Use Enter or Space to open/close task groups or check off steps, click step action buttons to run inline setup flows, and minimize the body into a compact header bar at any time.
rule.zh: 按 Enter 或空格展开/收起分组与勾选任务，点击右侧动作按钮执行对应配置，并可随时将面板收起为紧凑进度条。

when: Multi-stage workspace onboarding where setup steps are organized into 2–4 logical areas (workspace, integrations, verification).
Corner dashboard guides that users can minimize while working and reopen until all milestones are complete.
not: Linear wizards that block the rest of the application—use OnboardingScreen or Stepper instead.
Single three-item checklists that do not benefit from collapsible groups.
en.apiLead: SetupGuide owns the spring progress bar, group disclosure folds, progressive PathBuilder check-stroke drawing, animated strikethrough bars, and per-step CTA events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a SetupGuide with 3 groups and 7 onboarding tasks (3 of 7 completed initially).

props.name: with_groups
props.description: Supply custom onboarding groups, task labels, action buttons, and initial done flags.

props.name: with_title
props.description: Override the heading shown above the overall progress bar.

props.name: with_minimized
props.description: Start with the task groups folded into a compact progress header.

props.name: with_edit_button
props.description: Show or hide the Edit action in the top-right header.

motion: Checking a task springs a filled accent disc, progressively strokes the two-segment check mark via PathBuilder, and sweeps a 1px strikethrough across the label.
Completing the final task in a group strikes through the group heading, folds that group closed via pro_fold, and opens the next incomplete group; Theme::reduced_motion snaps immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::setup_guide::SetupGuide (library) or crate::ui::components::setup_guide::SetupGuide after running kui add setup-guide.
Persist completed_ids from SetupGuideEvent::TaskToggled so onboarding progress survives reloads.

when: 按工作区信息、工具接入、域名验证等阶段划分的多分组新用户初始化清单。
悬浮在控制台角落、支持随时折叠收起并稍后继续完成的渐进式引导面板。
not: 需要阻断主界面逐步填写的全屏注册向导——请改用 OnboardingScreen 或 Stepper。
无需分组折叠的两三条简单待办项。
zh.apiLead: SetupGuide 内置弹簧进度条、分组平滑折叠、PathBuilder 渐进对勾笔画、标题平滑删除线及单步动作按钮，并通过强类型事件同步进度。

props.name: new
props.description: 使用 3 个分组共 7 项任务（默认已完成 3 / 7 项）创建初始化向导。

props.name: with_groups
props.description: 自定义分组标题、任务文案、右侧动作按钮及初始完成状态。

props.name: with_title
props.description: 自定义进度条上方的主标题文案。

props.name: with_minimized
props.description: 设置初始状态下是否折叠任务列表主体。

props.name: with_edit_button
props.description: 显示或隐藏顶栏右侧的「编辑」按钮。

motion: 勾选任务时弹簧填充主色圆盘，经 PathBuilder 逐段勾勒白色对勾，并从左至右平滑划过 1px 删除线。
当某一分组内任务全部完成时，组标题同步划上删除线并自动收起，同时平滑展开下一未完成分组；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时立即完成状态切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::setup_guide::SetupGuide 导入；执行 kui add setup-guide 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::setup_guide::SetupGuide 导入。
监听 SetupGuideEvent::TaskToggled 中的 completed_ids 即可持久化保存用户的初始化完成进度。

lead.en: Stack calm notifications that fan out on hover, morph Promise spinners into check marks in place, pause timers while read, and swipe away cleanly.
lead.zh: 提供悬停纵向扇形展开、异步加载圆弧原地演变为完成对勾、悬停暂停倒计时及拖拽滑动关闭的安静通知栈。

rule.en: Hover the stack or press F8 to fan cards out and pause auto-dismiss, press Esc to close the newest toast, click Undo to reverse destructive actions, or drag horizontally to swipe-dismiss.
rule.zh: 悬停通知栈或按 F8 展开卡片并暂停自动消失，按 Esc 关闭最新通知，点击「撤销」恢复操作，或横向拖拽滑动关闭。

when: Brief confirmations after user actions—draft saved, link copied, file moved to trash with an inline Undo button.
Background uploads, exports, and syncs where a Promise toast morphs from Saving… into Saved without spawning a second card.
not: Inline form validation errors—render field errors directly beside the offending input.
Blocking confirmations that require an explicit user choice before continuing—use ConfirmPopover or Dialog.
en.apiLead: Toaster manages a bounded notification queue, per-card Slide top/scale fan-out springs, hover-paused countdown hairlines, Promise arc-to-check morphing, and pointer swipe physics.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a Toaster with interactive preset triggers (Default, Success, Action/Undo, Error, Promise) and 3 stacked toasts.

props.name: push_toast
props.description: Push a Default, Success, Action, Error, or Promise notification to the front of the stack.

props.name: with_visible_toasts
props.description: Maximum toasts visible at once while older items wait with paused timers.

props.name: with_duration
props.description: Default on-screen lifetime in milliseconds for auto-dismissing notifications.

props.name: with_triggers
props.description: Show or hide the interactive Q3 Board Report trigger deck above the stack.

motion: Cards behind the front notification scale down and peek out cleanly, then fan out into a spaced vertical list via Slide springs when hovered or focused via F8.
Promise toasts close their spinning 28% arc into a full ring while progressively stroking a check mark via PathBuilder; short swipes spring back smoothly.
ai: Import from kui::components::toaster::Toaster (library) or crate::ui::components::toaster::Toaster after running kui add toaster.
Prefer ToastItem::with_promise_resolution for async saves and uploads instead of pushing separate loading and completion toasts.

when: 用户完成操作后的轻量级确认反馈——如草稿已保存、链接已复制、移入废纸篓并附带行内「撤销」按钮。
后台上传、导出与云端同步任务，通过 Promise 通知从「保存中…」原地演变为「已保存」。
not: 表单字段校验错误——请直接在对应输入框下方就近提示。
必须由用户明确决策后才能继续的阻断式确认——请改用 ConfirmPopover 或 Dialog。
zh.apiLead: Toaster 内置有界通知队列、单卡 Slide 弹簧扇形展开、悬停暂停倒计时细线、圆弧转对勾变形及指针横向拖拽关闭物理回弹。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含五类预设触发面板（默认、成功、撤销动作、异常、异步流转）与 3 张堆叠通知的提醒器。

props.name: push_toast
props.description: 向通知栈顶部推入新通知并返回唯一标识。

props.name: with_visible_toasts
props.description: 设置同时展示的最大堆叠张数，超出项暂停计时并在队列中等待。

props.name: with_duration
props.description: 设置自动消失通知的默认停留毫秒数。

props.name: with_triggers
props.description: 显示或隐藏上方的交互式触发演示面板。

motion: 后层卡片按比例微缩并露出底边层次，指针悬停或按 F8 时经 Slide 弹簧顺滑展开为等距纵向列表。
Promise 异步通知完成时，旋转中的 28% 圆弧平滑闭合为完整圆环并逐笔绘制完成对勾；未达阈值的短距离拖拽将弹性回位。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::toaster::Toaster 导入；执行 kui add toaster 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::toaster::Toaster 导入。
对于异步保存或上传流程，优先使用 ToastItem::with_promise_resolution 原地更新状态，避免弹出两条分离通知。

lead.en: Collaborate across human and AI threads with sliding filter tabs, runnable /edit slash commands, @mention pills, resolve transitions, and an inline composer.
lead.zh: 在文档或工作区侧栏协同讨论：支持滑动筛选标签、可执行的 /edit 斜杠修改指令、@提及胶囊、解决状态流转与回复输入器。

rule.en: Filter threads across Open, Resolved, and All, click Run edit on any /edit comment or reply to apply and undo changes, toggle checkmarks to resolve, and post @mentions or /edit replies.
rule.zh: 在待处理、已解决与全部之间切换筛选，点击任意评论或回复中的执行 /edit 按钮应用并可撤销修改，勾选右上角圆圈解决讨论。

when: Document, canvas, spec, or PR sidebars where teammates and AI assistants review sections and trigger inline /edit revisions.
Review feeds needing fast Open/Resolved triage, @mentions, and one-click slash-command execution.
not: Deeply nested forum discussions spanning dozens of indentation levels—use CommentThread for single long-form discussions.
en.apiLead: CommentsPanel manages Open/Resolved/All pill filtering, sort order, runnable /edit states across comments and replies, @mention tokenization, and an inline Editor.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a CommentsPanel preloaded with human and Kense AI threads, @mentions, and runnable /edit commands.

props.name: with_comments
props.description: Supply custom comment threads with section anchors and nested replies.

props.name: with_current_user
props.description: Set the author name and avatar initials used for newly submitted comments and replies.

props.name: with_filter
props.description: Choose the initial filter tab (Open, Resolved, or All).

props.name: with_title
props.description: Override the panel heading text.

motion: Filter selection glides via pro_pill_indicator, running /edit actions sweep with pro_shimmer_text before settling into Edit applied, and feed switches animate via pro_view_transition.
Replying unfolds a target bar above the Editor via pro_fold; Theme::reduced_motion completes /edit runs and filter changes without delay.
ai: Import from kui::components::comments_panel::CommentsPanel (library) or crate::ui::components::comments_panel::CommentsPanel after running kui add comments-panel.
Any comment or reply starting with /edit automatically renders a command pill and a Run edit / Undo lifecycle.

when: 文档、设计稿、需求规格或 PR 侧边评审栏，团队成员与 AI 助手可针对锚点段落讨论并直接执行 /edit 修改指令。
需要快速筛选待处理/已解决评论、插入 @提及 并一键运行斜杠编辑的工作流。
not: 拥有数十层深度嵌套的长篇论坛帖（单帖深度讨论请使用 CommentThread）。
zh.apiLead: CommentsPanel 统一管理待处理/已解决/全部胶囊筛选、排序菜单、评论及回复内的 /edit 执行状态、@提及高亮与底部 Editor 输入。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置团队成员与 Kense AI 协作评论、@提及及可执行 /edit 指令的评论侧栏。

props.name: with_comments
props.description: 传入带锚点标签与嵌套回复的自定义评论列表。

props.name: with_current_user
props.description: 设置发表新评论或回复时使用的当前用户名与头像缩写。

props.name: with_filter
props.description: 设置初始激活的筛选标签（Open、Resolved 或 All）。

props.name: with_title
props.description: 自定义面板顶部标题文案。

motion: 筛选标签通过 pro_pill_indicator 平滑滑动，执行 /edit 时呈现 pro_shimmer_text 流光并过渡至绿色已应用状态，列表切换带 pro_view_transition 微移。
点击回复时在输入框上方通过 pro_fold 展开回复对象提示条；开启减少动效时立即完成状态切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::comments_panel::CommentsPanel 导入；执行 kui add comments-panel 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::comments_panel::CommentsPanel 导入。
任何以 /edit 开头的评论或回复都会自动渲染指令徽标与“执行 /edit → 已应用修改 / 撤销”完整交互。

lead.en: Track an agent run as a Git-like #82bcff checkpoint rail where rewinding branches a new parallel attempt while preserving faded history.
lead.zh: 以类 Git 的 #82bcff 检查点轨道记录智能体运行快照，回退至任意节点将分叉出全新并行尝试并完整保留渐隐历史分支。

rule.en: Hover or focus any earlier checkpoint and press Rewind (or Enter / Space) to mark any running head Stopped, fade the old attempt, and bend a new parallel lane out of that parent.
rule.zh: 悬停或聚焦任意早期检查点并点击回退（或按 Enter / Space），即可将运行中节点标记为已停止、淡化旧分支并从父节点平滑弯出新轨道。

when: Long coding or research agent runs where a wrong turn should rewind to the last clean snapshot without losing prior work.
Making state recovery visible so people trust that abandoned attempts stay inspectable and reachable.
not: Pre-execution step lists that have not run yet (use AgentPlan) or planned-vs-actual timing comparisons (use PlanVsActual).
en.apiLead: AgentCheckpoints computes parallel branch lanes directly from parent links, preserves full checkpoint history on rewind, and emits typed Rewind events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a checkpoint card preloaded with the Ship the pricing page run.

props.name: with_checkpoints
props.description: Supply ordered checkpoints with parent links, tool icons, file counts, timestamps, and USD costs.

props.name: with_head
props.description: Set the active head checkpoint id whose ancestor path highlights in #82bcff.

props.name: with_task
props.description: Set the run task summary displayed next to the Checkpoints heading.

props.name: with_auto_branch_on_rewind
props.description: Automatically append a new running branch checkpoint when Rewind is triggered.

motion: Rewinding smoothly widens the rail gutter via Slide springs while PathBuilder draws a cubic S-bend into the new parallel attempt lane and shimmers the active title; Theme::reduced_motion disables shimmer and curve draw-in.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_checkpoints::AgentCheckpoints (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_checkpoints::AgentCheckpoints after running kui add agent-checkpoints.
Never delete checkpoints after a rewind—append the new attempt with parent set to the rewound checkpoint id and mark interrupted running heads CheckpointStatus::Stopped.

when: 耗时较长的编码或研究智能体任务，遇到方向偏差时回退到最近稳定快照重试而不丢失既有记录。
向用户直观传达“历史永不丢失”：回退离开的尝试分支自动淡化保留，随时可追溯。
not: 尚未开始执行的静态计划清单（请使用 AgentPlan）或计划与实际耗时对比图（请使用 PlanVsActual）。
zh.apiLead: AgentCheckpoints 仅凭 parent 父节点引用自动推导并行分支轨道，回退时完整保留历史记录并发出强类型 Rewind 事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载“上线定价页面”检查点序列的卡片组件。

props.name: with_checkpoints
props.description: 传入包含父子关联、工具图标、变更文件数、耗时与费用的检查点列表。

props.name: with_head
props.description: 指定当前所处的 head 检查点，其祖先链路以 #82bcff 高亮。

props.name: with_task
props.description: 设置标题旁展示的智能体任务描述。

props.name: with_auto_branch_on_rewind
props.description: 触发回退时是否自动追加一条并行尝试的运行中检查点。

motion: 回退时通过 Slide 弹簧平滑拓宽左侧轨道边距，PathBuilder 绘制三次贝塞尔 S 形分支曲线并为运行中标题叠加流光动效；开启减少动效时立即呈现静态结果。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_checkpoints::AgentCheckpoints 导入；执行 kui add agent-checkpoints 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_checkpoints::AgentCheckpoints 导入。
回退时切勿删除旧检查点——应将原 Running 节点标为 CheckpointStatus::Stopped，并以目标检查点为 parent 追加新尝试。

lead.en: Keep a lead agent and every sub-agent on screen as one persistent live tree of cards—watching context windows, twinkling work states, glowing connector handoffs, and steering any agent on click.
lead.zh: 将主控智能体与所有子智能体常驻展示为一棵实时卡片树：一目了然掌握上下文窗口占比、工作微光、圆角连线交接光脉冲，并可点击任意卡片随时介入调控。

rule.en: Switch projects in the top-left menu, trigger a handoff to watch light travel down the connectors and wash the destination card, or click any card to pause, approve, retry, or send a direct instruction.
rule.zh: 在左上角切换项目协作组，点击模拟交接观察光束沿连线抵达目标卡片并泛起方向性微光，或点击任意卡片执行暂停、批准、重试与发送指令。

when: Multi-agent runs where every specialist should remain visible on screen—who is working right now, who is resting, how full each context window is, and who handed what to whom.
Operations dashboards that switch across active project crews and let humans step in when an agent needs approval or hits an error.
not: Dynamic runs where sub-agents spawn and fold with rolled-up branch costs—use AgentTree instead.
Comparing several parallel orchestrators side by side with only one branch unfolded at a time—use AgentFleet instead.
en.apiLead: AgentCrew owns project switching, multi-hop connector pulse routing, directional arrival washes, context threshold coloring, and a keyboard-accessible steering dialog with inline message editing.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a persistent crew tree initialized with three switchable multi-agent projects.

props.name: with_root
props.description: Provide a single custom lead agent and nested sub-agent hierarchy.

props.name: with_projects
props.description: Configure multiple crews selectable from the top-left project switcher.

props.name: push_handoff
props.description: Animate a new handoff pulse hop-by-hop from source to destination once per id.

props.name: steer_agent
props.type: (&mut self, impl Into<SharedString>, CrewSteerAction, Option<SharedString>, &mut Context<Self>)
props.description: Pause, resume, stop, approve, decline, retry, or message a specific agent.

motion: Working pixel marks twinkle diagonally while activity text shimmers; handoffs travel hop-by-hop along rounded connectors and trigger a directional gradient wash on the destination card; reduced motion disables continuous pulses.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_crew::AgentCrew (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_crew::AgentCrew after running kui add agent-crew.
Assign stable CrewAgent and CrewHandoff ids so each handoff animates once and context meters spring smoothly.

when: 需要让主控与所有子智能体始终同屏可见的多智能体协作场景——直观查看谁在工作、谁在待命、各自上下文容量及最近交接内容。
需要在同一面板切换多个项目的协作组，并在智能体等待确认或报错时立即介入指导。
not: 子智能体动态增减且需要按分支折叠汇总成本的场景——请改用 AgentTree。
需要并排总览多个主智能体且一次仅展开一棵子树的场景——请改用 AgentFleet。
zh.apiLead: AgentCrew 内置多项目切换菜单、多跳圆角连线光脉冲、目标卡片方向性微光渲染、上下文阈值变色条，以及带行内指令输入框的调控弹窗。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认包含三个可切换多智能体项目的实时协作树。

props.name: with_root
props.description: 传入单个自定义主控智能体及其子智能体层级。

props.name: with_projects
props.description: 配置左上角项目下拉菜单中的多个协作组。

props.name: push_handoff
props.description: 按唯一 id 触发一次从源节点沿连线逐跳抵达目标节点的交接光脉冲。

props.name: steer_agent
props.type: (&mut self, impl Into<SharedString>, CrewSteerAction, Option<SharedString>, &mut Context<Self>)
props.description: 对指定智能体执行暂停、恢复、停止、批准、拒绝、重试或发送短指令。

motion: 工作中智能体的像素徽标呈对角波浪闪烁且状态文案流光扫过；交接光束沿圆角连线逐跳推进并在抵达边缘泛起方向性渐变光晕；开启减少动效时立即更新。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_crew::AgentCrew 导入；执行 kui add agent-crew 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_crew::AgentCrew 导入。
为每个 CrewAgent 和 CrewHandoff 保持稳定的 id，使交接脉冲不重复触发且上下文进度条平滑过渡。

lead.en: Watch multiple AI agents collaborate inside a shared document and table with gliding pointers, letter-by-letter patches, resizable figures, and margin comments.
lead.zh: 在共享文档与表格画布中实时呈现多智能体如同队友般协同编辑：平滑滑行的彩色指针与姓名铭牌、逐字键入的代码与正文修订、四角缩放配图以及页边批注卡片。

rule.en: Click an agent avatar in the header to follow its pointer, click any underlined inline edit to Accept or Reject it, or resolve margin comments beside the page.
rule.zh: 点击顶栏智能体头像即可跟随其光标并弱化其余指针，点击正文或代码块中的划线建议可逐条采纳或拒绝，亦可在页边批注卡中回复并标记已解决。

when: Documents, launch briefs, or specs edited concurrently by multiple specialist agents where people want to see who is working where.
Keeping each agent's prose and code edits as color-coded suggestions until a human accepts them.
not: Single-agent text rewrites (use WritingAssistant or InlineDiff) or hierarchical parent-child spawn graphs (use AgentTree).
en.apiLead: AgentCursors renders structured document and table blocks, tracks per-agent live cursors and costs, and splices accepted edits via accept_suggestion.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a collaborative editor stage preloaded with the Pulse 2.0 launch brief.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Configure agent names, provider marks, cursor colors, follow tints, and running USD costs.

props.name: with_blocks
props.description: Supply Title, Heading, Paragraph, Item, Code, Image, or Table blocks.

props.name: with_suggestions
props.description: Provide pending strike/insert suggestions with rationale notes.

props.name: with_comments
props.description: Attach margin comment pins and expandable discussion cards.

motion: Slide springs glide PathBuilder cursor arrows, nametag flags, and resizing hero image bounds while active header avatars spin a progress arc; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous loops and snaps positions.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_cursors::AgentCursors (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_cursors::AgentCursors after running kui add agent-cursors.
Use accept_suggestion(&blocks, &suggestions, id) to splice accepted text and automatically shift character offsets for remaining suggestions in the same block.

when: 由研究、设计、编码、撰稿等多个智能体并行协作编写的文档或立项简报，需要直观展示每位智能体当前所在位置与动作。
希望将智能体对正文和代码块的修改保留为带配色的待审建议，由用户确认后再正式合入正文。
not: 单智能体改写回复（请使用 WritingAssistant 或 InlineDiff）或展示智能体派系拓扑（请使用 AgentTree）。
zh.apiLead: AgentCursors 支持结构化文档与表格双视图、智能体光标跟随与实时费用汇总，并通过 accept_suggestion 安全合入字符级建议。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 Pulse 2.0 发布简报的多智能体协同画布。

props.name: with_agents
props.description: 配置智能体名称、模型标识、专属指针色、跟随底色与累计费用。

props.name: with_blocks
props.description: 传入标题、小节、正文、列表、代码块、可缩放配图或表格内容块。

props.name: with_suggestions
props.description: 配置带删除线与下划线的内联修订建议及原因说明。

props.name: with_comments
props.description: 挂载可展开、快速回复与标记解决的页边批注图钉。

motion: 通过 Slide 弹簧驱动 PathBuilder 光标箭头、姓名铭牌与首屏配图尺寸平滑过渡，顶栏活跃头像环绕旋转弧线；开启减少动效时立即静态就位。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_cursors::AgentCursors 导入；执行 kui add agent-cursors 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_cursors::AgentCursors 导入。
调用 accept_suggestion(&blocks, &suggestions, id) 可在合入建议文本的同时自动重算同一段落后续建议的字符偏移。

lead.en: Follow a parallel swarm of auditing or verification agents with calm per-agent progress bars above a live feed where Critical, Warning, and Note findings slide in as uncovered.
lead.zh: 上方以克制清晰的进度行展示并行审查智能体的实时检查进度，下方实时滑入智能体最新发现的严重、警告与提示级问题。

rule.en: Click any agent row to filter Latest findings to its discoveries alone, or click a finding row to expand its source location and remediation note.
rule.zh: 点击任意智能体行即可仅筛选其发现的问题，点击底部信息流中的任意条目可展开源码位置与修复说明。

when: Security audits, code reviews, invariant checks, or QA swarms where several agents inspect a target in parallel.
Surfacing high-signal findings as they arrive without burying people in raw execution logs.
not: Parent-child spawn hierarchies (use AgentTree) or precise span timing breakdowns (use TraceWaterfall).
en.apiLead: AgentFindings pairs per-agent check progress and severity counters with a bounded, filterable live findings feed.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a swarm card preloaded with a 4-agent smart-contract verification run.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Supply parallel agents with step subtitles and done/total check counts.

props.name: with_findings
props.description: Provide findings with Critical, Warning, or Note severity, file:line locations, and ages.

props.name: with_rows
props.description: Maximum number of finding rows visible in the sliding bottom feed.

props.name: with_live_swarm
props.description: Automatically advance running check meters and stream staged findings.

motion: pro_spring_bar advances check ratios smoothly, pro_rolling_number updates Critical and Warning counters, and new findings glide from -10px into slot 0 while feed height springs open; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous ticks.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_findings::AgentFindings (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_findings::AgentFindings after running kui add agent-findings.
Use push_finding(finding, cx) to stream newly uncovered issues to the top of the feed in real time.

when: 安全审计、代码走查、形式化验证或数据质检等由多个智能体并行排查问题的场景。
希望在问题发现瞬间以高信噪比信息流即时浮现，而不让用户淹没在冗长日志中。
not: 需强调谁派生了谁的拓扑树（请使用 AgentTree）或毫秒级调用瀑布流（请使用 TraceWaterfall）。
zh.apiLead: AgentFindings 将每位智能体的检查进度、分级计数与可按智能体筛选的底部实时发现流融为一体。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 4 位合约安全核验智能体的审查卡片。

props.name: with_agents
props.default: 审计、模糊测试、证明与 Gas 审查
props.description: 传入各智能体的当前步骤描述及已完成/总检查项数。

props.name: with_findings
props.default: 按最新排序的发现条目
props.description: 配置包含严重级别、源码行列号、相对时间与修复建议的发现列表。

props.name: with_rows
props.description: 设置底部实时信息流最多同时展示的条目行数。

props.name: with_live_swarm
props.description: 是否自动推进运行中检查进度并流式推入待发现问题。

motion: pro_spring_bar 平滑推进检查进度条，pro_rolling_number 滚动更新顶栏严重/警告计数，新发现条目自顶部平滑滑入且容器高度弹簧舒展；开启减少动效时立即静态呈现。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_findings::AgentFindings 导入；执行 kui add agent-findings 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_findings::AgentFindings 导入。
运行期可通过 push_finding(finding, cx) 将新发现的问题实时推入信息流顶部。

lead.en: Monitor several parallel orchestrator agents side by side—each card rolls up sub-agent progress, urgent blockers, and branch spend, unfolding its sub-agent tree to the right on click while folding the last.
lead.zh: 并排监控多个并行主控智能体：每张卡片自动汇总子智能体进度饼环、紧急阻塞项与分支总花费，点击任一主卡片即可在右侧平滑展开其子树并收起上一棵。

rule.en: Click any lead agent card to unfold its sub-agent tree on the right, then click Answer, Resolve, or any sub-agent card to inspect its steps and approve or retry inline.
rule.zh: 点击任一主控智能体卡片在右侧展开其子智能体树，点击子卡片或“处理 / 解决”按钮即可查看执行步骤并直接批准或重试。

when: Several autonomous orchestrators running simultaneously—a launch, a support queue, a mobile release, and a weekly report—each managing sub-agents of its own.
Fleet dashboards where seeing total spend, who needs human sign-off, and who failed matters without keeping every tree open at once.
not: One single orchestrator run where every branch and rolled-up node cost stays focused on a single goal—use AgentTree instead.
Keeping every agent of one crew permanently expanded with live handoff pulses—use AgentCrew instead.
en.apiLead: AgentFleet rolls up descendant costs automatically, renders Linear-style completion pie rings, dims inactive leads via Slide springs, and unfolds sub-agent task and approval drawers via pro_fold.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 4-lead, 14-sub-agent fleet overview with Launch lead unfolded.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Supply custom lead agents with nested sub-agents, tools, steps, asks, and errors.

props.name: with_default_open
props.description: Set which lead agent starts unfolded, or None to fold all trees initially.

props.name: set_open
props.description: Programmatically unfold a lead agent's tree or fold all trees.

props.name: resolve_sub_agent
props.description: Approve, reject, retry, or dismiss a waiting or failed sub-agent.

motion: Opening a lead dims sibling leads to 50% (86% on hover) via Slide springs while staggered sub-agent cards and orthogonal rounded connectors draw out to the right; reduced motion switches trees immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_fleet::AgentFleet (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_fleet::AgentFleet after running kui add agent-fleet.
Set each FleetAgent's own cost only—AgentFleet sums child costs into each lead card and the fleet header automatically.

when: 多个主控智能体同时并行运转（如产品上线、客服工单池、客户端发版与竞品周报），且各自拥有独立子智能体编队的场景。
需要在同一总览面板一眼识别哪个团队待确认、哪个构建失败以及总花费，而无需把所有树同时铺满屏幕。
not: 单一目标下的多层级子智能体编排与逐级分支成本折叠——请改用 AgentTree。
单项目内所有智能体常驻展示并观察实时连线交接——请改用 AgentCrew。
zh.apiLead: AgentFleet 自动递归汇总子智能体花费、绘制完成度饼环、以 Slide 弹簧柔化非激活主卡片透明度，并通过 pro_fold 展开子智能体的步骤与审批抽屉。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含 4 个主智能体与 14 个子智能体且默认展开“发布负责人”的舰队总览。

props.name: with_agents
props.description: 传入自定义主智能体及其子智能体树、工具徽标、执行步骤与待办审批。

props.name: with_default_open
props.description: 指定初始展开的主智能体 id，传入 None 则默认全部收起。

props.name: set_open
props.description: 在运行时动态切换展开的主智能体或全部折叠。

props.name: resolve_sub_agent
props.description: 对等待确认或失败的子智能体执行批准、拒绝、重试或忽略。

motion: 展开某一主智能体时其余主卡片通过 Slide 弹簧柔和退至半透明（悬停恢复清晰），右侧圆角连线与子卡片依次浮现；开启减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_fleet::AgentFleet 导入；执行 kui add agent-fleet 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_fleet::AgentFleet 导入。
只需填写每个节点的自身花费 cost，组件会自动向上递归汇总分支成本与舰队总计。

lead.en: See agents and the tools they call as a living orbital network—pulses travel out for calls and return for answers, busy links thicken dynamically, working agents breathe softly, and amber nodes flag where human approval is needed.
lead.zh: 将智能体及其调用的工具呈现为鲜活的轨道网络：请求与响应光脉冲双向穿梭、高频链路动态加粗、运行中节点柔和呼吸，需要人工介入的节点自动亮起琥珀色提醒。

rule.en: Hover any node to isolate its connected links, click Send burst to watch busy links thicken, and click the amber Writer node or 1 needs you chip to inspect and approve.
rule.zh: 悬停任一节点聚焦其关联链路，点击“发送调用簇”观察繁忙连线加粗，点击琥珀色节点或顶栏“待确认”徽标打开详情并批准。

when: Live topology overviews showing which specialist agents are active, which shared tools and databases they call, and where traffic or bottlenecks concentrate.
Spotting at a glance which agent waits on human approval, which call failed, and how total run spend distributes across nodes.
not: Strict parent-child delegation trees with rolled-up branch costs—use AgentTree instead.
Single-agent finite-state transitions across Planning, Coding, and Testing—use AgentStateMachine instead.
en.apiLead: AgentGraph computes orbital coordinates, renders rounded PathBuilder circuit edges with traffic-driven stroke thickness, animates bidirectional call/answer streaks and landing ripples, and opens a per-node approval and call-log dialog.

when: 需要实时总览多智能体系统中哪些智能体在运行、各自调用了哪些外部工具与数据库、以及流量集中在哪些链路。
需要一眼识别哪个智能体正在等待人工批准、哪次调用报错以及整体成本分布。
not: 严格按父子派生关系汇总分支花费的树状视图——请改用 AgentTree。
单个智能体在规划、编码、测试等有限状态间的跳转——请改用 AgentStateMachine。
zh.apiLead: AgentGraph 自动计算内外双环轨道坐标，基于 PathBuilder 绘制随调用热度动态加粗的圆角电路连线、双向光脉冲与着陆波纹，并提供节点调用日志与审批弹窗。

motion: 请求以蓝色彗星光束发出，响应以绿色空心光环返回并在目标节点激起波纹；繁忙连线随调用频次平滑增粗并在空闲后回落；开启减少动效时自动静默。
