title.zh: 智能体后台任务收件箱

lead.en: Collect every background agent task in one calm list or board—filter tabs with rolling counts, live ticking clocks, rows that unfold to recent steps with Approve / Reject / Retry / Open, and smooth glides when status changes.
lead.zh: 将所有后台智能体任务收纳进克制的分组列表或三栏看板：配备滚动计数的筛选标签、实时跳动计时器、可展开的最近步骤时间线及就地批准/拒绝/重试，并在状态流转时平滑滑入新分组。

rule.en: Filter across All / Needs you / Running / Done, switch between List and Board views, click any task to unfold its recent steps, and press Approve or Retry to watch the card glide into Running.
rule.zh: 按全部、待处理、运行中、已完成筛选或切换列表/看板视图，点击任意任务展开最近执行步骤，点击批准或重试即可平滑滑入运行中分组。

when: Dashboards and sidebars where several background tasks—migrations, PR reviews, CRM cleanups, digests—run concurrently and collect human approvals in one calm place.
Asynchronous job queues where each task carries a short summary, recent step history, and one clear next action.
not: A single inline tool-call prompt inside a chat message—use ApprovalCard instead.
Full-screen single-item decision triage with keyboard split panes—use InboxScreen instead.
en.apiLead: AgentInbox manages status filter tabs with rolling counts, List/Board layout switching, live elapsed clocks, pro_fold step disclosures, and FLIP position glides across groups.

props.name: with_default_filter
props.description: Set the initial status filter tab (All, NeedsYou, Running, Done).

props.name: with_header_action
props.description: Add an optional primary CTA button in the header bar (such as "New task").

motion: Filter and layout switches glide via pro_pill_indicator while badge counters micro-roll via pro_rolling_number; running and waiting clocks tick live every second.
Unfolding a task reveals its step timeline via pro_fold, and approving or retrying a task smoothly glides its card from Needs you into Running via FLIP coordinates.

Below 620px width, Board view automatically collapses into the single-column List layout so cards stay readable down to 300px.

when: 多项后台任务（数据迁移、代码审查、CRM 去重、周报生成）并行推进，需要在一个安静的面板集中处理审批与失败重试。
每条任务包含简短背景说明、最近几步进展与明确下一步动作的异步作业队列。
not: 嵌入单条聊天流中的即时工具调用确认（请使用 ApprovalCard）。
全屏双栏逐条决策与富文本批注工作台（请使用 InboxScreen）。
zh.apiLead: AgentInbox 内置带滚动计数的状态筛选栏、列表/看板双视图、实时运行秒表、pro_fold 步骤展开以及跨分组 FLIP 平滑位移。

props.name: new

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: 传入包含模型名称、耗时、检索源与工具调用数及最近步骤时间线的任务列表。

props.description: 设置初始筛选标签（All、NeedsYou、Running、Done）。

props.description: 选择默认呈现纵向分组列表（List）或三栏看板（Board）。

props.name: with_header_action
props.description: 在顶部工具栏右侧添加可选操作按钮（如“新建任务”）。

motion: 筛选与布局胶囊通过 pro_pill_indicator 顺滑滑动，计数徽标通过 pro_rolling_number 翻滚过渡，活跃任务计时器每秒跳动。
点击任务通过 pro_fold 展开步骤时间线；批准或重试导致分组变更时，卡片通过 FLIP 坐标插值平滑滑入目标分组；支持 Theme::reduced_motion。

容器宽度低于 620px 时自动收敛为单列列表布局，在窄至 300px 的侧边栏中依然清晰易读。

lead.en: See what every autonomous agent is doing right now on a live horizontal swimlane timeline with inter-agent handoff curves and inline approvals.
lead.zh: 在实时横向多智能体泳道图中总览每位智能体当前进展、跨泳道交接曲线与就地审批操作。

rule.en: Click Approve or Reject directly on waiting task blocks (or open the full decision dialog), and click any running or finished task block to inspect its summary bullets.
rule.zh: 直接在待确认任务块上点击批准或拒绝（也可展开完整决策弹窗），点击任一运行中或已完成任务块即可查看执行摘要。

when: Multi-agent pipelines where work flows from one specialist agent to the next (Researcher → Writer → Reviewer → Ops).
Control-room dashboards where operators spot blocked approvals or failed tasks without opening every run.
not: Single-agent step checklists (use AgentTrail) or week-ahead calendar scheduling.
en.apiLead: AgentLanes coordinates sliding time windows, per-agent Idle/Needs-you state badges, PathBuilder cubic handoff splines, inline approvals, and task summary popovers.

props.name: new

props.name: with_tasks

motion: Running blocks stretch smoothly into the now cursor while live PathBuilder cubic handoff curves animate dash phase toward downstream agents and waiting indicators pulse; Theme::reduced_motion holds all motion still.

Link sequential tasks across agents via LaneTask::with_handoff_to(next_id) and provide a concise one-sentence with_ask(...) on waiting tasks.

when: 多智能体流水线协作场景（如研究 → 写作 → 审查 → 运维），直观呈现任务交接关系与并行进度。
智能体控制中心大盘，无需逐一点开运行记录即可发现待审批阻塞或失败任务。
not: 单一智能体的纵向步骤清单（请使用 AgentTrail），或面向未来数天的日历排期。
zh.apiLead: AgentLanes 统筹滑动时间窗、智能体空闲/待确认徽章、PathBuilder 三次贝塞尔跨泳道交接曲线、行内审批按钮与任务摘要浮层。

使用 LaneTask::with_handoff_to(next_id) 串联跨智能体交接，并为等待审批任务配置简明的一句话 with_ask(...)。

lead.en: Track everything an agent changed across real systems—with before → after diffs per row, Irreversible locks, and dependency-aware Undo that previews what rolls back with it and what cannot be taken back.
lead.zh: 完整记录智能体在真实业务系统中执行的每一项变更：逐行展示前后值对比与不可逆锁，并在悬停撤销时实时预览一并回滚的下游变更与无法撤回的副作用。

rule.en: Hover Undo on any row to highlight downstream dependent mutations (Also undone in blue, Can't undo in amber), click Undo to roll back the reversible chain, and click Redo to reapply.
rule.zh: 悬停任意行的“撤销”按钮即可高亮其下游依赖链（蓝色“一并撤销”、琥珀色“无法撤回”），点击撤销一键回滚可逆链路，点击重做恢复。

when: Agents mutate real external systems—Stripe, HubSpot, GitHub, Vercel, Gmail—and operators need an honest audit trail with reversible rollback.
Post-execution side-effect logs where undoing an earlier step must clearly surface dependent downstream changes and irreversible actions.
not: Asking for permission before a risky action executes—use ApprovalCard or HandoffSwimlanes instead.
Latency and token profiling along a millisecond timeline—use TraceWaterfall instead.
en.apiLead: AgentLedger sorts mutations newest-first, computes transitive undo blast radii and redo prerequisite chains, renders target app tiles via pro_app_tile, and emits Undo / Redo id batches.

props.name: with_entries
props.description: Provide system mutations with `(before, after)` diffs, `reversible` flags, and `depends_on` links.

props.name: with_point_at
props.description: Programmatically spotlight a mutation's Undo blast radius for walkthroughs.

motion: Hovering Undo lights up the target row and every downstream dependent in place (Also undone in blue, Can't undo in amber) while keeping row height locked at 56px.
Rolling back sweeps a spring-driven strikethrough line across each reverted row via pro_spring_f32 and dims its app tile; respects Theme::reduced_motion.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_ledger::AgentLedger (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_ledger::AgentLedger after running kui add agent-ledger.
Mark external side effects that cannot be recalled (such as sent emails or payouts) with `.with_reversible(false)` so dependency previews remain honest.

when: 智能体直接操作代码仓、支付、CRM、邮件与部署平台，用户需要事后审计并安全回退变更。
撤销前置操作会影响后续多步变更，必须诚实告知哪些会一并回滚、哪些已发送无法撤回的场景。
not: 在动作执行前进行事前人工拦截审批（请使用 ApprovalCard 或 HandoffSwimlanes）。
分析单次运行中各调用的毫秒级耗时瓶颈（请使用 TraceWaterfall）。
zh.apiLead: AgentLedger 按最新时间倒序排列变更，自动计算传递依赖回滚范围与重做前置条件，通过 pro_app_tile 渲染目标系统徽标并派发批量事件。

motion: 悬停撤销时锁定 56px 行高不跳动，原位切换下游行的“一并撤销”与“无法撤回”高亮胶囊。
执行撤销后通过 pro_spring_f32 扫过删除线并弱化应用图标，顶部统计同步更新；支持 Theme::reduced_motion。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_ledger::AgentLedger 导入；执行 kui add agent-ledger 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_ledger::AgentLedger 导入。
对群发邮件、打款等不可撤回动作请显式设置 `.with_reversible(false)`，确保依赖回滚提示真实可信。

lead.en: Read a multi-agent release or workflow like a transit map—each agent rides its colored 45° line as a pixel-mark train chip, meeting at interchange rings and pausing at amber stations for human approval.
lead.zh: 以城市地铁图方式直观呈现多智能体协同流程：每个智能体化作像素徽标列车沿专属 45° 彩色轨道行进，在换乘环站交接工作，并在琥珀色站点等待人工签批。

rule.en: Hover any top legend chip or station to highlight its route, click Step trains to advance active agents, and click the amber Sign-off station to inspect and Approve.
rule.zh: 悬停顶部图例或站点高亮对应线路，点击“推进列车”观察智能体沿轨道平滑前进，点击琥珀色“人工签批”站点打开卡片并批准放行。

when: Multi-agent launches, releases, or onboarding pipelines where people want to see at a glance where each agent is, where lines meet to hand work over, and what stops remain ahead.
Workflows with explicit human sign-off gates embedded directly as stations on the route.
not: Single-agent finite-state loops and retry counts—use AgentStateMachine instead.
Detecting file or logic collisions across teammates' coding agents—use AgentOverlapMap instead.
en.apiLead: AgentMetroMap lays out stations on a responsive grid, routes PathBuilder rails with true 45-degree diagonal geometry, glides train chips via Slide springs, and opens station approval and route stop dialogs.

流程中包含需要人工签字放行的关键卡点，希望直接在路线图站点上完成审批。
not: 单个智能体内部的状态流转与重试计数——请改用 AgentStateMachine。
排查多位团队成员的编程智能体在文件或逻辑上的冲突——请改用 AgentOverlapMap。

props.name: resolve_station

lead.en: Keep one working agent in view with a live clock, rolling USD bill, tool time strip, clickable step input/output drawers, exact command approval box, and foldable status bar.
lead.zh: 以紧凑卡片持续监督单个智能体：实时计时与滚动账单、按耗时比例切分的工具条带、点击可展开输入/输出详情的步骤列表、敏感命令审批框以及可折叠工具图标状态栏。

rule.en: Click any completed step or time-strip segment to inspect its input/output details, Approve or Deny the exact shell command when Needs you appears, or fold the card into a slim bar.

when: Side panels or floating tiles supervising one background agent while the user focuses elsewhere.
Agents that pause for human confirmation before running a real-world deploy, release, or API mutation.
not: Deep nested span hierarchies (use TraceWaterfall) or multiple parallel agents running side by side (use AgentLanes).
en.apiLead: AgentMonitor combines live elapsed timing, cost rolling, cross-highlighted tool segments, inline approval gates, and a foldable summary bar.

when: 侧边栏或悬浮面板中持续关注单个后台智能体的当前步骤、累计耗时与实时费用。
智能体在执行发版、部署或退款等真实外部操作前需展示精确命令并等待人工批准。
not: 需要查看多层嵌套调用栈细节（请使用 TraceWaterfall）或多智能体并行泳道对比（请使用 AgentLanes）。
zh.apiLead: AgentMonitor 集成了实时时钟、滚动费用计数、双向联动工具耗时条带、内联命令审批与可折叠工具栏。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 web-app v3.2 发布任务的单智能体监督卡。

props.name: with_state
props.description: 设置空闲、运行中、待审批、已暂停、已完成、失败或已取消状态。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 配置按时间排序的步骤、工具图标、耗时及输入/输出摘要。

props.name: with_ask
props.description: 设置待审批状态下展示的标题、工具图标与精确命令代码。

props.name: with_default_folded
props.description: 是否默认折叠为 44px 高的已用工具图标状态栏。

motion: pro_rolling_number 平滑滚动更新累计美元账单，pro_shimmer_text 渲染运行中步骤流光，pro_fold 驱动步骤详情抽屉与整卡折叠；开启减少动效时立即静态切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_monitor::AgentMonitor 导入；执行 kui add agent-monitor 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_monitor::AgentMonitor 导入。
为每个 MonitorStep 填写 with_io_details，以便用户点击已完成行或耗时条带时直观查看执行的命令与输出结果。

lead.en: Spot where teammates' AI coding agents collide—severity-coded center badges link to each person's agent chip via smooth Bezier curves, highlighting red decisions, amber heads-ups, dashed minor overlaps, and who is cleanly in sync.
lead.zh: 一眼识别多位团队成员的 AI 编程智能体在何处发生碰撞：中央分级冲突徽标通过平滑贝塞尔曲线连接两侧成员智能体，区分红色待决策、琥珀色提醒与灰色虚线轻微重叠，并列出保持同步的成员。

rule.en: Hover any conflict badge or agent chip to isolate its Bezier tangle curves, and click a badge to inspect involved teammates and mark the overlap resolved.
rule.zh: 悬停任一冲突徽标或成员智能体以聚焦关联的贝塞尔曲线，点击徽标查看涉及成员与详情并标记冲突已解决。

when: Team workspaces where several engineers run Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI concurrently and risk editing the same files, using stale IDs, or duplicating work.
Engineering lead overviews that separate urgent architectural contradictions from minor shared-config edits.
not: Live co-editing cursors inside a single open document—use AgentCursor instead.
Monitoring sub-agent delegation inside one orchestrator run—use AgentTree instead.
en.apiLead: AgentOverlapMap deduplicates (person, agent) endpoints, measures chip and badge bounds via prepaint sensors, draws solid and dashed PathBuilder cubic Bezier curves, and updates synced teammates dynamically as conflicts resolve.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 9-person, 8-conflict collision radar with Jonas listed in sync.

props.name: with_people
props.description: Provide everyone on the team; members involved in zero conflicts appear in the synced footer.

props.name: with_conflicts
props.description: Provide open collisions with severity (High, Medium, Low) and participating agent sides.

props.name: resolve_conflict
props.description: Remove a resolved conflict and move newly uninvolved teammates into the synced bar.

motion: Hovering or focusing an agent or conflict brings its Bezier curves to 88% opacity while fading unrelated curves and chips; involved pixel marks twinkle diagonally unless reduced motion is active.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_overlap_map::AgentOverlapMap (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_overlap_map::AgentOverlapMap after running kui add agent-overlap-map.
Keep conflict labels to one or two words (Same files, Contradicts, Out of sync, Same work) and put the full explanation in OverlapConflict::title.

when: 多位成员同时运行 Claude Code、Codex 或 Gemini CLI 时，排查并发修改同一文件、口径矛盾或重复造轮子的问题。
团队总览面板，需要一眼区分必须立即拍板的架构冲突与仅需知晓的轻微配置重叠。
not: 同一份打开文档内的多人实时光标协同——请改用 AgentCursor。
单个主控智能体内部的子智能体树状分发——请改用 AgentTree。
zh.apiLead: AgentOverlapMap 自动归并（成员，智能体）节点，通过预绘制尺寸传感器精确定位芯片与徽标边缘，绘制实线与虚线三次贝塞尔曲线，并在解决冲突后自动更新底部同步名单。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含 9 位成员、8 项活跃冲突且底部显示 Jonas 同步中的冲突雷达。

props.name: with_people
props.description: 传入团队成员列表，未卷入任何冲突的成员会自动列在底部同步栏。

props.name: with_conflicts
props.description: 传入冲突标题、严重级别（High、Medium、Low）及涉及的智能体端点。

props.name: resolve_conflict
props.description: 移除已解决的冲突，并将不再存在冲突的成员移入底部同步栏。

motion: 悬停或键盘聚焦任一徽标或智能体芯片时，关联曲线柔和提亮并淡化其余连接；参与冲突的像素徽标呈对角闪烁，开启减少动效时自动静默。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_overlap_map::AgentOverlapMap 导入；执行 kui add agent-overlap-map 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_overlap_map::AgentOverlapMap 导入。
徽标文案保持简短（如“同一文件”、“逻辑冲突”、“重复开发”），完整描述放入 OverlapConflict::title。

title.zh: 智能体任务队列与工作池

lead.en: Watch queued jobs glide into worker pool slots with growing progress bars, land in Done or Failed bins, and drive a live backlog depth area chart through rate-limit spikes.
lead.zh: 实时呈现待处理任务进入并发工作槽、以渐进进度条执行并落入已完成/已失败分箱的全过程，下方配有展示限流积压峰值与排空过程的实时面积图。

rule.en: Trigger Rate limit to pause workers in amber and watch the Queue depth chart climb above the dashed backpressure threshold, adjust worker concurrency with - N +, or click any job to promote or cancel it.
rule.zh: 点击“模拟限流”可将工作槽置为琥珀色等待并观察队列深度冲破背压虚线，通过 - N + 步进器调节并发工作槽数，或点击任意任务将其移至队首或取消。

when: Operations views monitoring how many agent tasks wait, which model worker runs what, and how fast the backlog drains.
Visualizing live backpressure when an upstream model provider rate-limits and workers temporarily stall.
not: Manual drag-and-drop task routing to named specialists (use DelegateBoard) or single-run span timing traces (use TraceWaterfall).
en.apiLead: AgentQueue models prioritized queued jobs, concurrent worker slots, terminal counters, and a PathBuilder backlog depth area chart.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a live queue and 4-worker pool visualizer with historical depth data.

props.name: with_workers
props.description: Configure worker pool slots and provider marks.

props.name: with_jobs
props.description: Supply Llm, Tool, Agent, or Human jobs with priority and progress.

props.name: with_backpressure
props.description: Set the dashed backpressure depth line above which Waiting turns amber.

props.name: with_totals
props.description: Seed cumulative Done and Failed bin counters.

motion: pro_spring_f32 grows worker progress fills smoothly, pro_rolling_number rolls KPI and terminal bin counts, and PathBuilder renders the live area curve with amber rate-limit bands; Theme::reduced_motion freezes continuous ticks.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_queue::AgentQueue (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_queue::AgentQueue after running kui add agent-queue.
Use enqueue_job, promote_job, and set_concurrency to steer queue execution programmatically.

when: 运维与调度面板，需实时掌握智能体排队积压数、各模型工作槽占用情况及吞吐速率。
直观演示上游模型触发 429 速率限制时的任务积压爬升与恢复后的快速排空过程。
not: 由人工按专长将任务指派给特定智能体（请使用 DelegateBoard）或单次运行的调用链耗时剖析（请使用 TraceWaterfall）。
zh.apiLead: AgentQueue 完整建模优先级排队队列、并发工作槽进度条、完成/失败计数箱以及 PathBuilder 积压深度面积图。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 4 个并发工作槽与历史积压曲线的实时队列组件。

props.name: with_workers
props.description: 配置工作槽列表及其模型服务商标识。

props.name: with_jobs
props.description: 传入模型、工具、子智能体或人工复核类型的队列任务。

props.name: with_backpressure
props.description: 设置面积图上的背压虚线阈值，超出时排队计数转为琥珀色预警。

props.name: with_totals
props.description: 设置累计已完成与已失败计数箱初始值。

motion: pro_spring_f32 平滑推进工作槽执行进度条，pro_rolling_number 滚动更新四项指标与分箱计数，PathBuilder 绘制带琥珀色限流色带的积压曲线；开启减少动效时暂停连续步进。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_queue::AgentQueue 导入；执行 kui add agent-queue 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_queue::AgentQueue 导入。
可通过 enqueue_job、promote_job 与 set_concurrency 在代码中动态操控队列优先级与并发度。

lead.en: Catch up on what your agents did while you were away—an overnight event-peak curve on top paired with a 3-lane board of Needs you, Failed, and Done cards you can approve, retry, or undo in place.
lead.zh: 一屏回顾离线期间智能体的全部工作：顶部以事件波峰曲线还原夜间节奏，下方按“待你确认”“失败”“已完成”三栏分组并支持就地批准、重试与撤销。

rule.en: Hover or click peak dots on the overnight curve to spotlight matching cards, and click Approve, Merge, Retry, or Undo right on the fixed-height cards without layout shift.
rule.zh: 悬停或点击顶部波峰圆点可联动聚光下方对应卡片，在等高卡片内直接执行批准、合并、重试或撤销且不会引发版面跳动。

when: Morning, post-meeting, or post-weekend summaries when users return to autonomous agents that kept working overnight.
Triage boards where pending human approvals and failed jobs come first and can be resolved in one click.
not: Live second-by-second execution monitoring while watching an agent work—use TraceWaterfall or MissionControlBlock instead.
Full system-mutation history with dependency-chain rollback—use AgentLedger instead.
en.apiLead: AgentRecap plots Gaussian event peaks via PathBuilder, links dot/card spotlighting bidirectionally, keeps all three lanes equal height, and handles inline Approve / Retry / Undo / Redo.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an AgentRecap preloaded with 6 overnight events across Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, and Linear.

props.name: with_events
props.description: Provide overnight events with normalized curve positions, counts, logos, and custom action labels.

props.name: with_window
props.description: Configure the start time, end time, and elapsed duration pill.

props.name: with_limit
props.description: Maximum cards shown per lane while reserving equal lane height.

props.name: with_replay_ms
props.description: Left-to-right curve replay duration on mount in milliseconds (0 shows immediately).

motion: The PathBuilder Gaussian curve draws smoothly from left to right on open, popping in orange, red, and neutral peak dots as the sweep passes each event.
Hovering a dot draws a vertical crosshair and tooltip while highlighting its card; acting on a card transitions its badge, mark, and Undo button in place at a steady 90px height.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_recap::AgentRecap (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_recap::AgentRecap after running kui add agent-recap.
Aggregate repetitive autonomous completions into one Done card with `.with_count(38)` instead of dozens of separate cards; below 640px the three lanes stack vertically.

when: 清晨、会后或周末归来时打开的首页简报，快速掌握后台智能体在离线期间完成了哪些事项。
优先呈现少量待人工拍板或需重试的任务，并支持在原卡片一键处理完结。
not: 实时盯盘正在执行的单次调用链（请使用 TraceWaterfall 或 MissionControlBlock）。
逐笔查看前后字段差异并进行依赖链级联回滚（请使用 AgentLedger）。
zh.apiLead: AgentRecap 通过 PathBuilder 绘制高斯事件波峰曲线，实现圆点与卡片双向聚光联动，保持三栏等高稳定并管理批准、重试、撤销与重做。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置跨 Slack、GitHub、Google Drive 与 Linear 共 6 项夜间事件的离线简报。

props.name: with_events
props.default: 2 待确认 + 1 失败 + 3 已完成
props.description: 传入包含归一化时间点、聚合计数、应用徽标与自定义动作文案的事件列表。

props.name: with_window
props.description: 配置离线窗口起止时间与持续时长胶囊。

props.name: with_limit
props.description: 设置每栏最多展示的卡片数，并为三栏预留一致高度。

props.name: with_replay_ms
props.description: 首次展开时波峰曲线从左向右绘制的动画毫秒数（0 表示立即呈现）。

motion: 打开时 PathBuilder 波峰曲线自左向右顺滑展开并依次点亮橙色、红色与中性事件圆点。
悬停圆点会绘制贯穿高度的准星线与浮层提示并高亮对应卡片；执行动作后在固定 90px 卡高内原位切换结果徽标与撤销按钮。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_recap::AgentRecap 导入；执行 kui add agent-recap 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_recap::AgentRecap 导入。
建议将同类批量完成项合并为带 `.with_count(38)` 的单张卡片；容器窄于 640px 时三栏自动垂直堆叠。

lead.en: Watch incoming requests flow into a router agent, settle on a specialist with a confidence score, light up that specialist's card, and drop into its queue—or escalate uncertain requests to a Human fallback.
lead.zh: 实时呈现请求分流全过程：新请求流入中央路由智能体，计算各专项置信度后点亮目标卡片并落入下方任务队列；低置信度请求自动向右转交人工坐席。

rule.en: Click + New request to route live traffic (including low-confidence Human escalations), click a specialist card to filter its queue, or click any request to view per-agent scores and manually reroute.
rule.zh: 点击“+ 模拟新请求”触发实时分流与低置信度人工升级，点击专项卡片筛选队列，或点击任一请求查看候选评分并手动改派。

when: Support inboxes, help desks, or triage pipelines where a classifier agent dispatches incoming emails, tickets, or chats across specialist agents and a human fallback.
Explaining routing decisions transparently—showing confidence percentages, candidate score breakdowns, and manual rerouting one click away.
not: A single lead splitting subtasks inside one project run—use AgentCrew or AgentTree instead.
Full conversational inbox reading and replying—use AgentInboxBoard instead.
en.apiLead: AgentRouter coordinates two-stage incoming-to-router-to-specialist light pulses via pro_connector_pulse, directional arrival washes, live task queues, and a per-candidate score & reroute dialog.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a Support inbox router with Billing, Tech support, Sales queues, and a Human fallback.

props.name: with_router
props.description: Configure the central classifier agent's name, model, and status text.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Configure specialist target cards and optional RouterAgent::human_fallback.

props.name: with_requests
props.description: Supply incoming and queued requests with confidence scores, rationales, and tags.

props.name: reroute_request
props.type: (&mut self, impl Into<SharedString>, impl Into<SharedString>, &mut Context<Self>)
props.description: Move a request to another specialist or Human fallback and animate the new pulse.

motion: Two-stage light pulses travel from the incoming card into Router and down soft blue S-bends to wash the target card with a directional gradient glow; reduced motion settles routing states immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_router::AgentRouter (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_router::AgentRouter after running kui add agent-router.
Route low-confidence requests to a RouterAgent::human_fallback endpoint with RouterRequestStatus::Escalated.

when: 客服收件箱、工单台或请求分拣流水线，由分流智能体决定每条邮件、聊天或工单交给哪个专项智能体或人工坐席。
需要透明展示分流依据：一眼看清置信度百分比、每个候选智能体的匹配得分，并支持一键手动改派。
not: 单个主控智能体在同一项目内拆分子任务——请改用 AgentCrew 或 AgentTree。
完整阅读和回复工单会话的工作台——请改用 AgentInboxBoard。
zh.apiLead: AgentRouter 基于 pro_connector_pulse 驱动“入站请求 → 路由中心 → 专项队列 / 人工兜底”两段式光脉冲，配合目标卡片方向性微光、底部任务队列及候选评分改派弹窗。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含账单、技术支持、销售三个专项队列及人工兜底通道的智能客服分流台。

props.name: with_router
props.description: 配置中央路由智能体的名称、模型与当前状态描述。

props.name: with_agents
props.description: 配置底部专项智能体列及右侧 RouterAgent::human_fallback 人工通道。

props.name: with_requests
props.description: 传入包含来源渠道、置信度、各候选评分与标签的请求列表。

props.name: reroute_request
props.type: (&mut self, impl Into<SharedString>, impl Into<SharedString>, &mut Context<Self>)
props.description: 将指定请求改派至新的专项智能体或人工坐席并触发连线脉冲。

motion: 两段式光脉冲先流入路由中心再沿蓝色圆角连线抵达目标卡片并泛起渐变光晕，路由过程伴随流光文案与置信度弹簧条；开启减少动效时即时落入队列。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_router::AgentRouter 导入；执行 kui add agent-router 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_router::AgentRouter 导入。
对于置信度不足的请求，可将其指向 RouterAgent::human_fallback 并标记为 Escalated。

lead.en: Trace who called whom in a multi-agent run with UML lifelines, activation bars, solid calls, dashed replies, par/retry frames, and click-to-inspect cards.
lead.zh: 以交互式 UML 序列图还原多智能体运行全貌：生命线激活条、实线调用与虚线返回箭头、par/retry 组合帧、流光绘入动效及点击详情卡。

rule.en: Click any participant chip on top or any message tag along the lifelines—or walk messages with Up and Down arrow keys—to open its role, payload, and round-trip timing card.
rule.zh: 点击顶部任意参与者胶囊或生命线间的消息标签（或按上下方向键漫游），即可弹出查看其模型职责、请求载荷与往返耗时。

when: Debugging multi-agent runs message by message: seeing which call waited on which reply, what ran inside a parallel frame, and where a retry or failure occurred.
Live execution views where new agent-to-agent and agent-to-tool messages draw across in real time.
not: Proportional duration waveforms on a horizontal time axis (use AgentTiming) or 30-minute fleet swimlanes (use AgentLanes).
en.apiLead: AgentSequence pairs Call and Reply messages into lifeline activation bars, groups adjacent framed messages into labelled par/retry boxes, and opens floating dialog cards.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 6-lifeline UML sequence diagram (You, Lead, Researcher, Coder, GitHub, Vercel) with 9 messages.

props.name: with_participants
props.description: Configure left-to-right columns for operators, agents (with model badges), and tools (with provider marks).

props.name: with_messages
props.description: Supply chronological calls, replies (with reply_to), self-loops, par/retry frames, and detail payloads.

props.name: with_running
props.description: Keep open activation bars shimmering and busy agent pixel marks twinkling while the run is active.

props.name: with_times
props.description: Show or hide the left elapsed timestamp gutter.

motion: Arrows fade directionally from sender to receiver and draw across with a glowing tip streak and landing ripple, open activation bars sweep a vertical glint, and inspection dialogs animate via pro_presence; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_sequence::AgentSequence (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_sequence::AgentSequence after running kui add agent-sequence.
Link replies via SeqMessage::reply(..., reply_to, ...) so receiver activation bars close automatically and message cards report round-trip duration.

when: 逐条排查多智能体协作链路：理清哪个调用在等待哪个返回、哪些请求在 par 帧中并行发出、何处触发了失败与 retry 重试。
实时运行监控视图，每条新增的智能体间或工具调用消息都会带着前端微光动态绘入。
not: 按真实时间比例对比信号高低的逻辑波形（请使用 AgentTiming），或长周期多智能体泳道（请使用 AgentLanes）。
zh.apiLead: AgentSequence 自动配对调用与返回以生成生命线激活条，聚合相邻帧标签生成 par/retry 框，并提供参与者与消息双维度检视弹窗。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含 You、主控、检索、编码、GitHub 与 Vercel 6 条生命线及 9 条消息的序列图。

props.name: with_participants
props.description: 从左至右定义人类、智能体（带模型标签）与外部工具（带品牌图标）生命线。

props.name: with_messages
props.description: 按发生顺序传入调用、返回（含 reply_to）、自调用回环、par/retry 帧标识与详情载荷。

props.name: with_running
props.description: 运行未结束时为未闭合激活条保持纵向流光并使智能体像素章闪烁。

props.name: with_times
props.description: 显示或隐藏左侧相对时间戳栏。

motion: 箭头由发送端淡出至接收端实色，新消息携尖端微光横跨绘入并在落点泛起涟漪，未闭合激活条纵向扫光；开启减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_sequence::AgentSequence 导入；执行 kui add agent-sequence 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_sequence::AgentSequence 导入。
为返回消息指定 SeqMessage::reply(..., reply_to, ...) 即可自动闭合接收方激活条并计算往返耗时。

lead.en: Inspect one agent as a live finite-state diagram—forward arrows right, backward loopbacks underneath, self-retries on top, rolling transition counts, an amber human-approval gate, and a bullseye Done state.
lead.zh: 以实时有限状态图呈现单个智能体的运行轨迹：向右前向流转、底部回退闭环、顶部自重试环路、滚动递增的跳转计数、琥珀色人工审批门禁与靶心终止态。

rule.en: Hover any state to isolate its incident transitions, click Step state to watch a light pulse traverse an arrow and roll up its N× count, or click any state or count pill to inspect dwell time, exit reasons, and Approve.
rule.zh: 悬停任一状态高亮关联跳转路径，点击“单步迁移”观察光脉冲沿箭头飞驰并滚动累加计数，点击状态卡或计数胶囊查看驻留耗时、退出原因与人工批准。

when: Showing what state an autonomous coding or research agent is in right now—and how often it looped back between Searching, Coding, Testing, and Waiting.
Debugging retry storms, long dwell times, or human approval pauses in a clean UML-inspired state diagram.
not: Multi-agent routes where several specialists run in parallel across shared interchanges—use AgentMetroMap instead.
Chronological message-by-message tool logs—use AgentToolCalls or AgentThread instead.
en.apiLead: AgentStateMachine lays out grid states responsively, routes forward, top self-loop, and bottom loopback PathBuilder arrows with arrowheads, animates arc-length transition pulses, rolls up N× badges via pro_rolling_number, and opens state and transition inspectors.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 6-state, 9-transition diagram for Atlas (Claude Opus 5.5) centered on Coding.

props.name: with_states
props.description: Configure Normal, Waiting, Error, and Final bullseye states with grid coordinates, tools, and dwell metrics.

props.name: with_transitions
props.description: Configure forward, self-retry (from == to), and backward transitions with trigger labels and counts.

props.name: fire_transition
props.description: Traverse a transition by id, increment its count, update dwell time, and launch a pulse.

props.name: resolve_waiting_state
props.description: Approve or reject an active Waiting gate and advance or return to Planning.

motion: Traversing a transition sends an arc-length comet pulse along its PathBuilder curve while rolling its N× pill upward via pro_rolling_number; reduced motion switches states immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_state_machine::AgentStateMachine (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_state_machine::AgentStateMachine after running kui add agent-state-machine.
Place the start state first in with_states(...) so the entry dot points to it automatically.

when: 直观展示单个编程或调研智能体当前所处状态，以及它在检索、编码、测试与等待确认之间循环往复的次数。
在类 UML 状态图中排查重试循环、耗时瓶颈或直接放行人工审批卡点。
not: 多个智能体并行推进并在换乘站交汇的多线流程——请改用 AgentMetroMap。
按时间顺序逐条阅读工具调用与对话消息——请改用 AgentToolCalls 或 AgentThread。
zh.apiLead: AgentStateMachine 自适应排布状态网格，基于 PathBuilder 绘制前向箭头、顶部自重试环路与底部回退通道，驱动弧长参数化光脉冲并通过 pro_rolling_number 翻滚计数，同时提供驻留耗时与退出原因检查器。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含 6 个核心状态与 9 条迁移路径的 Atlas（Claude Opus 5.5）状态机。

props.name: with_states
props.description: 配置常规、等待确认、异常与靶心终止态，包含网格行列、关联工具与驻留时长。

props.name: with_transitions
props.description: 配置前向、自环重试（from == to）与反向回退边及其触发原因和次数。

props.name: fire_transition
props.description: 触发指定迁移边，累加计数与驻留耗时并发射沿线光脉冲。

props.name: resolve_waiting_state
props.description: 批准或拒绝处于等待确认状态的门禁，继续向后推进或回退重规划。

motion: 状态跳转时沿 PathBuilder 路径发射等速彗星脉冲，同时通过 pro_rolling_number 翻滚递增胶囊计数；开启减少动效时直接切换状态。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_state_machine::AgentStateMachine 导入；执行 kui add agent-state-machine 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_state_machine::AgentStateMachine 导入。
将起始状态放在 with_states(...) 列表首位，左侧起始圆点会自动指向该状态。

lead.en: Steer an agent while it works—queue a correction for the next step and watch it glide into the plan when the current step finishes, or interrupt right away.
lead.zh: 在智能体执行途中优雅纠偏：可将指令排入下一步队列并观察其随步骤切换平滑滑入计划，也可立即中断当前步即时注入。

rule.en: Press Enter to queue a note for the next step, press ⌘↵ (or click Now on a queued chip) to interrupt the active step immediately, and pause or resume from the header.
rule.zh: 按 Enter 将指令排入下一步队列，按 ⌘↵（或点击队列胶囊上的“立即”）即刻中断当前步骤注入指令，顶栏支持暂停与恢复。

when: Long-running agent plans where nudging the next step is far cheaper than aborting and starting over.
Audit-friendly execution traces that keep each user instruction visibly attached to the exact step it altered.
not: Approving a static plan before execution begins—use ReviewCenter instead.
Single-turn chat answers without a multi-step plan—use RunControls or ResponseStream instead.
en.apiLead: AgentSteering pairs a ticking step-by-step plan with a queued note tray and Editor composer, emitting Queued, Interrupted, Removed, StatusChanged, and StepAdvanced events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an AgentSteering card preloaded with the 5-step Migrate users table plan and one queued note.

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Supply Done, Active, and Pending plan steps with durations and absorbed notes.

props.name: with_queue
props.description: Preload steering notes waiting in the Queued for the next step tray.

props.name: with_status
props.description: Set the initial run state (Running, Paused, Done).

props.name: with_auto_tick
props.description: Automatically tick step durations and advance steps so queued notes glide into the plan live.

motion: When the active step finishes, queued notes glide smoothly into the newly active step over 620ms and settle with a soft blue highlight border.
Active step titles sweep via pro_shimmer_text and the queue tray expands/collapses via pro_fold without jumps; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_steering::AgentSteering (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_steering::AgentSteering after running kui add agent-steering.
Call advance_step(cx) when driving steps externally to move queued notes cleanly into the next pending step.

when: 耗时较长的多步智能体任务：在下一步切入前微调约束，避免推倒重跑浪费上下文。
需要在执行轨迹中清晰保留“哪条人工指令改动了哪一步”的可追溯工作流。
not: 运行开始前对计划做一次性签批——请使用 ReviewCenter。
不含分步计划的单轮流式问答控制——请使用 RunControls 或 ResponseStream。
zh.apiLead: AgentSteering 将实时推进的分步计划、待采纳指令队列与 Editor 输入框融为一体，派发 Queued、Interrupted、Removed、StatusChanged 与 StepAdvanced 事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 5 步“Migrate users table”计划及 1 条待采纳指令的纠偏卡片。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 设置包含 Done、Active、Pending 状态与已吸收备注的步骤列表。

props.name: with_queue
props.description: 预置等待下一步采纳的引导指令胶囊。

props.name: with_status
props.description: 设置运行状态（Running、Paused、Done）。

props.name: with_auto_tick
props.description: 自动推进步骤计时并在步骤完成时将队列指令平滑吸入下一步。

motion: 当前步完成时，排队指令会在 620ms 内平滑滑入新激活步骤，并伴随柔和蓝色高亮边框落位。
执行中步骤通过 pro_shimmer_text 流光提示，队列区通过 pro_fold 平滑折叠不跳高；减少动效模式下自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_steering::AgentSteering 导入；执行 kui add agent-steering 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_steering::AgentSteering 导入。
外部驱动任务时可调用 advance_step(cx)，自动将待采纳指令转入下一个待执行步骤。

title.zh: 智能体硬件逻辑时序图

lead.en: Visualize a multi-agent run as a hardware-logic timing diagram with rounded step waveforms, gradient fills, dashed amber waiting states, and vertical handoffs.
lead.zh: 以硬件逻辑分析仪风格呈现多智能体运行时序：圆角阶跃信号线、纵向渐变填充、虚线琥珀等待态、脉冲此刻点与跨行交接虚线。

rule.en: Point at any step waveform or vertical hand-off wire—or focus the diagram and use the arrow keys—to inspect participant state, tool names, and exact timing.
rule.zh: 悬停任意阶跃波形段或跨行交接虚线（或使用方向键漫游），即可查看参与者状态、工具名称与精确起止时长。

when: Pinpointing where a multi-agent run spends or loses time—long tool calls, idle gaps, or waiting on human approval.
Live diagnostic views alongside chat logs where You and multiple specialist agents coordinate.
not: Message-by-message call/reply ordering without a proportional time axis (use AgentSequence).
en.apiLead: AgentTiming synthesizes continuous rounded step-waveforms from second-based intervals, paints vertical gradient washes and dashed handoffs via PathBuilder, and surfaces hover/keyboard step cards.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 6-row timing diagram (You, Lead, Coder, Tester, Reviewer, Docs) on Fix the cart total.

props.name: with_participants
props.description: Define signal rows for operators (full 3x3 ink mark) and agents (palette-colored pixel marks).

props.name: with_segments
props.description: Supply Thinking (low), Tool (high with tool label), and Waiting (dashed amber) intervals in seconds.

props.name: with_handoffs
props.description: Draw vertical dashed hand-off arrows with landing dots between participant rows.

props.name: with_now
props.description: Current run time in seconds; open segments without an end stretch to now.

motion: PathBuilder connects touching segments with smooth cubic S-steps over soft vertical gradient fills, pulsing dots breathe where active steps meet the now cursor, and handoff wires draw in as now crosses them; Theme::reduced_motion stops pulses and pixel twinkle.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_timing::AgentTiming (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_timing::AgentTiming after running kui add agent-timing.
Pass start, end, at, and now in seconds from run start, leaving TimingSegment::end as None while a step is still running.

when: 诊断多智能体运行瓶颈：直观识别耗时较长的工具调用、空闲等待间隙以及等待人工确认的时段。
在对话流旁实时展示人类用户与多位专业智能体的并行协同节奏。
not: 仅关注请求/响应消息先后顺序与嵌套帧而非真实时间比例（请使用 AgentSequence）。
zh.apiLead: AgentTiming 将秒级区间合成为连续圆角阶跃波形，通过 PathBuilder 绘制纵向渐变底色与跨行交接虚线，并提供悬停与键盘浮层读数。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含 You、主控、编码、测试、审查与文档 6 行信号的时序波形图。

props.name: with_participants
props.description: 配置参与者行：人类显示实心 3×3 像素章，智能体显示专属配色像素标识。

props.name: with_segments
props.description: 传入以秒为单位的思考（低电平）、工具调用（高电平带工具名）与等待确认（琥珀虚线）区间。

props.name: with_handoffs
props.description: 定义参与者之间的纵向虚线交接信号与落点圆点。

props.name: with_now
props.description: 设置当前运行秒数，未结束的区间将平滑延伸至此时间线。

motion: 相邻信号通过三次贝塞尔圆角阶跃无缝衔接并配纵向渐变填充，正在运行的波形末端在此刻线上呼吸脉冲，交接虚线随时间推进动态绘出；开启减少动效时停止闪烁与脉冲。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_timing::AgentTiming 导入；执行 kui add agent-timing 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_timing::AgentTiming 导入。
时间参数均采用自运行启动起算的秒数；正在执行中的区间保持 end 为 None 即可自动随 now 延伸。

lead.en: Display an agent's execution steps on a quiet vertical trail with 3/5 completion count, S-curved sub-steps, a traveling light pulse, and dashed amber approval gates.
lead.zh: 在静谧纵向轨迹上展示智能体执行进度（如 3/5）、S 形分支子步骤、沿轨游走的微光脉冲与虚线琥珀色审批门禁。

rule.en: Click or press Enter / Space on steps with sub-steps to fold their branch spine open or closed, and click Approval / Needs you to inspect and Approve or Decline gated steps.
rule.zh: 点击或按 Enter / Space 展开或收起带子任务的分支轨道；点击需审批步骤即可展开说明并执行批准或拒绝。

when: Inline chat answers, side panels, or task cards showing what an agent has completed, what it is doing right now, and what comes next.
Multi-step plans containing human-in-the-loop approval gates such as opening a pull request, sending emails, or charging a customer.
not: Editing a plan before execution starts (use AgentPlan) or inspecting per-call latency and token cost waterfalls (use TraceWaterfall).
en.apiLead: AgentTrail manages step and sub-step disclosure, automatic folding for long sub-task lists, live elapsed timers, and inline gate approval actions.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an AgentTrail preloaded with the Fix the checkout crash 5-step run (3/5 done).

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Supply ordered steps with states, circular tool marks, durations, sub-steps, and approval gates.

props.name: with_title
props.description: Set the task title displayed in the header bar before the agent chip and done/total ratio.

props.name: with_agent
props.description: Configure or hide the model/agent attribution chip in the header.

props.name: without_header
props.description: Omit the header bar when embedding inside an outer card that already names the task.

motion: A front-weighted fading blue light pulse travels from the running step down the cubic S-bend wire into the active sub-step and blooms an arrival ring while the running arc spins and status shimmers; Theme::reduced_motion turns continuous motion off.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_trail::AgentTrail (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_trail::AgentTrail after running kui add agent-trail.
Give each TrailStep a stable id and keep status to a concise present-participle word such as Testing or Editing.

when: 在对话回复、侧边栏或任务卡中轻量展示智能体已完成步骤、当前子任务进展以及后续计划。
包含人工审批关卡（如发起 PR、外发邮件或扣款确认）的智能体流程，提前预告停顿位置。
not: 执行前编辑计划步骤（请使用 AgentPlan）或逐条排查调用耗时与成本瀑布图（请使用 TraceWaterfall）。
zh.apiLead: AgentTrail 内置步骤与子步骤折叠动画、长子步骤列表智能收折、实时秒表计时以及行内审批交互，并发出强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载“修复结算页崩溃” 5 步轨迹（已完成 3/5）的组件实例。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 传入有序步骤列表，支持工具圆章、耗时、嵌套子步骤与审批门禁配置。

props.name: with_title
props.description: 设置顶栏左侧展示的任务标题文案。

props.name: with_agent
props.description: 配置或隐藏顶栏中的智能体/模型标识胶囊。

props.name: without_header
props.description: 嵌入已有标题的外部容器时隐藏自身顶栏。

motion: 前端高亮、尾部渐隐的微光沿 S 形分支轨道流向当前运行子步骤并触发圆环涟漪，同时主步骤圆弧旋转、状态词流光闪烁；开启减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_trail::AgentTrail 导入；执行 kui add agent-trail 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_trail::AgentTrail 导入。
请为每个 TrailStep 提供稳定的 id，并将运行中 status 保持为精炼动词（如 Testing / 测试中）。

lead.en: Trace who started whom across an autonomous run—every card shows status, live elapsed time, own spend, and rolled-up branch cost, with branches that fold smoothly to a single summary line.
lead.zh: 清晰呈现多智能体调用链路：每张节点卡实时展示状态、运行耗时、自身花费与向上汇总的分支总成本，支持将任意子树平滑折叠为单行摘要。

rule.en: Click any branch count chevron to fold its sub-agents into one summary row, click + Step spend to watch branch costs roll up, or open 1 needs you to approve waiting agents.
rule.zh: 点击卡片右下角的子智能体数量按钮即可将该分支收折为单行摘要，点击“+ 模拟计费”观察花费沿父级实时滚动累加，或点击“待确认”直接审批。

when: Multi-agent runs where one orchestrator delegates subtasks to specialists—and those specialists spawn sub-agents of their own.
Spotting at a glance which branch is still running, which branch waits on human approval, and where run spend is accumulating.
not: Comparing several independent lead orchestrators side by side—use AgentFleet instead.
Visualizing high-frequency tool calls across shared services as an orbital network—use AgentGraph instead.
en.apiLead: AgentTree recursively rolls up branch costs with pro_rolling_number, folds subtrees via pro_fold into single-line summaries, and surfaces waiting or failed nodes in an actionable header popover.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 7-node pricing launch orchestrator tree with live elapsed clocks and branch cost rollups.

props.name: with_root
props.description: Supply a custom root orchestrator and nested TreeAgent hierarchy.

props.name: with_default_collapsed
props.description: Specify branch ids that start folded to a single summary row.

props.name: toggle_branch
props.description: Fold or unfold a branch by id and emit CollapsedChanged.

props.name: resolve_agent
props.description: Approve, reject, retry, or dismiss a waiting or failed agent node.

motion: Branch costs micro-roll upward via pro_rolling_number as child spend grows; subtrees fold and unfold via pro_fold while rounded blue connectors track card bounds continuously.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_tree::AgentTree (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_tree::AgentTree after running kui add agent-tree.
Provide each TreeAgent's own cost—AgentTree sums child costs into every ancestor card and the header bar automatically.

when: 单个主控编排器将复杂目标拆解给多个子智能体，且子智能体继续派生下级执行器的多层级运行场景。
需要一眼看清哪条分支仍在运行、哪条分支卡在人工确认、以及哪条分支消耗了最多预算。
not: 并排对比多个独立主控编队的总览面板——请改用 AgentFleet。
展示多个智能体频繁共享调用外部工具与数据库的拓扑网络——请改用 AgentGraph。
zh.apiLead: AgentTree 通过 pro_rolling_number 自动向上递归汇总每条分支的花费，通过 pro_fold 将任意子树平滑折叠为单行摘要，并在顶栏聚合所有待审批与失败节点。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建包含 7 个节点的定价页上线编排树，内置实时计时与分支成本汇总。

props.name: with_root
props.description: 传入自定义主控节点及其递归子智能体结构。

props.name: with_default_collapsed
props.description: 指定初始折叠为单行摘要的分支节点 id 集合。

props.name: toggle_branch
props.description: 按节点 id 折叠或展开子树并发出 CollapsedChanged 事件。

props.name: resolve_agent
props.description: 对等待确认或失败的节点执行批准、拒绝、重试或忽略。

motion: 当子节点花费增长时，各级祖先节点的分支总计通过 pro_rolling_number 平滑翻滚更新；子树通过 pro_fold 收折展开，圆角连线逐帧跟随卡片位置。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_tree::AgentTree 导入；执行 kui add agent-tree 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_tree::AgentTree 导入。
每个 TreeAgent 只需填写自身花费 cost，组件会自动计算所有父级分支与全局总计。

lead.en: Show one active agent at work on one request: the requester and prompt on the left, the live agent with its three-row step log in the middle, attached files under a macOS folder on the right, and connected tools below—linked by rounded wires with a traveling light pulse.
lead.zh: 直观呈现单个智能体处理一次请求的全景：左侧提问人与提示词、中央智能体与三行实时工作区、右侧 macOS 文件夹及附件列表、下方已连接工具卡片，并以带流动光脉冲的圆角连线串联。

rule.en: Click the agent, any attached file, or any tool card to open its permissions and per-request activity popover (Esc to close), or step through live execution to watch the light pulse move across active connectors.
rule.zh: 点击中央智能体、右侧任一附件或下方工具卡片展开权限与本次调用详情（按 Esc 关闭），或单步/自动推进以观察光脉冲沿活动连线流动。

when: Showing one assistant working across mail, calendar, and uploaded files on a single user prompt so people see what it touches right now.
Pairing a live visual architecture view beside a chat thread or onboarding walkthrough.
not: Multiple agents delegating subtasks to one another—use AgentCrew or AgentTree instead.
Managing long-term remembered facts and connected integrations over time—use MemoryGraph instead.
en.apiLead: AgentWorkbench coordinates requester, agent, macOS folder attachments, tool permission cards, measured wire endpoints, and detail popovers while emitting typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an AgentWorkbench preloaded with Ryan Brooks' calendar + Q4 budget request across Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive.

props.name: with_user
props.description: Configure the requester's name, presence dot, and prompt bubble on the left.

props.name: with_agent
props.description: Set the central agent's deterministic mark seed, display name, subtitle, and popover facts.

props.name: with_files
props.description: Provide attached files (Excel, Word, PDF, or generic) shown under the macOS blue folder.

props.name: with_tools
props.description: Provide connected tool cards with scopes, last actions, and detail metadata.

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Supply controlled chronological steps targeting "user", "files", or a tool id.

motion: Rounded orthogonal connectors carry a glowing light pulse along whichever target is currently running, framed by hollow endpoint ports.
Running steps shimmer via pro_shimmer_text while keeping a steady 3-row work area height; detail popovers settle via pro_presence and respect Theme::reduced_motion.
ai: Import from kui::components::agent_workbench::AgentWorkbench (library) or crate::ui::components::agent_workbench::AgentWorkbench after running kui add agent-workbench.
Set WorkbenchStep::at to "user", "files", or a matching WorkbenchTool::id so the connector pulse routes to the right card.

when: 展示单个智能助手围绕一条用户指令跨邮件、日历与上传附件协同工作的实时过程，让用户清楚看到它正在读取或调用什么。
在对话侧栏或产品引导页直观展示智能体的权限边界与实时执行连线。
not: 多个智能体相互委派与汇总任务（请使用 AgentCrew 或 AgentTree）。
管理跨会话的长期记忆条目与工具开关（请使用 MemoryGraph）。
zh.apiLead: AgentWorkbench 统一编排提问人卡片、智能体实时三行工作区、macOS 文件夹附件列表、工具权限卡片、精确测量的圆角脉冲连线与详情浮层。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 Ryan Brooks 约会与 Q4 预算发送场景（含 Gmail、Google Calendar、Google Drive）的空间工作台。

props.name: with_user
props.description: 设置左侧提问人的姓名、在线状态点与提示词气泡内容。

props.name: with_agent
props.description: 设置中央智能体的像素徽标种子、名称、账户副标题与详情属性。

props.name: with_files
props.description: 传入右侧 macOS 蓝色文件夹下的附件列表（自动匹配 Excel、Word、PDF 图标）。

props.name: with_tools
props.description: 传入底部工具卡片列表，包含权限范围、上次动作与详情元数据。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 传入受控的时序执行步骤，通过 at 指向 "user"、"files" 或工具 ID。

motion: 当前运行步骤对应的圆角正交连线上会有柔和光脉冲流动，并在两端配以空心端口圆环。
运行中的步骤通过 pro_shimmer_text 呈现流光扫掠，工作区固定三行高度避免跳动；开启减少动效时立即停驻。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::agent_workbench::AgentWorkbench 导入；执行 kui add agent-workbench 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::agent_workbench::AgentWorkbench 导入。
将 WorkbenchStep::at 设为 "user"、"files" 或对应 WorkbenchTool::id，即可自动点亮对应连线与文件行。

lead.en: Ask before an agent acts—with a risk badge, recipient preview, keyboard shortcuts, a live countdown ring that pauses on hover or focus, and a smooth morph into a resolved row.
lead.zh: 在智能体执行关键动作前请求确认：提供风险徽标、收件人与参数预览、快捷键、悬停自动暂停的倒计时圆环，以及平滑收折的已处理状态行。

rule.en: Hover or focus the card to pause the countdown ring, check Always allow to remember trust, press ⌘↵ to approve or Esc to deny, and click Undo on the resolved row to replay.
rule.zh: 鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时倒计时圆环自动暂停，勾选“始终允许”记住授权，按 ⌘↵ 批准或按 Esc 拒绝，完成后可点击撤销重放。

when: An agent is about to perform an external, paid, or hard-to-undo action—sending customer emails, deleting records, or spending money—and needs explicit human consent.
Single pending tool calls embedded in a chat thread or run log that should expire safely when unanswered.
not: Stacked multi-step approval queues across an active agent run—use ApprovalGates instead.
Harmless, easily reversible read actions where immediate execution with undo is faster.
en.apiLead: ApprovalCard manages countdown suspension on hover/focus, persistent trust checkboxes, optional inline subject editing, and spring folding into a compact resolved row.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an ApprovalCard preloaded with the October campaign email scene and 45s countdown.

props.name: with_risk
props.description: Display a Low, Medium, or High risk badge in the card header, or None to hide it.

props.name: with_recipients
props.description: Configure overlapping person avatars and overflow count at the top of the preview panel.

props.name: with_details
props.description: Supply structured key-value rows describing exact tool arguments.

props.name: with_expires_in
props.description: Seconds until automatic timeout denial; pauses while hovered or focused.

motion: Approving, denying, or expiring folds the pending card and tray footer smoothly into a 48px resolved status row via pro_fold while popping in the outcome glyph.
The circular PathBuilder countdown ring inside Approve sweeps smoothly and freezes immediately on pointer hover or keyboard focus; Theme::reduced_motion snaps transitions.
ai: Import from kui::components::approval_card::ApprovalCard (library) or crate::ui::components::approval_card::ApprovalCard after running kui add approval-card.
Below 400px width, Deny and Approve share a full-width row and hide kbd badges; below 340px, the risk pill condenses to Low / Medium / High.

when: 智能体即将执行对外发送邮件、扣款、删除数据或上线部署等难以撤销的操作，需先经人工明确同意。
嵌入在聊天流或运行日志中的单条工具调用请求，无人响应时可自动超时安全拒绝。
not: 同一运行中连续阻塞后续步骤的多张待审批卡堆叠（请使用 ApprovalGates）。
无副作用、随时可回退的只读或草稿类操作。
zh.apiLead: ApprovalCard 管理悬停与聚焦倒计时暂停、“始终允许”勾选状态、可选行内主题编辑及向紧凑结果行的弹簧收折，并派发强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置十月产品通讯邮件审批场景与 45 秒倒计时的审批卡。

props.name: with_risk
props.description: 在卡片右上角显示低、中、高风险徽标，传 None 则隐藏。

props.name: with_recipients
props.description: 配置预览区顶部的重叠收件人头像及剩余人数胶囊。

props.name: with_details
props.description: 传入结构化键值预览行以展示具体调用参数。

props.name: with_expires_in
props.description: 自动超时拒绝前的秒数；鼠标悬停或聚焦时自动暂停计时。

motion: 点击批准、拒绝或超时后通过 pro_fold 将待审批卡片平滑折叠为 48px 结果行，并弹出状态图标。
Approve 按钮内的 PathBuilder 倒计时圆环实时平滑缩减并在悬停或聚焦时即时冻结；开启减少动效时直接切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::approval_card::ApprovalCard 导入；执行 kui add approval-card 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::approval_card::ApprovalCard 导入。
容器窄于 400px 时按钮自动平分整行并隐藏快捷键提示；窄于 340px 时风险胶囊自动精简文案。

lead.en: Work through an agent run's pending approvals as a stacked card deck—inspect the requester, diff, and held steps on top, edit inline before approving, and watch resolved gates settle into the Decided log.
lead.zh: 以层叠卡片组处理智能体运行中的待审批请求：顶卡聚焦展示发起方、代码差异与受阻步骤，支持行内修改后批准，处理完毕自动归入下方已决定列表。

rule.en: Approve, Reject, or click Edit (⌘↵ to approve with changes) on the front card, press Left and Right arrows or click peeking cards to switch open gates, and click any Decided row to inspect its payload.
rule.zh: 在顶层卡片点击批准、拒绝或修改后批准（按 ⌘↵ 确认），按左右方向键或点击后方露出的卡片切换请求，点击下方已决定行展开详情。

when: Human-in-the-loop agent runs that pause on file diffs, database migrations, sub-agent spawns, or outbound messages while holding dependent downstream steps.
Sequential review workflows where operators decide several pending gates one after another and retain an expandable audit trail below.
not: Configuring upfront autonomy levels across action categories—use AutonomyDial instead.
One standalone chat confirmation bubble with an expiration timer—use ApprovalCard instead.
en.apiLead: ApprovalGates coordinates stacked open cards, inline multi-line payload editing, downstream held-step tallies, and an expandable Decided audit list with typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an ApprovalGates deck preloaded with 2 open gates (pricing diff + trial email) and 1 decided migration.

props.name: with_gates
props.description: Supply open and decided gates with diffs, inputs, prior context steps, and held downstream steps.

props.name: with_task
props.description: Set or hide the muted run task title in the top summary bar.

props.name: with_live
props.description: Show Running status once all open gates clear, or Completed when false.

props.name: decide
props.description: Programmatically resolve an open gate as Approved, Edited, or Rejected.

motion: Resolving the front gate drops it into Decided while the next card in the deck rises forward smoothly via Slide springs; rejecting triggers a crisp horizontal micro-shake.
Waiting counts roll via pro_rolling_number and Full context / Decided rows expand via pro_fold while keeping deck floor height steady; Theme::reduced_motion disables motion.
ai: Import from kui::components::approval_gates::ApprovalGates (library) or crate::ui::components::approval_gates::ApprovalGates after running kui add approval-gates.
Keep rejected gates in the Decided list rather than removing them so operators always see where a run halted.

when: 人机协同智能体运行在遇到文件修改、数据库迁移、子代理调度或外发消息时暂停审批，并清晰展示被阻塞的下游步骤。
需要逐张审阅多项待批请求，并在下方保留可展开审计记录的工作流。
not: 事前按风险等级设定智能体的整体自主运行权限（请使用 AutonomyDial）。
单条带超时倒计时的聊天内动作确认卡（请使用 ApprovalCard）。
zh.apiLead: ApprovalGates 统一管理层叠待审卡片、行内多行参数编辑、受阻下游步骤统计与可展开历史审计列表，并派发强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 2 张待审卡（定价差异与试用邮件）及 1 条已批准迁移记录的审批关卡栈。

props.name: with_gates
props.description: 传入包含代码差异、输入载荷、前置上下文与受阻下游步骤的关卡列表。

props.name: with_task
props.description: 设置或隐藏顶部概览栏中的运行任务名称。

props.name: with_live
props.description: 当所有待审卡清空后显示“运行中”（true）或“全部通过”（false）。

props.name: decide
props.description: 通过代码将指定待审关卡标记为已批准、已修改批准或已拒绝。

motion: 处理顶层卡片后该卡落入下方已决定列表，下一张卡片通过 Slide 弹簧平滑升起；拒绝时带有克制的横向微震反馈。
待处理计数通过 pro_rolling_number 滚动更新，完整上下文与历史行通过 pro_fold 展开；开启减少动效时立即切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::approval_gates::ApprovalGates 导入；执行 kui add approval-gates 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::approval_gates::ApprovalGates 导入。
被拒绝的关卡应保留在已决定列表中并标注“已中止运行”，方便追溯运行停驻位置。

lead.en: Set how much an agent may do on its own—pick Always ask, If risky, or Full auto and watch real workspace actions glide between Runs on its own and Asks you first, with padlocks for what always asks.
lead.zh: 直观设定智能体自主执行边界：切换“每次询问 / 有风险时询问 / 全自动”三档拨盘，真实工作区动作实时在“自主运行”与“先询问你”之间平滑迁移，并支持单项挂锁。

rule.en: Click Always ask, If risky, or Full auto (or use Left and Right arrows) to move actions between groups, and click any row's padlock to pin it to Asks you first.
rule.zh: 点击三档自主等级或按左右方向键查看动作归属变化，悬停任一动作并点击右侧挂锁将其固定在“先询问你”。

when: Agent settings and onboarding screens where people choose how much trust to grant an agent before its first run.
Making abstract permission tiers concrete by showing the exact Notion, Gmail, HubSpot, Drive, and Stripe operations in each bucket.
not: Approving a single pending tool call right before execution—use ApprovalCard instead.
Flat lists of unrelated feature toggles that have no shared autonomy levels.
en.apiLead: AutonomyDial pairs a spring-gliding three-stop selector with live action partitioning, per-row padlock overrides, non-negotiable red-line locks, and exported asks_first evaluation.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an AutonomyDial preloaded with 6 Sales agent actions and Spend money locked.

props.name: with_level
props.description: Set the initial autonomy level (AlwaysAsk, IfRisky, FullAuto).

props.name: with_actions
props.description: Configure governed actions with Safe, Risky, or Destructive tags, app marks, and red_line policies.

props.name: with_pinned
props.description: Set action ids that start locked to Asks you first regardless of level.

props.name: asks_first
props.description: Evaluate the exact runtime consent rule for any action, level, and lock set.

motion: pro_pill_indicator glides a raised surface pill across the three autonomy stops while crossing actions fold and slide smoothly between Runs on its own and Asks you first.
Group count badges roll tabular digits via pro_rolling_number; Theme::reduced_motion switches groups immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::autonomy_dial::AutonomyDial (library) or crate::ui::components::autonomy_dial::AutonomyDial after running kui add autonomy-dial.
Call kui::components::autonomy_dial::asks_first in your agent executor so UI settings and runtime enforcement never diverge.

when: 智能体设置页或新智能体引导流程，让用户在首次运行前设定信任等级。
需要将抽象权限等级转化为具体可见的 Notion、Gmail、HubSpot、Drive、Stripe 操作清单的场景。
not: 针对单次即将执行的工具调用进行确认（请使用 ApprovalCard）。
彼此独立、不存在统一信任层级的普通开关列表。
zh.apiLead: AutonomyDial 将三档弹簧胶囊选择器与动作实时分组、单项挂锁覆盖、红线强制锁定及导出的 asks_first 判定函数融为一体。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 6 项销售智能体动作且默认锁定“执行资金扣款”的自主度拨盘。

props.name: with_level
props.description: 设置初始自主等级（AlwaysAsk、IfRisky、FullAuto）。

props.name: with_actions
props.description: 配置带安全/有风险/破坏性分级、应用图标与红线策略的动作列表。

props.name: with_pinned
props.description: 指定无论处于何种等级都始终先询问的锁定动作 ID。

props.name: asks_first
props.description: 以同一规则计算任意动作在当前等级与挂锁集合下是否需要先询问用户。

motion: pro_pill_indicator 驱动凸起指示胶囊在三档之间平滑滑动，跨组动作通过 pro_fold 与位移缓动在上下分组间顺滑迁移。
分组数量徽标通过 pro_rolling_number 滚动数字；开启减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::autonomy_dial::AutonomyDial 导入；执行 kui add autonomy-dial 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::autonomy_dial::AutonomyDial 导入。
在智能体执行端直接复用 kui::components::autonomy_dial::asks_first，确保界面配置与实际拦截逻辑完全一致。

lead.en: Place a concise 'While you were away' catch-up card right where you left off in a chat thread—with duration away, Needs you / Failed / Done rows, one action per row, and Got it folding into a one-line divider.
lead.zh: 在聊天线程你离开的位置内嵌“离开期间进展”卡片：汇总离线时长、待确认/失败/已完成事项并提供单行快捷动作，点击“知道了”平滑收折为单行分割线。

rule.en: Click Approve or Retry on any row to resolve it in place without shifting neighboring rows, expand Show 3 more for overflow tasks, and click Got it (or press Esc) to fold into a thread divider.
rule.zh: 点击行内批准或重试原地更新状态而不抖动下方列表，点击展开更多查看折叠项，点击“知道了”或按 Esc 收折为线程分割线。

when: Returning to an active agent chat thread where background work continued while the user was away.
Inline thread catch-ups that prioritize Needs you and Failed items before Done items, then tuck away cleanly into a divider.
not: Full-screen morning fleet dashboards with milestone curves and supervisor trees—use MissionControlBlock instead.
Inspecting multi-file code diffs on a single blocking step—use ApprovalGates instead.
en.apiLead: AwaySummary sorts initial updates by urgency, resolves NeedsYou and Failed rows in place, expands overflow items, and folds smoothly between card and thread divider.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an AwaySummary preloaded with 2h 14m away and 8 thread updates (1 needs you, 1 failed, 6 done).

props.name: with_since_duration
props.description: Set the elapsed absence duration shown next to While you were away.

props.name: with_items
props.description: Supply NeedsYou, Failed, and Done updates with details and optional action overrides.

props.name: with_limit
props.description: Maximum rows shown before revealing the Show N more disclosure.

props.name: with_collapsed
props.description: Start folded into the quiet one-line thread divider.

motion: Pressing Got it or clicking the thread divider cross-folds smoothly between the full card and a 28px hairline pill via pro_fold.
The amber Needs you bullseye breathes gently every 2.4s while unresolved; Theme::reduced_motion disables the pulse.
ai: Import from kui::components::away_summary::AwaySummary (library) or crate::ui::components::away_summary::AwaySummary after running kui add away-summary.
Pass with_thread_chrome(false) when embedding AwaySummary inside your own conversation message list.

when: 回到后台持续运行的智能体聊天线程时，在上次离开的位置快速浏览离线进展。
按“待确认 → 失败 → 已完成”优先级呈现单行动作，并在阅读后收折为轻量分割线的对话流。
not: 带离线事件曲线与主从智能体编队树的全屏总览台（请使用 MissionControlBlock）。
需要逐行审阅代码差异的阻塞式关卡栈（请使用 ApprovalGates）。
zh.apiLead: AwaySummary 自动按紧急度排序初始条目、支持原地无跳动状态更新、超限折叠展开，并在摘要卡与单行分割线间平滑过渡。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置离开 2h 14m 及 8 条任务动态（1 待确认、1 失败、6 已完成）的离线摘要卡。

props.name: with_since_duration
props.description: 设置标题旁显示的离线时长文案。

props.name: with_items
props.description: 注入包含待确认、失败与已完成状态及单行说明的事项列表。

props.name: with_limit
props.description: 出现“展开其余 N 项”前默认展示的行数上限。

props.name: with_collapsed
props.description: 指定初始是否折叠为单行线程分割线。

motion: 点击“知道了”或点击线程分割线胶囊时，通过 pro_fold 在完整摘要卡与 28px 分割线之间顺滑折叠切换。
待确认事项的琥珀色靶心图标以 2.4 秒周期轻柔呼吸；开启减少动效时自动保持静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::away_summary::AwaySummary 导入；执行 kui add away-summary 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::away_summary::AwaySummary 导入。
将组件嵌入你自己的消息流容器时，调用 with_thread_chrome(false) 即可仅渲染摘要卡本体。

lead.en: Follow what collaborating agents say to each other—From → To avatars on every message, tagged Handoff and Question for you badges, clickable file chips that open an inline preview, collapsible structured payload cards, and an @agent composer.
lead.zh: 实时呈现多智能体之间的真实对话：逐条标明发送方与接收方头像、突出显示“任务移交”与“向你提问”徽标、点击附件芯片内联预览表格与文档、支持折叠结构化负载卡片，并可通过底部输入框 @智能体或直接作答。

rule.en: Filter messages by participant, click file chips to preview CSV tables or drafts inline, toggle Details to inspect structured payloads, and use @ or Answer in the composer to reply.
rule.zh: 点击顶部成员标签聚光特定对话，点击文件芯片内联预览 CSV 表格或草稿，展开结构化负载查看调用详情，并在输入框输入 @ 或点击“回答”直接介入。

when: Multi-agent runs where users want to read actual inter-agent handoffs, shared files, and reasoning rather than only a static spawn tree.
Human-in-the-loop collaboration feeds where questions for the user are tagged in amber and answered directly from the bottom composer.
not: Single-assistant 1:1 chat interfaces—use ChatComposer with a standard thread instead.
Cross-run background task queues across dozens of independent jobs—use AgentInbox instead.
en.apiLead: CollaborationStream renders From → To avatars, resolves Question for you badges when answered, opens inline Table/Code/Document file previews, unfolds structured payloads via pro_fold, and parses @agent mentions in an Editor composer.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a CollaborationStream preloaded with Orchestrator, Researcher, and Writer collaborating on a pricing launch.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Configure agent participants with deterministic pixel avatars, tones, and model labels.

props.name: with_messages
props.description: Supply chronological messages, spawns, handoffs, questions, file chips, and structured payloads.

props.name: with_live
props.description: Display the pulsing Live indicator in the top participant bar.

props.name: with_max_height
props.description: Set the scrollable feed height in pixels so the composer stays anchored.

motion: Typing agents twinkle their 3x3 pixel avatars via pro_agent_avatar while live text sweeps a soft highlight sheen via pro_shimmer_text; participant tabs slide via pro_pill_indicator.
Structured payload cards unfold smoothly under messages via pro_fold, and file preview windows fade and lift in via pro_presence; respects Theme::reduced_motion.
ai: Import from kui::components::collaboration_stream::CollaborationStream (library) or crate::ui::components::collaboration_stream::CollaborationStream after running kui add collaboration-stream.
Questions addressed to "you" keep their amber Question for you badge until a message from "you" references their id via reply_to.

when: 展示多智能体协同运行中的真实对话内容、跨角色任务移交与共享中间产物，而不仅是静态父子拓扑。
人在回路的协作流：向用户发起的提问会自动打上琥珀色“向你提问”标记，支持在底部输入框一键定向回答或 @点名。
not: 单人单助手的常规聊天窗口（请使用 ChatComposer）。
跨多次独立运行的后台批量任务汇总列表（请使用 AgentInbox）。
zh.apiLead: CollaborationStream 渲染发送/接收双端头像、在用户回复后自动消解待答徽标、内联预览表格/代码/文档附件、通过 pro_fold 展开负载卡片，并支持 Editor @点名路由。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 Orchestrator、Researcher 与 Writer 协同推进定价页上线的协作流。

props.name: with_agents
props.description: 配置参与协作的智能体名册、专属像素徽标色调与模型名称。

props.name: with_messages
props.description: 传入按时间排序的提问、移交、派生、附件芯片与结构化详情负载。

props.name: with_live
props.description: 控制是否在顶部栏右侧显示脉冲实时状态点。

props.name: with_max_height
props.description: 设置消息流滚动区最大高度（像素），使底部输入框保持稳定锚定。

motion: 正在输入中的智能体 3x3 像素头像呈波浪闪烁且文案带有 pro_shimmer_text 微光；顶部成员筛选通过 pro_pill_indicator 平滑滑动。
消息下方的结构化负载卡片通过 pro_fold 弹簧展开，文件预览弹窗经 pro_presence 柔和升降显现；支持 Theme::reduced_motion。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::collaboration_stream::CollaborationStream 导入；执行 kui add collaboration-stream 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::collaboration_stream::CollaborationStream 导入。
发往 "you" 的 Question 消息会持续保留琥珀色“向你提问”标记，直到收到 reply_to 指向该消息的用户回复。

lead.en: Show human and agent commits along a blue Git trail with change-kind tags, backtick file/branch chips, foldable merge curves, and expandable commit details.
lead.zh: 在蓝色 Git 轨迹上呈现团队成员与智能体提交记录，配齐变更类型标签、反引号文件/分支胶囊、可折叠合并分支曲线与详情抽屉。

rule.en: Switch branches from the header menu, click merge commits to fold or unfold their side branch curve, and click any commit to inspect its author, pixel mark, hash, and diff stats.
rule.zh: 通过顶栏菜单切换分支，点击合并节点折叠或展开侧边分支曲线，点击任一提交查看作者（含智能体像素标识）、短哈希与增删行数。

when: Repository side panels or pull request timelines where developers and autonomous coding agents both land commits.
Live coding sessions where an agent writes and lands commits at the top of the branch while you watch.
not: Line-by-line code review diffs (use DiffTimeline) or complex multi-branch cross-merge graphs.
en.apiLead: CommitTrail parses backtick file and branch chips automatically, folds merged commit sub-trees along S-curved wires, and discloses commit metadata with clipboard hash copy.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a CommitTrail on main with 9 landed commits, 1 live Committing head, and invoice-pdf unfolded.

props.name: with_commits
props.description: Supply commits newest-first with authors, co-authors, change kinds, diff stats, and merged sub-commits.

props.name: with_branches
props.description: Configure two or more branch names to enable the header branch switcher menu.

props.name: with_has_more
props.description: Extend and fade the blue trail past the oldest commit when older history exists.

props.name: with_max_height
props.description: Scroll the commit list vertically past the given height in pixels.

motion: Pending commits spin a blue progress arc with shimmering Committing text and an upward fading rail pulse from the newest landed check, while merge curves and commit drawers animate via pro_fold; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::commit_trail::CommitTrail (library) or crate::ui::components::commit_trail::CommitTrail after running kui add commit-trail.
Wrap file paths (`proration.ts`) and branch names (`invoice-pdf`) in backticks inside TrailCommit::message so they render as typed chips.

when: 代码仓库侧栏或合并请求页面，同时展示人类工程师与自主编码智能体的提交历史。
实时监控智能体提交流水线：顶部旋转圆弧与 Committing 流光提示正在写入，落地后自动化为蓝色对勾。
not: 逐次编辑的代码增删曲线与差异片段预览（请使用 DiffTimeline），或复杂多主干交叉网络图。
zh.apiLead: CommitTrail 自动解析反引号包裹的文件与分支胶囊，支持合并子提交的 S 形曲线折叠以及带一键复制哈希的详情抽屉。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建默认位于 main 分支（含 9 次已落地提交与 1 条正在提交记录）的组件实例。

props.name: with_commits
props.description: 按最新在前传入提交列表，支持作者、协同智能体、变更类型、行数统计与合并子提交。

props.name: with_branches
props.description: 传入两个及以上分支名以启用顶栏分支切换菜单。

props.name: with_has_more
props.description: 在末尾提交下方延伸并渐隐蓝色轨迹线，提示仍有更早历史。

props.name: with_max_height
props.description: 限制提交列表最大像素高度并启用纵向滚动。

motion: 正在写入的提交在顶部旋转蓝色圆弧并由最新对勾向上发射渐隐脉冲微光，合并分支与详情面板通过 pro_fold 平滑折叠；开启减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::commit_trail::CommitTrail 导入；执行 kui add commit-trail 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::commit_trail::CommitTrail 导入。
在提交说明中用反引号包裹文件名（如 `proration.ts`）或分支名（如 `invoice-pdf`），即可自动生成带图标的内联胶囊。

title.zh: 多分支智能体冲突雷达

lead.en: Spot overlapping line edits across parallel coding-agent branches in a file-by-agent matrix, compare each agent's approach in one sentence, and unlock Merge branches once settled.
lead.zh: 以“文件 × 智能体”矩阵定位多分支并行编码中的重叠行号修改，通过水平连接杆连接冲突分支，对比一句话方案摘要并在全部裁决后解锁合并。

rule.en: Click any file row linked by an orange connector bar, pick the preferred agent radio card below to turn that file Kept, and click Merge branches once zero conflicts remain.
rule.zh: 点击带有橙色水平连接线的冲突文件行，在下方单选卡片中选定要保留的分支实现，待所有冲突消解后即可点击“合并分支”。

when: Several coding agents modify sibling branches of the same repository concurrently and overlapping line edits must be reconciled before merge.
Comparing competing one-sentence architectural choices per conflicting file without reading raw git conflict markers.
not: Best-of-N tournament runs on the exact same prompt (use ParallelAttempts) or single-agent file diffs (use AgentLedger).
en.apiLead: ConflictRadar detects true inclusive line-range overlaps per file, links colliding branch columns via PathBuilder, and gates Merge branches on full resolution.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 3-agent checkout branch conflict matrix with 2 active overlaps.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Configure parallel branch columns with pixel avatars, models, and Running/Done state.

props.name: with_files
props.description: Supply per-file edits with inclusive (start, end) line numbers and one-sentence summaries.

props.name: with_resolved
props.description: Pre-populate settled file-to-agent resolution choices.

motion: PathBuilder renders horizontal overlap connector bars with a sweeping amber pulse until settled, and pro_view_transition animates switching between conflict radio panels; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous pulses.
ai: Import from kui::components::conflict_radar::ConflictRadar (library) or crate::ui::components::conflict_radar::ConflictRadar after running kui add conflict-radar.
Disjoint line edits within the same file automatically render as clean Changed bars—only overlapping line intervals trigger a conflict.

when: 多个编码智能体在同一代码库的不同分支上并行开发，需要在合并前直观排查重叠行号冲突。
智能体针对同一文件给出了不同实现思路，需人工通过一句话摘要快速二选一裁决。
not: 针对同一任务的多次独立竞速尝试（请使用 ParallelAttempts）或单智能体变更台账（请使用 AgentLedger）。
zh.apiLead: ConflictRadar 基于真实行号区间交集识别冲突，用 PathBuilder 绘制跨列冲突连线，并在冲突清零后解锁分支合并。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 3 个结账特性分支与 2 处重叠冲突的雷达矩阵。

props.name: with_agents
props.description: 配置并行分支列、像素头像配色、模型标签与完成状态。

props.name: with_files
props.description: 传入每个文件的智能体修改行号区间及一句话方案说明。

props.name: with_resolved
props.description: 预填已裁决的文件路径与保留分支映射。

motion: PathBuilder 在冲突列间绘制带流光脉冲的水平连接杆，裁决后平滑隐退，底部单选面板通过 pro_view_transition 平滑切换；开启减少动效时禁用循环脉冲。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::conflict_radar::ConflictRadar 导入；执行 kui add conflict-radar 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::conflict_radar::ConflictRadar 导入。
同一文件内互不重叠的行号修改会自动呈现为无冲突的蓝色变更条，仅真实行号交集才会触发冲突裁决。

lead.en: Track every slice of an agent's context window against its auto-compact threshold, cross-highlight slices with ordered rows, and watch Compact now shimmer and fold old turns into a summary.
lead.zh: 通过按 Token 比例切分的顶栏色块与有序条目列表呈现智能体上下文构成，支持双向悬停高亮，并在点击“立即压缩”时流光闪烁、平滑挤压合并历史轮次为单条摘要。

rule.en: Point at any slice or entry row to cross-highlight its partner, click Compact now to shimmer and condense historical turns into a green Summary row, or click the Summary row to inspect what was archived.
rule.zh: 悬停顶栏色块或下方列表行即可双向联动高亮，点击“立即压缩”将旧对话与工具输出流光折叠为绿色摘要行，点击摘要行可展开查看归档明细。

when: Side panels showing what occupies an agent's context window during long coding or research sessions.
Making automatic or manual context compaction transparent so users see which turns folded into a summary and how many tokens were saved.
not: Spatial 2D treemap area comparisons (use ContextMap) or per-step dollar spend breakdowns (use CostWaterfall).
en.apiLead: ContextCompaction synchronizes a segmented token bar and dashed threshold line with ordered context rows and two-phase shimmer-to-summary folding.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 200K context window card near its 160K compaction mark.

props.name: with_entries
props.default: System, Tools, User, Agent, ToolResult, File
props.description: Supply ordered context entries with token counts and optional app logos.

props.name: with_limit
props.description: Set the context window capacity in tokens.

props.name: with_threshold
props.description: Set the dashed auto-compaction share of the limit.

props.name: with_model
props.description: Display a model badge beside the context title.

motion: Compacting entries shimmer via pro_shimmer_text before Slide springs squeeze their bar slices into the green Summary slice, pro_fold collapses retired rows, and pro_rolling_number rolls token counts down; Theme::reduced_motion compacts immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::context_compaction::ContextCompaction (library) or crate::ui::components::context_compaction::ContextCompaction after running kui add context-compaction.
System prompt, Tool definitions, and the newest active File stay uncompacted by default so essential instructions and working files remain intact.

when: 长会话智能体侧边栏，用于直观呈现系统提示词、工具定义、对话轮次与文件内容各自占用的上下文份额。
让上下文自动或手动压缩过程清晰可见：哪些旧轮次被归入摘要、压缩前后节省了多少 Token。
not: 二维矩形树图面积映射（请使用 ContextMap）或按步骤拆解美元成本瀑布流（请使用 CostWaterfall）。
zh.apiLead: ContextCompaction 将按比例切分的上下文进度条、自动压缩阈值虚线与两阶段流光折叠列表无缝联动。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 200K 容量且临近 160K 自动压缩线的上下文卡片。

props.name: with_entries
props.default: 系统、工具、用户、智能体、工具输出与文件
props.description: 按时间顺序传入上下文条目、Token 数量与关联应用图标。

props.name: with_limit
props.description: 设置上下文窗口最大 Token 上限。

props.name: with_threshold
props.description: 设置触发自动压缩的琥珀色虚线比例位置。

props.name: with_model
props.description: 设置标题旁展示的模型名称标签。

motion: 待压缩条目先由 pro_shimmer_text 渲染流光扫掠，再通过 Slide 弹簧将顶栏色块挤压合并为绿色摘要切片，pro_rolling_number 同步回落占用百分比；开启减少动效时立即完成压缩。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::context_compaction::ContextCompaction 导入；执行 kui add context-compaction 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::context_compaction::ContextCompaction 导入。
默认保留系统提示词、工具定义及最新活跃文件不参与压缩，确保核心指令与当前编辑上下文完整保留。

lead.en: Explore an agent's context window as a living squarified treemap where System, Tools, Memory, Files, Chat, Tool results, and dashed Free space tiles glide as turns grow or compact.
lead.zh: 以动态正方化矩形树图直观映射智能体上下文占用：系统提示、工具定义、记忆、文件、对话、工具输出与虚线剩余空间随对话增长或压缩平滑滑行缩放。

rule.en: Point at or click any tile to inspect its token share, press + Turn to watch Free space shrink smoothly, or press Compact and flip Before | After to compare summarized blocks.
rule.zh: 悬停或点击任意色块查看精确 Token 占比，点击“+ 轮次”观察剩余虚线区块平滑收缩，或点击“压缩”并通过“压缩前 / 压缩后”切换对比浓缩效果。

when: Debugging why an agent's context window is filling up by comparing 2D area across files, chat turns, and verbose tool outputs.
Making compaction visually tangible as old turns condense into a green summary tile and free capacity expands.
not: Compact single-line token meters (use ContextCompaction) or cross-session persistent notes (use MemoryPanel).
en.apiLead: ContextMap computes order-preserving squarified treemap bounds, animates every tile via Slide springs, and supports Before | After compaction inspection.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a living 200K context treemap preloaded with Checkout fixer blocks.

props.name: with_blocks
props.description: Supply ordered context blocks and the total window capacity in tokens.

props.name: with_profiles
props.description: Configure switchable agent profiles in the header dropdown.

motion: Each tile's (x, y, w, h) rectangle glides via Slide springs on turn additions, profile switches, and Before | After compaction toggles, while pro_rolling_number rolls used token counts; Theme::reduced_motion snaps bounds immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::context_map::ContextMap (library) or crate::ui::components::context_map::ContextMap after running kui add context-map.
Keep ContextBlock::id stable across updates so compute_squarified_treemap glides existing tiles in place.

when: 排查长会话智能体上下文耗尽原因，通过二维面积一眼对比各源码文件、对话轮次与工具输出日志的空间占比。
直观演示上下文压缩：旧轮次浓缩为绿色摘要块，斜纹虚线剩余空间随之平滑扩张。
not: 紧凑的单行进度条列表视图（请使用 ContextCompaction）或跨会话持久记忆管理（请使用 MemoryPanel）。
zh.apiLead: ContextMap 内置保序正方化矩形树图布局算法，通过 Slide 弹簧平滑插值每个区块的四维边界，并支持压缩前后视图对比。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载“结账修复智能体”200K 窗口分块的动态面积树图。

props.name: with_blocks
props.description: 传入按顺序排列的上下文块与窗口最大 Token 容量。

props.name: with_profiles
props.default: 结账修复与文档研究智能体
props.description: 配置顶栏下拉菜单可切换的多智能体上下文档案。

motion: 追加轮次、切换智能体或切换压缩前后视图时，所有图块的 (x, y, w, h) 均由 Slide 弹簧平滑过渡，pro_rolling_number 同步滚动更新已用 Token 数；开启减少动效时立即静态定位。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::context_map::ContextMap 导入；执行 kui add context-map 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::context_map::ContextMap 导入。
更新上下文时请保持 ContextBlock::id 稳定，以便树图分块在原位平滑滑行形变。

lead.en: See where the money and tokens of an agent run go—every LLM call, tool call, and sub-agent stepped across a cumulative waterfall with model marks, a TOP spend flag, and a smooth Cost / Tokens switch.
lead.zh: 透视单次智能体运行的费用与 Token 去向：将每次模型调用、工具执行与子智能体绘制成累积阶梯瀑布条，配齐模型图标、最高花费标记与费用/Token 平滑切换。

rule.en: Switch smoothly between Cost ($) and Tokens, click Most expensive to jump straight to the costliest step, fold sub-agents, and click any row to inspect its Prompt / Response.
rule.zh: 在费用（$）与 Token 维度间平滑切换，点击顶部“最高花费步骤”一键展开定位瓶颈，支持折叠子智能体并点击任意行查看提示词与响应详情。

when: Showing what a multi-step agent run cost and which LLM calls or sub-agents spent the budget—alongside a chat thread, run log, or billing inspector.
Live runs where totals climb while steps stream and negative prompt-cache credits step the cumulative bar back.
not: Inspecting wall-clock start times, concurrency, and latency bottlenecks on a time axis—use TraceWaterfall instead.
Tracking workspace-wide monthly quotas across days and weeks—use UsageMeter instead.
en.apiLead: CostWaterfall sums nested sub-agent trees automatically, highlights the most expensive leaf step, glides stepped bars between Cost and Tokens, and unfolds per-step Prompt/Response inspectors.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a CostWaterfall preloaded with the "Report on LLM API prices in 2026" run.

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Supply ordered LLM calls, tool calls, and nested sub-agent trees (sub-agents sum their children automatically).

props.name: with_mode
props.description: Select whether stepped bars measure cumulative USD cost or cumulative tokens.

props.name: with_task
props.description: Set the muted run task subtitle displayed beside the header title.

props.name: with_max_height
props.description: Cap the vertical height of the waterfall list in pixels for long agent runs.

motion: Toggling Cost and Tokens glides the segmented pill via pro_pill_indicator while every bar's start offset, length, and output-token split spring smoothly via pro_spring_f32.
Running steps sweep a soft highlight sheen across their waterfall bar and shimmer live totals; row details unfold with measured-height spring physics via pro_fold.
ai: Import from kui::components::cost_waterfall::CostWaterfall (library) or crate::ui::components::cost_waterfall::CostWaterfall after running kui add cost-waterfall.
Pass direct per-step costs and token counts without pre-summing parents; negative cost values render diagonal credit hatches and step the cumulative cursor back.

when: 在对话侧栏、运行日志或账单详情中展示单次智能体运行的总开销，并定位哪一步模型或工具消耗最多预算。
需要在运行过程中实时累加费用与 Token，或呈现提示词缓存折扣回退的场景。
not: 按真实时间轴排查各调用起止时刻与并发延迟瓶颈（请使用 TraceWaterfall）。
按天或按月统计整个工作区的周期配额消耗（请使用 UsageMeter）。
zh.apiLead: CostWaterfall 自动汇总嵌套子智能体开销、标记最高花费步骤、在费用与 Token 间平滑重排阶梯条，并内联展开提示词与输出详情。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置“2026 大模型 API 定价基准报告”运行示例的成本瀑布图。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 传入模型调用、工具执行及含 children 的子智能体节点列表（父节点自动累加子项）。

props.name: with_mode
props.description: 设置瀑布条的度量基准（Cost 美元费用或 Tokens 数量）。

props.name: with_task
props.default: "2026 大模型 API 定价基准报告"
props.description: 设置标题右侧展示的任务背景摘要。

props.name: with_max_height
props.description: 为超长运行列表设置最大滚动高度（像素）。

motion: 切换费用与 Token 时通过 pro_pill_indicator 滑动分段胶囊，同时所有阶梯条起点、长度与输出占比经 pro_spring_f32 平滑过渡。
运行中的步骤条带有柔和扫光与末端呼吸高亮，点击行通过 pro_fold 弹簧展开提示词与响应卡片；开启减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::cost_waterfall::CostWaterfall 导入；执行 kui add cost-waterfall 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::cost_waterfall::CostWaterfall 导入。
仅需在叶子步骤填写自身 cost 与 tokens，父级子智能体会自动汇总；负数 cost 会以斜纹回退形式展示返还抵扣。

lead.en: Dock an agent's structured question right above the chat composer—numbered options with Recommended, visual preview tiles, Approve / Decline facts, an inline Other input, 1–5 shortcuts, and Later folding.
lead.zh: 将智能体的结构化提问停靠在聊天输入框正上方：提供带“推荐”徽标的编号选项、版式预览瓷砖、审批键值摘要及自定义输入行，支持数字键秒答与“稍后”单行折叠。

rule.en: Click any row or tile—or press keys 1–5—to answer at once, page across all 3 variants (Choice, Pick tiles, Approval) with ‹ ›, type custom words in Other, or press Later (Esc) to fold.
rule.zh: 点击任意选项或按数字键 1–5 立即作答，通过右上角翻页体验三种变体（列表、预览瓷砖、发布审批），在底部输入自定义指令，或按 Esc 折叠为单行。

when: An agent in a chat workspace needs one quick answer—architecture pick, layout variant, or release sign-off—right above where the user already types.
