Multiple background tasks waiting on human answers simultaneously through a compact paged card.
not: Inspecting multi-file code diffs across sequential run gates—use ApprovalGates instead.
Visualizing multi-branch downstream consequences and sub-questions—use DecisionTree instead.
en.apiLead: DecisionCard unifies Choice rows, Pick wireframe tiles, and Approval facts with 1–5 keyboard shortcuts, custom Editor answers, and spring folding above any composer.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a DecisionCard preloaded with 3 open decisions showcasing Choice, Pick tiles, and Approval.

props.name: with_decisions
props.description: Provide open questions with options, Recommended badges, wireframes, or facts.

props.name: with_folded
props.description: Start folded into the compact 'N decisions waiting · Show' bar.

props.name: with_allow_own
props.description: Show or hide the inline 'Other — type your own…' Editor row at the bottom.

props.name: with_composer_chrome
props.description: Render or omit the surrounding orchestrator status line and docked composer.

motion: Answering or paging cross-glides to the next decision via pro_step_transition; answering the final item folds the card height cleanly to zero via pro_fold.
Pressing Later or Escape folds the card into a single 42px summary bar; Theme::reduced_motion disables animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::decision_card::DecisionCard (library) or crate::ui::components::decision_card::DecisionCard after running kui add decision-card.
Pass with_composer_chrome(false) when docking DecisionCard directly above your own chat composer component.

when: 聊天工作台中的智能体遇到需要用户拍板的单步问题（架构选型、版式挑选或上线确认），直接停靠在输入框上方作答。
多个并行后台任务同时等待用户回答，通过带翻页器的单张紧凑卡片集中处理。
not: 需要逐行审阅多文件代码差异的运行关卡（请使用 ApprovalGates）。
需要展开多级分支并对比各路径连锁后果的复杂抉择（请使用 DecisionTree）。
zh.apiLead: DecisionCard 在同一套交互中囊括编号列表、线框预览瓷砖与键值审批三种形态，支持 1–5 数字快捷键、自由文本输入与弹簧折叠。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 3 道待答问题（涵盖编号选项、版式预览瓷砖与发布审批）的决策提问卡。

props.name: with_decisions
props.description: 传入包含选项、推荐标记、线框图或键值事实的待决策队列。

props.name: with_folded
props.description: 初始是否折叠为“N 项决策等待回答 · 展开”单行条。

props.name: with_allow_own
props.description: 显示或隐藏底部的“其他 — 输入你自己的指令…”编辑行。

props.name: with_composer_chrome
props.description: 显示或隐藏外围状态提示行与底部停靠聊天输入框。

motion: 作答或翻页时通过 pro_step_transition 水平微移过渡；答完最后一题后通过 pro_fold 将卡片高度平滑收拢为零。
点击“稍后”或按 Esc 平滑折叠为 42px 单行摘要条；开启减少动效时即时切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::decision_card::DecisionCard 导入；执行 kui add decision-card 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::decision_card::DecisionCard 导入。
在自有聊天输入框上方组合使用时，调用 with_composer_chrome(false) 即可仅渲染决策卡本体。

lead.en: Lay out an agent's high-stakes fork as an interactive branching tree—see consequences, cost/latency trade-offs, flagged risks, and the agent's own pick along each path, or write your own instruction.
lead.zh: 将智能体遇到的关键岔路展开为交互式分支树：直观对比各路径的连锁后果、耗时成本、风险标记与“智能体推荐”路径，也支持手写自定义分支。

rule.en: Hover or press 1–3 to pick a branch (or sub-branch), hover amber flags or press F to inspect the agent's risk note, press 4 for Other… to write a custom path, and use ← → to switch scenarios.
rule.zh: 悬停或按数字键 1–3 选择分支（含二级子选项），悬停琥珀色标记或按 F 查看风险注解，按 4 展开自定义路径输入，按左右方向键切换场景。

when: An agent hits an operational or architectural fork—incident rollbacks, duplicate billing cleanups, cache warm-ups—where consequences and trade-offs are the primary content.
Decisions where the agent has an honest preference (Agent's pick) while keeping alternative paths and custom instructions one click away.
not: Simple yes/no consent on a single tool call with a countdown—use ApprovalCard instead.
Compact inline questions docked directly above a chat composer—use DecisionCard instead.
en.apiLead: DecisionTree measures live card bounds to paint orthogonal PathBuilder curves and traveling pulses across root questions, primary branches, nested sub-choices, and custom instructions.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a DecisionTree preloaded with 3 scenarios (Incident rollback, Billing duplicates, EU cache warm-up).

props.name: with_decisions
props.description: Configure root questions, agent/model metadata, risk tiers, branches, sub-choices, and flagged consequences.

props.name: with_allow_other
props.description: Show or hide the bottom Other… branch for custom user instructions.

props.name: choose_branch
props.description: Programmatically select a branch and optional nested sub-option.

props.name: submit_custom
props.description: Submit a custom instruction on the Other… branch.

motion: pro_connector_pulse draws rounded orthogonal connectors and animates light pulses along Agent's pick and hovered/confirmed branches while dimming sibling paths.
Below 640px width, the tree reflows cleanly onto a vertical rail without horizontal scrolling; Theme::reduced_motion disables connector pulses.
ai: Import from kui::components::decision_tree::DecisionTree (library) or crate::ui::components::decision_tree::DecisionTree after running kui add decision-tree.
Mark at most one branch per decision with .with_pick(true) and flag only the specific consequence span that carries irreversible risk.

when: 智能体遇到难以独自决断的运维或架构岔路（如线上故障回滚、重复扣款清理、跨区缓存预热），需要直观对比各分支后果。
智能体拥有明确倾向（标注“智能体推荐”），同时保留备选方案与人工自定义指令入口的场景。
not: 单次操作仅需简单“批准 / 拒绝”与超时倒计时（请使用 ApprovalCard）。
停靠在聊天输入框上方的轻量单步问答（请使用 DecisionCard）。
zh.apiLead: DecisionTree 实时测量节点几何边界并通过 PathBuilder 绘制正交圆角连线与流光脉冲，串联根问题、主分支、二级子追问与自定义输入。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 3 组真实决策树场景（线上结账故障回滚、重复订阅处理、法兰克福缓存预热）的组件。

props.name: with_decisions
props.description: 配置根问题、智能体与模型信息、风险等级、分支选项、二级追问及带注解的风险标记。

props.name: with_allow_other
props.description: 显示或隐藏底部的“其他路径…”自定义指令分支。

props.name: choose_branch
props.description: 通过代码选定指定主分支及可选的二级子选项。

props.name: submit_custom
props.description: 在“其他路径…”分支提交自定义指令。

motion: pro_connector_pulse 绘制圆角正交树状连线，并在推荐分支、悬停分支与已确认路径上驱动光脉冲流动，同时柔和淡化其余分支。
容器窄于 640px 时自动切换为纵向导轨树布局，无需横向滚动；开启减少动效时关闭连续脉冲。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::decision_tree::DecisionTree 导入；执行 kui add decision-tree 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::decision_tree::DecisionTree 导入。
每棵决策树最多将一个分支设为 .with_pick(true)，并仅对不可逆或高风险后果片段添加 flagged 注解。

lead.en: Hand unassigned tasks to specialist agents via drag-and-drop while previewing updated Busy until clocks, load bars, and USD spend—or flip Auto to route work to whoever frees up first.
lead.zh: 通过拖拽或快捷键将待分配任务交给专职智能体，实时预览新增费用、“忙至 HH:MM”时间与负载进度条；开启“自动指派”则自动路由给最早空闲的智能体。

rule.en: Drag an unassigned task onto any agent (or click to pick up and press 1–4) to preview its +$cost and Busy until time, click a queued chip to return it to Unassigned, or flip Auto.
rule.zh: 将左侧任务拖入任意智能体卡片（或点击选中后按数字键 1–4）即可预览新增美元成本与最新预计完成时间，点击排队标签可退回待分配池，亦可拨动“自动指派”开关。

when: Dispatching backlog tasks across a team of specialist agents while weighing model speed, queue wait time, and per-minute cost.
Rebalancing queued tasks between busy and free agents or previewing automatic earliest-free routing.
not: Chronological swimlanes of already-running traces (use AgentLanes) or high-throughput anonymous worker pools (use AgentQueue).
en.apiLead: DelegateBoard pairs a drag-and-drop Unassigned pile with per-agent Busy until clocks, load bars, cost rates, and earliest-free Auto routing.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a delegation board with 4 unassigned tasks and 4 specialist agents.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Configure specialist agents with model names, provider marks, and $/min rates.

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: Supply tasks with minute estimates, tool logos, and optional agent_id assignments.

props.name: with_mode
props.description: Start in Manual drag/click mode or Auto earliest-free routing mode.

props.name: with_suggestion
props.description: Highlight a recommended task-to-agent hand-off preview.

motion: pro_switch drives the capsule Auto toggle, pro_spring_f32 glides each agent's current and previewed load bars, and Auto mode dispatches tasks ~once per second to earliest_free_agent_id; Theme::reduced_motion routes immediately without continuous loops.
ai: Import from kui::components::delegate_board::DelegateBoard (library) or crate::ui::components::delegate_board::DelegateBoard after running kui add delegate-board.
Task estimates are in minutes; agent_busy_minutes sums the running task's remaining minutes plus all queued task estimates.

when: 在由不同模型与专长组成的智能体团队间分派任务，需要同时权衡空闲时间与每分钟单价。
在繁忙与空闲智能体之间重平衡排队任务，或演示按最早空闲时间自动路由。
not: 观察运行中智能体的时间轴泳道（请使用 AgentLanes）或高吞吐无差别工作槽队列（请使用 AgentQueue）。
zh.apiLead: DelegateBoard 将可拖拽的待分配池与各智能体的“忙至”时钟、负载条、单价预览及最早空闲自动路由合为一体。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 4 项待分配任务与 4 位专职智能体的委派看板。

props.name: with_agents
props.default: 研究、撰稿、编码与运维智能体
props.description: 配置智能体名称、模型型号、服务商标识与每分钟美元单价。

props.name: with_tasks
props.default: 4 项待分配 + 4 项已入队任务
props.description: 传入带预估分钟数、工具图标与所属智能体 id 的任务列表。

props.name: with_mode
props.description: 设置手动拖放指派模式或最早空闲自动路由模式。

props.name: with_suggestion
props.description: 高亮展示系统推荐的任务与目标智能体配对预览。

motion: pro_switch 驱动胶囊形自动开关，pro_spring_f32 平滑伸缩每位智能体的当前与预览负载条，自动模式按秒级节奏依次路由至最早空闲智能体；开启减少动效时立即完成分配。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::delegate_board::DelegateBoard 导入；执行 kui add delegate-board 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::delegate_board::DelegateBoard 导入。
任务耗时单位为分钟，agent_busy_minutes 会累加当前执行中剩余分钟数与后续排队任务的预估时长。

lead.en: Replay or watch a coding agent's pull request edit by edit with overlaid +added / −removed curves, per-file diff bars, and hover diff snippets.
lead.zh: 逐次重放或实时追踪编码智能体在合并请求中的修改：叠绘新增与删除行数渐变曲线、单文件分段进度条及悬停代码片段预览。

rule.en: Scrub across the chart, click any file bar segment, or press Left and Right arrow keys to inspect each edit's diff lines; hover a file row to pin its edit timestamps along the baseline.
rule.zh: 在图表上滑动鼠标、点击文件分段条或按左右方向键即可查看单次修改的代码差异；悬停文件行可在时间基线上标出其历次编辑时间点。

when: Pull-request review screens showing both when major changes landed and which files absorbed the churn.
Live coding agent dashboards or post-run replays of multi-file edits.
not: Monorepo sweeps touching hundreds of files simultaneously (aggregate by directory first) or multi-agent swimlane comparisons (use AgentLanes).
en.apiLead: DiffTimeline locks Y-axis and X-axis scales from the full edit list so nothing rescales mid-run, aggregates file rows in first-touched order, and previews monospace diffs.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a DiffTimeline preloaded with Frontend agent · PR #214 across 6 files.

props.name: with_edits
props.description: Supply chronological file edits with added/removed counts, notes, and monospace diff snippets.

props.name: with_elapsed
props.description: Set seconds elapsed since run start; edits beyond elapsed remain hidden until reached.

props.name: with_live
props.description: Twinkle the agent pixel mark, breathe curve tip rings, and announce the active file.

props.name: with_max_rows
props.description: Maximum file rows visible before scrolling so card height stays bounded.

motion: PathBuilder renders green +added and red −removed gradient areas with staggered tip glow rings while Slide springs widen segmented per-file bars and glide the active file highlight; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::diff_timeline::DiffTimeline (library) or crate::ui::components::diff_timeline::DiffTimeline after running kui add diff-timeline.
Pass all known or expected DiffEdit entries so Y-axis ticks stay stable while advancing with_elapsed during playback.

when: 合并请求审查面板，帮助工程师直观把握大改动发生的时间节点与核心受影响文件。
编码智能体实时工作监控或运行结束后的逐次修改回放。
not: 单次触及上百个文件的超大规模批处理（建议先按目录聚合），或多智能体并行泳道对比（请使用 AgentLanes）。
zh.apiLead: DiffTimeline 根据完整编辑序列锁定纵横坐标刻度避免播放跳变，按首次触及顺序聚合文件进度条并支持等宽代码片段浮层。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 Frontend agent · PR #214（6 个文件、7 次编辑）的差异时间线。

props.name: with_edits
props.description: 传入按时间排序的文件修改记录，包含增删行数、说明与等宽代码差异行。

props.name: with_elapsed
props.description: 设置当前已演进的运行秒数，晚于该时间的编辑保持隐藏。

props.name: with_live
props.description: 开启实时写入态：智能体像素标识闪烁、曲线端点呼吸发光并播报正在编辑的文件。

props.name: with_max_rows
props.description: 文件列表触发滚动前的最大可见行数，保持卡片高度恒定。

motion: PathBuilder 绘制新增绿线与删除红线渐变面积并在端点呈现呼吸光圈，Slide 弹簧驱动单文件分段条伸展与高亮底色滑移；开启减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::diff_timeline::DiffTimeline 导入；执行 kui add diff-timeline 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::diff_timeline::DiffTimeline 导入。
传入完整编辑序列并推进 with_elapsed，可确保播放过程中纵轴刻度始终稳定不重排。

lead.en: Trace one request through an ordered priority list of LLM providers—failed branches break red on timeouts or 429/529 errors, a traveling light tests the next fallback, and the model that answers carries the pulse into Response.
lead.zh: 以流向图直观追踪单次请求在多模型优先级队列中的故障转移：超限或 529 报错分支断裂标红，光脉冲顺移尝试下一备选模型，成功响应后将结果绿光汇入终点。

rule.en: Toggle Healthy / Fail 529 on any model row to simulate provider outages and watch failover cascade down the chain, click Request or Response to inspect payloads, or press Replay.
rule.zh: 点击任意模型行上的“正常响应 / 模拟失败”实时模拟厂商故障并观察级联转移，点击入站请求或返回节点查看载荷预览，或点击重播再次演示。

when: LLM gateways, multi-region routers, and incident dashboards where operators need to see which model answered and why higher-priority providers were skipped.
Interactive reliability demos letting users simulate 429/529 provider outages across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Vertex, and Fireworks.
not: Running several models simultaneously on the same prompt to compare outputs—use JudgeBracket or ParallelAttempts instead.
Splitting aggregate production traffic percentages across healthy models—use ModelRouter instead.
en.apiLead: FallbackChain manages prioritized FallbackAttempt rows, cubic bezier fan-out/fan-in curves, live cumulative latency/cost readouts, and interactive outage toggles with typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a FallbackChain with 4 prioritized models (Claude Sonnet 529 -> GPT-5.4 answers -> Gemini & DeepSeek standby).

props.name: with_attempts
props.description: Provide custom prioritized models with brand marks, provider regions, latencies, costs, and failure reasons.

props.name: with_request
props.description: Configure the left Request endpoint card and incoming prompt text.

props.name: with_response
props.description: Configure the right Response endpoint card and completion preview.

props.name: toggle_model_failure
props.description: Flip a model's simulated failure state and replay the failover sequence.

motion: Smooth cubic bezier curves carry a glowing blue pulse into the currently trying model, split open in red with a break mark on failures, and stream emerald green into Response once answered.
Active attempt captions shimmer via pro_shimmer_text and node details transition via pro_view_transition; Theme::reduced_motion settles immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::fallback_chain::FallbackChain (library) or crate::ui::components::fallback_chain::FallbackChain after running kui add fallback-chain.
Order FallbackAttempt items from highest priority (#1) to last-resort fallback (#N); models after the answering row automatically show Not needed.

when: 在模型网关、多可用区路由与可用性看板中清晰展示哪一顺位模型最终响应，以及高优模型失败的具体错误码。
交互式容灾演示：允许用户模拟 429 限流或 529 过载，验证多厂商自动兜底能力。
not: 让多个模型并发回答同一提示词并做盲测打分对决（请使用 JudgeBracket）。
按流量百分比将生产请求切分至不同模型通道（请使用 ModelRouter）。
zh.apiLead: FallbackChain 统一管理优先级模型卡片、三次贝塞尔分流与汇流曲线、累计耗时/成本状态栏及故障模拟开关，并发出强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 4 级模型队列（#1 Claude 529 转移至 #2 GPT-5.4 成功响应）的故障转移图。

props.name: with_attempts
props.description: 传入按尝试顺序排列的模型列表，包含品牌图标、区域、耗时、成本与错误原因。

props.name: with_request
props.description: 配置左侧入站请求节点及其提示词原文。

props.name: with_response
props.description: 配置右侧返回终点节点及其生成结果预览。

props.name: toggle_model_failure
props.description: 切换指定模型的故障模拟状态并立即重播故障转移波。

motion: 平滑三次贝塞尔曲线向正在尝试的模型输送蓝色光脉冲，遇到失败分支即刻标红断开，成功响应后以绿光脉冲汇入终点。
尝试中的状态文案通过 pro_shimmer_text 流光显示，底部详情卡通过 pro_view_transition 切换；遵循减少动效设置。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::fallback_chain::FallbackChain 导入；执行 kui add fallback-chain 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::fallback_chain::FallbackChain 导入。
按优先级从 #1 到 #N 传入 FallbackAttempt，首个健康模型响应后其后的顺位会自动标记为“无需调用”。

lead.en: Watch an orchestrator fan a batch job across dozens of parallel workers as a dense live cell matrix with rolling spend, ETA, status filtering, failed-task retry, and hover inspection.
lead.zh: 将大规模批处理作业呈现为实时高密工作单元矩阵，汇聚滚动完成数、开销、预计剩余时间、状态筛选、失败重试与悬停详情卡片。

rule.en: Hover or walk cells with arrow keys to inspect worker, latency, attempts, cost, and result or error copy; click status counts to isolate one state or press Retry failed to requeue failures in place.
rule.zh: 悬停或用方向键漫游单元格即可查看工作节点、耗时、尝试次数、费用及结果或错误详情；点击底部图例可筛选单一状态，点击重试可原位重派失败任务。

when: Batch agent jobs fanned out across many parallel workers—enriching leads, running evals, translating pages, or triaging tickets.
Live progress views where retry pressure, failure clusters, cumulative cost, and remaining ETA matter more than one linear log.
not: Small agent spawning hierarchies (use AgentTree), single-run step latency waterfalls (use TraceWaterfall), or parallel multi-agent timelines (use AgentLanes).
en.apiLead: FanOutGrid renders hundreds of tasks in a single responsive canvas pass, computes rolling ETA once three tasks finish, and emits typed Select, Retry, and FilterChanged events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a fan-out matrix preloaded with the 240-lead enrichment batch.

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: Supply ordered tasks with status, worker slot, start/end offsets, cost, attempts, and result or error copy.

props.name: with_job
props.description: Set the batch job summary displayed beside the heading.

props.name: with_workers
props.description: Set concurrent worker slots used to estimate remaining seconds.

props.name: with_now_ms
props.description: Set the elapsed batch clock in milliseconds from job start.

motion: Cells enter in a staggered wave, Running cells sweep an out-of-phase shine, Retrying cells breathe in amber, and hovered or focused cells pop to 1.3x scale without reflowing neighbors; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous sweeps and entrance waves.
ai: Import from kui::components::fan_out_grid::FanOutGrid (library) or crate::ui::components::fan_out_grid::FanOutGrid after running kui add fan-out-grid.
Preserve stable task ids across updates—when retrying failed tasks, increment attempts and transition status back to FanOutStatus::Running.

when: 由主智能体向数十个工作节点并发派发的大规模批处理作业，如线索补全、评测集跑批、页面翻译或工单分流。
需要在紧凑空间同时把控完成率、重试风暴、失败聚集、累计费用与预计剩余时间的实时监控面板。
not: 展示少量智能体父子派生关系（请使用 AgentTree）、单次运行的逐步耗时瀑布（请使用 TraceWaterfall）或多智能体并排时间轴（请使用 AgentLanes）。
zh.apiLead: FanOutGrid 通过单次响应式画布绘制数百个任务单元，完成满 3 项后自动推算剩余时间，并发出 Select、Retry 与 FilterChanged 强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 240 条线索补全批次的并发扇出矩阵。

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: 传入包含状态、工作节点、起止毫秒偏移、费用、尝试次数与结果或错误详情的任务列表。

props.name: with_job
props.description: 设置标题旁显示的批处理作业摘要。

props.name: with_workers
props.description: 设置并发工作节点槽位数，用于估算剩余完成秒数。

props.name: with_now_ms
props.description: 设置距作业启动已流逝的毫秒时钟。

motion: 任务单元以错峰波浪浮现，运行中单元扫过错相流光，重试中单元呈琥珀色呼吸，悬停或聚焦时以 1.3 倍缩放弹出且不挤压邻近布局；开启减少动效时立即呈现静态矩阵。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::fan_out_grid::FanOutGrid 导入；执行 kui add fan-out-grid 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::fan_out_grid::FanOutGrid 导入。
更新批次状态时请保持任务 id 稳定——重试失败项时递增 attempts 并将状态切回 FanOutStatus::Running。

lead.en: Build top-down agent automations in place with + step insertion on every connector, named If / else forks, Undo history, and a live test run that pulses down active rails.
lead.zh: 原地构建自上而下的智能体自动化流程：每段连线均可通过 + 插入节点，支持命名 If / else 双路分叉、一键撤销与流光脉冲测试运行。

rule.en: Click + on any connector to insert Agent, Tool, Wait, or If / else steps, reorder or delete steps with Undo, and press Test run to send a live light pulse into each executing step.
rule.zh: 点击连线上的 + 插入智能体、工具、等待或条件分支步骤，支持上下调序、删除与撤销，并可点击“测试运行”沿连线发送实时流光脉冲。

when: Product settings, side panels, or workflow editors where people assemble what happens after a signup, webhook, or schedule trigger.
Conditional agent automations that fork into named paths and benefit from an in-place dry run.
not: Unconstrained node-and-wire canvases where arbitrary nodes form cycles, pre-run single-turn plans (use AgentPlan), or post-hoc execution traces (use TraceWaterfall).
en.apiLead: FlowBuilder maintains recursive step trees with non-destructive Undo snapshots, orthogonal PathBuilder branch forks, and typed StepsChanged, Select, and TestRun events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a flow builder preloaded with the 8-step Onboard new signups automation.

props.name: with_name
props.description: Set the workflow title shown in the header bar.

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Supply the hierarchical workflow steps starting with a Trigger.

props.name: with_status
props.description: Provide controlled execution statuses keyed by step or branch path id.

props.name: with_height
props.description: Set the scrollable workflow canvas viewport height in pixels.

motion: Test runs send a glowing light pulse down vertical and forked PathBuilder rails, bathe the active card in a top-down blue wash, twinkle Agent avatars, and shimmer step notes; Theme::reduced_motion settles immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::flow_builder::FlowBuilder (library) or crate::ui::components::flow_builder::FlowBuilder after running kui add flow-builder.
Keep every step card at a fixed 256x92px geometry so starting or stopping a test run never shifts vertical layout.

when: 在设置页、侧边栏或流程编辑器中，让用户围绕触发器编排后续调研、通知与跟进动作。
包含命名条件分叉（If / else）并需原地发起试运行验证的智能体自动化场景。
not: 任意节点自由连线且存在环路的无限画布、智能体执行前的单轮计划审阅（请使用 AgentPlan）或历史运行耗时回放（请使用 TraceWaterfall）。
zh.apiLead: FlowBuilder 维护支持撤销栈的递归步骤树与 PathBuilder 圆角分叉连线，并发出强类型 StepsChanged、Select 与试运行生命周期事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 8 步“新注册用户自动引导”流程的编排器。

props.name: with_name
props.description: 设置顶部栏显示的工作流名称。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 传入以 Trigger 起头的层级化步骤树。

props.name: with_status
props.description: 按步骤或分支路径 id 注入受控运行状态。

props.name: with_height
props.description: 设置可滚动流程画布视口高度（像素）。

motion: 测试运行时沿垂直与分叉连线传递流光脉冲，激活卡片顶部浮现柔和蓝光，Agent 像素徽标闪烁且描述文本扫过流光；开启减少动效时立即呈现结果。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::flow_builder::FlowBuilder 导入；执行 kui add flow-builder 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::flow_builder::FlowBuilder 导入。
所有步骤卡片保持固定 256x92px 尺寸，确保测试运行启停与标签切换时绝不发生布局跳动。

lead.en: See who does what in an agent run and where work changes hands—one lane per person, agent, and tool with task boxes, diamond approval gates, live handoff pulses, and inline approvals.
lead.zh: 清晰呈现多智能体运行中的职责分工与交接节点：为人、智能体与外部工具各设一行泳道，串联任务块、菱形审批门、实时交接光脉冲与行内批准卡片。

rule.en: Click any task box, approval diamond, start/end circle, or lane header to open its card; approve or reject waiting human gates right in place, or press Esc to close.
rule.zh: 点击任意任务卡片、菱形审批门、起止节点或左侧泳道标题即可打开详情浮层；待确认的人工关卡支持就地批准或拒绝，按 Esc 关闭。

when: Showing who owns each step in a multi-agent workflow and where tasks hand over between people, agents, and external tools.
Release, review, or onboarding pipelines with human approval gates that operators should approve directly on the diagram.
not: Chronological chat and tool transcripts of a single agent run—use AgentSequence or CollaborationStream instead.
Exact millisecond duration debugging along a continuous time axis—use TraceWaterfall instead.
en.apiLead: HandoffSwimlanes computes cycle-safe topological columns from `after` dependencies, paints live orthogonal handoff pulses and diamond gates, and manages inline gate approvals.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a HandoffSwimlanes preloaded with the 6-lane "Ship the billing fix" workflow.

props.name: with_lanes
props.description: Configure person, agent, and tool participant rows from top to bottom.

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: Provide tasks, human approval gates, and start/end markers with `after` handoff dependencies.

props.name: with_title
props.description: Customize the header title and accessible group label.

props.name: with_approvals_enabled
props.description: Show or hide inline Approve and Reject actions on waiting gate cards.

motion: Active cross-lane handoffs animate traveling light pulses via pro_connector_pulse in the receiving agent's color (or amber toward a waiting approval gate).
Running task boxes sweep a soft highlight sheen while their 3x3 agent pixel mark twinkles, and waiting diamond gates breathe softly; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::handoff_swimlanes::HandoffSwimlanes (library) or crate::ui::components::handoff_swimlanes::HandoffSwimlanes after running kui add handoff-swimlanes.
Columns narrow responsively so the diagram never scrolls horizontally; below 520px lane headers condense to their pixel/tool marks.

when: 展示多智能体流程中各方负责的任务步骤，以及工作在人工、智能体与外部工具之间的移交路径。
包含人工审批关卡的上线、复核或入职标准流程，需要支持在流程图内直接点击批准或拒绝。
not: 按时间顺序查看单次智能体运行的完整对话与调用记录（请使用 AgentSequence 或 CollaborationStream）。
在精确时间轴上排查各步骤耗时瓶颈（请使用 TraceWaterfall）。
zh.apiLead: HandoffSwimlanes 根据 after 依赖自动计算无环拓扑列布局，绘制正交交接光脉冲与菱形审批门，并派发强类型交互事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 6 条泳道（You、4 个智能体与 Vercel）账单修复发布流程的泳道图。

props.name: with_lanes
props.description: 从上至下配置成员、智能体与工具参与方泳道。

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: 传入任务块、人工菱形审批门与起止节点及 after 前置依赖。

props.name: with_title
props.description: 自定义顶部标题与无障碍区域名称。

props.name: with_approvals_enabled
props.description: 控制是否在待确认关卡详情卡中显示批准与拒绝按钮。

motion: 正在进行的跨泳道移交通过 pro_connector_pulse 沿圆角折线传递流动光束，奔向审批门时自动切换为琥珀色。
运行中的任务卡片带有柔和流光且 3x3 智能体像素徽标闪烁，待审批菱形门轻柔呼吸；开启 Theme::reduced_motion 时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::handoff_swimlanes::HandoffSwimlanes 导入；执行 kui add handoff-swimlanes 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::handoff_swimlanes::HandoffSwimlanes 导入。
窄屏下自动收缩列间距与节点宽度避免横向滚动；低于 520px 时左侧泳道自动精简为图标徽标。

title.zh: 行内 AI 润色对比

lead.en: Show AI prose rewrites directly inside the paragraph—red struck-through deletions and green insertions resolved one by one via hover popover, keyboard shortcuts, or bulk actions with full undo.
lead.zh: 在自然段落中行内展示 AI 润色建议：红底删除线与绿底新增词并列呈现，支持悬浮气泡、键盘快捷键逐处决断或一键全收/全拒与多步撤销。

rule.en: Navigate pending edits with Tab / ← / →, accept with Enter or Y, reject with Backspace or N, and undo with ⌘Z; deleted words always carry both red tint and strikethrough.
rule.zh: 用 Tab / ← / → 在待审修改间跳转，按 Enter 或 Y 接受，按 Backspace 或 N 拒绝，按 ⌘Z 撤销；删除词同时具备红色底纹与删除线双重无障碍提示。

when: Email drafts, release notes, and product copy rewritten by an AI where users approve or reject scattered phrase edits individually.
Make-it-shorter, fix-grammar, and tone-adjustment workflows that keep unchanged sentences verbatim.
not: Multi-file source code diffs with line gutters—use ReviewCenter with ReviewFile entries instead.
Complete from-scratch rewrites where nearly every word changes.
en.apiLead: InlineDiff exports diff_words(original, suggested) to compute grouped DiffSegment runs, tracks per-change decisions with an undo stack, and emits InlineDiffEvent with live assembled prose.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an InlineDiff preloaded with the 4-edit announcement rewrite.

props.name: with_texts
props.description: Diff original prose against suggested prose word by word.

props.name: with_segments
props.description: Supply precomputed Equal and Change segments directly.

props.name: with_label
props.default: Some("Suggested by AI · Make it shorter")
props.description: Configure or hide the sparkle provenance line above the paragraph.

motion: Accepting smoothly collapses struck red words while fading the green highlight into plain prose; rejecting collapses green insertions in reverse.
The Accept / Reject popover glides between suggestions via pro_spring_f32 and the completion check draws itself on Done; reduced motion resolves immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::inline_diff::{InlineDiff, diff_words} (library) or crate::ui::components::inline_diff::InlineDiff after running kui add inline-diff.
Subscribe to InlineDiffEvent::Decided and InlineDiffEvent::Done to persist the live assembled draft.

when: 邮件草稿、发版公告与产品文案经 AI 精简或润色后，由人工逐处确认或回退词句改动的场景。
“更精炼”“修正语法”“调整语气”等大部分原句保持不变的局部改写流程。
not: 带行号与文件头的多文件源代码审查——请使用 ReviewCenter 的 ReviewFile 模式。
几乎全文重写的长篇生成对比。
zh.apiLead: InlineDiff 导出 diff_words(original, suggested) 词级对比算法，内置多步撤销栈与逐处决断状态，并在每次操作后通过 InlineDiffEvent 返回最新合成文本。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 4 处精简改写建议的行内文本对比卡片。

props.name: with_texts
props.description: 传入原文与 AI 建议文本并自动按词计算合并差异。

props.name: with_segments
props.description: 直接注入预计算的 Equal 与 Change 差异片段列表。

props.name: with_label
props.default: Some("Suggested by AI · Make it shorter")
props.description: 设置或隐藏段落上方的 AI 改写来源说明。

motion: 点击接受时红色删除词平滑收拢消失，绿色新增底纹柔和褪去融入正文；点击拒绝则反向收拢新增词。
悬浮审阅气泡通过 pro_spring_f32 在各处建议间丝滑游走，全部审完时对勾逐笔绘出；减少动效时立即切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::inline_diff::{InlineDiff, diff_words} 导入；执行 kui add inline-diff 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::inline_diff::InlineDiff 导入。
监听 InlineDiffEvent::Decided 与 InlineDiffEvent::Done 即可实时写回未决项保留原文的安全草稿。

lead.en: Run best-of-N completions through an LLM-as-a-judge tournament bracket—two contenders meet at a time, losers fade onto dashed arms, the champion's path lights up in blue, and clicking any match compares both answers side by side with scores and reasoning.
lead.zh: 以单败淘汰赛对阵图呈现 LLM-as-a-Judge 优选过程：两两候选方案同场对决，落败项淡出为虚线分支，冠军晋级之路以蓝光脉冲贯通，点击任一场次即可在下方并排对比两份代码/文本回答、评分与裁判理由。

rule.en: Click any Quarterfinal, Semifinal, or Final pairing (or use arrow keys) to compare both completions, rubric scores, and judge reasoning side by side below, then press Use champion.
rule.zh: 点击四分之一决赛、半决赛或决赛中的任一对阵（或使用方向键导航），在下方并排查阅两份候选方案、评分与裁判评语，并一键选用优胜结果。

when: Best-of-N coding or writing pipelines where an LLM judge compares candidate patches or drafts pairwise until one champion emerges.
Explaining to users why a winning completion beat alternatives with side-by-side outputs, rubric scores, and concise judge rationales.
not: Running parallel candidates without pairwise judge elimination—use ParallelAttempts instead.
Sequential failover when providers error out—use FallbackChain instead.
en.apiLead: JudgeBracket lays out 2-, 4-, or 8-seed tournament trees with fixed-height contender pills, winner/champion path connectors, and a side-by-side comparison & selection panel.

props.name: new
props.description: Create an 8-seed JudgeBracket evaluating candidate payment-retry bugfixes with Claude Opus 4.6.

props.name: with_contenders
props.description: Supply 2, 4, or 8 seeded completions with model brand marks, diff/test metadata, and outputs.

props.name: with_verdicts
props.description: Provide controlled match verdicts ([upper, lower] scores + reason) and optional active judging match.

props.name: with_judge
props.description: Set the judge model name credited in the comparison header.

props.name: champion
props.description: Return the winning BracketContender once the Final match has been decided.

motion: Contender names in the active match shimmer via pro_shimmer_text while eliminated slots dim flat onto dashed connectors without shifting bracket geometry.
Once the Final is decided, a blue pro_connector_pulse beam traces the champion's entire route from Round 1 to the trophy-badged Final slot; Theme::reduced_motion disables animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::judge_bracket::JudgeBracket (library) or crate::ui::components::judge_bracket::JudgeBracket after running kui add judge-bracket.
Seed contenders in initial pairing order (0 vs 1, 2 vs 3, …) and keep MatchVerdict::reason to one clear sentence.

when: Best-of-N 编程修复或文案生成工作流：由高阶裁判模型两两对比多份候选输出并逐轮决出最优方案。
向用户透明展示最终方案胜出的原因，支持随时回看每一轮对阵双方的原文、得分与评判依据。
not: 仅并发展示多个候选输出而不做裁判晋级对决（请使用 ParallelAttempts）。
上游模型报错后的顺位容灾重试（请使用 FallbackChain）。
zh.apiLead: JudgeBracket 自动排布 2、4 或 8 强对阵树，结合固定高度选手槽位、冠军蓝光通路与下方并排对比选用面板，并派发强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 8 份防重复扣款补丁方案、由 Claude Opus 4.6 担任裁判的锦标赛对阵树。

props.name: with_contenders
props.description: 按种子顺位传入 2、4 或 8 个候选方案，包含模型图标、测试摘要与输出代码/文本。

props.name: with_verdicts
props.description: 传入受控的各场裁决结果（上下方得分与胜出理由）及当前正在评审的场次坐标。

props.name: with_judge
props.description: 设置下方对比面板展示的裁判模型名称。

props.name: champion
props.description: 当决赛裁定完成后返回最终夺冠的候选方案。

motion: 正在接受评审的对阵双方名称通过 pro_shimmer_text 流光呈现，淘汰项在原位淡出并转为虚线连接，对阵树布局高度保持恒定。
决赛落定后，蓝色脉冲光束沿冠军晋级路径全程点亮并呈现奖杯徽标；开启减少动效时立即停驻。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::judge_bracket::JudgeBracket 导入；执行 kui add judge-bracket 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::judge_bracket::JudgeBracket 导入。
按首轮配对顺序（0 对 1、2 对 3……）传入 BracketContender，并将每场裁判理由凝练为一句话。

title.zh: 智能体记忆与工具图谱

lead.en: Place an agent at the center of everything it remembers and every tool it can reach—provenance cards on the left, scoped tools on the right, live pulses along rounded connectors, Gradient Floor washes on newly learned cards, switches to disable anything, and an Add popover on the agent.
lead.zh: 将智能体置于中央，左侧环绕附带文件/对话/邮件溯源的记忆卡片，右侧环绕带权限范围的已连接工具；圆角连线流淌实时光脉冲并以底部渐变光晕点亮新习得记忆，支持逐项开关、遗忘与点击智能体添加文件或工具。

rule.en: Click any memory or tool card to toggle its access switch or Forget a memory, hover a memory to reveal dashed links to related facts, or click the central agent to import a document or connect a catalog tool.
rule.zh: 点击任一记忆或工具卡片可切换启用开关或遗忘记忆，悬停记忆卡片显示关联虚线，点击中央智能体可导入文档或连接目录中的新工具。

when: Showing users what an assistant remembers about their preferences and projects alongside where each fact came from (file, chat, or email).
Visualizing which external tools an agent can reach right now while letting users switch individual memories or integrations off.
not: A flat searchable list of categorized memories with inline text editing and undo—use MemoryPanel instead.
Inspecting per-call arguments, latencies, and replayable logs for one run's tool invocations—use ToolAccessMap instead.
en.apiLead: MemoryGraph manages a stable six-slot left/right C-arc around the central agent, provenance artwork, switches, Forget, and catalog connection popovers with typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a MemoryGraph preloaded with 4 provenance memories, 5 tools (Figma active), and 3 catalog integrations.

props.name: with_memories
props.description: Supply left-ring memory cards with chat/file/email artifacts, related links, and superseding ids.

props.name: with_tools
props.description: Supply right-ring tool cards with access level, workspace scope, last action, and call count.

props.name: with_catalog
props.description: Provide unconnected integrations offered when clicking the central agent.

props.name: with_using
props.description: Control which tool ids are actively pulsing right now.

motion: Traveling pulses run from the central agent to active tools and recalled memories while newly learned or recalled cards bloom with a bottom Gradient Floor wash.

when: Settings pages or chat sidebars where users inspect, edit, pause, or delete facts the assistant remembered about them.
Products that need a non-destructive master personalization switch alongside per-memory controls.
not: Visualizing spatial connections between memories, source files, and external tools—use MemoryGraph instead.
Inspecting token budgets inside a single active conversation—use ContextWindow instead.
en.apiLead: MemoryPanel manages categorized MemoryEntry items, inline Editor instances for row editing and creation, search filtering, and soft-delete Undo restoration while emitting typed events.

lead.en: Visualize and configure how an LLM gateway splits traffic across models—light streaks flow along spring-width ribbons scaled to each share %, blended $/1K tokens compares against the live policy, and operators tune presets, fallback rules, and Deploy.
lead.zh: 直观配置大模型网关的流量切分策略：光束沿随占比弹簧伸缩的彩色流带注入各模型，顶部实时滚动对比混合千 Token 成本与线上基准，支持预设切换、自动回退规则选择与一键发布。

rule.en: Switch Cost, Balanced, or Quality presets (or press Left/Right arrows) to watch ribbon widths and blended cost roll, hover any model row to spotlight its stream, configure Fallback pickers, and click Deploy policy.
rule.zh: 切换成本优先、均衡或质量优先预设（或按左右方向键）观察流带粗细与混合成本平滑变化，悬停任一模型高亮对应通路，配置失败回退模型后点击“发布策略”。

when: AI gateway and routing consoles where engineers compare Cost, Balanced, and Quality traffic splits against the live policy before deploying.
Configuring blended token cost targets alongside single-hop failover rules across frontier and fast models.
not: Inspecting historical token spend over days or weeks—use ModelUsage instead.
Tracing one individual request's retry cascade across failing providers—use FallbackChain instead.
en.apiLead: ModelRouter synchronizes spring-width PathBuilder ribbons, pro_rolling_number blended $/1K readouts, pro_pill_indicator strategy tabs, route tables, and fallback model pickers with versioned deploy state.

Blended $/1K cost and per-row shares roll via pro_rolling_number, strategy selection glides via pro_pill_indicator, and fallback menus settle via pro_presence; Theme::reduced_motion disables animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::model_router::ModelRouter (library) or crate::ui::components::model_router::ModelRouter after running kui add model-router.
Supply cost_per_1k in USD and p95_secs in seconds; shares in RouterStrategy are automatically normalized to sum to 100%.

同时管理多模型流量权重、p95 延迟指标与主备模型自动回退规则。

追踪单条请求遇到报错时的逐级重试过程（请使用 FallbackChain）。

rule.en: The highest-scoring finished attempt is automatically marked Best and selected; click any attempt row to inspect its code diff and switch the active winner, or press Re-run to replay the race.
rule.zh: 得分最高的已完成方案将自动标记“最佳”并默认采用；点击任意方案行即可检视统一代码差异并切换优胜结果，或点击“重跑”回放并行竞速。

when: Best-of-N coding, drafting, or planning runs where multiple models or approaches race in parallel and an evaluator scores each outcome.
Surfacing why the winning attempt won while letting humans inspect alternative diffs and override the pick in one click.
not: Hundreds of independent sub-tasks across workers (use FanOutGrid), step-by-step latency inside one run (use TraceWaterfall), or human policy forks (use DecisionTree).
en.apiLead: ParallelAttempts pairs provider marks, spring progress bars, automatic Best crowning, and a cross-fading diff inspector with typed Pick and Inspect events.

lead.en: Ask for one specific right when an agent hits a boundary—showing who asks, target app, reason, and exact impact—with Allow once, Allow for 1 hour, or Always allow folding into a draining status line with Revoke.
lead.zh: 当智能体触达权限边界时请求单项细粒度授权：展示发起者、目标应用、原因与具体变更影响，支持“仅一次 / 1 小时 / 始终允许”并在授权后折叠为带倒计时进度条与“撤销”的状态行。

rule.en: Pick Once, 1 hour, or Always with clicks or ← → arrows, press Enter to grant (folding into a live timer bar with Revoke) or Esc to deny, and click Revoke to reopen.
rule.zh: 点击或按左右方向键选择“仅此次 / 1 小时 / 始终允许”，按 Enter 授权（平滑折叠为带剩余时间条与“撤销”的状态行）或按 Esc 拒绝，点击撤销即可重新展开。

when: An agent encounters an action it does not yet hold permission for—pushing to main, issuing refunds, or messaging customers—and requests that exact scope.
Time-bounded human-in-the-loop grants (1 hour) where operators want a visible countdown and instant Revoke.
not: Configuring broad upfront autonomy levels across all actions—use AutonomyDial instead.
First-time OAuth account linking flows handled by external identity providers.
en.apiLead: PermissionRequest combines agent and app identity, impact previews, three-stop scope selection, destructive-action guardrails, and a live timed-grant status bar.

希望授予限时权限（如允许 1 小时）并实时展示剩余有效时间与一键撤销按钮的场景。

首次连接第三方账号的 OAuth 外部授权流程。
zh.apiLead: PermissionRequest 集成了智能体与目标应用标识、具体影响预览、三档时效选择、破坏性操作护栏，以及带实时消耗条的已授权状态行。

motion: pro_pill_indicator 在“仅此次 / 1 小时 / 始终允许”之间平滑滑动，并同步切换主按钮文案。
点击允许或拒绝后通过 pro_fold 收折为 58px 单行状态条，底部附带 2px 实时缩减的绿色剩余时间条；开启减少动效时停止连续刷新。

when: Showing whether an autonomous agent run stays on schedule—and pinpointing which step caused downstream delay.
Giving users an honest projected finish time (ETA vs Plan) while dependent steps are still running.
not: Pre-run plan editing (use AgentPlan) or multi-agent parallel swimlanes (use AgentLanes).
en.apiLead: PlanVsActual computes DAG planned windows, actual/overrun bar splits, downstream forecast shifts, and time/cost rollups from millisecond timestamps.

在串并联依赖流程运行过程中，为用户提供诚实可信的动态预计完成时间（ETA 对比 Plan）。
not: 运行前编辑计划步骤（请使用 AgentPlan），或多个智能体并行协作泳道（请使用 AgentLanes）。
zh.apiLead: PlanVsActual 基于毫秒级依赖图自动推导计划窗口、超时琥珀分段、下游预测顺延以及时间与费用汇总。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载“上线定价页面” 7 步甘特对比图的组件实例。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 按依赖拓扑顺序传入步骤，配置预计毫秒数、实际起止毫秒数、工具图标与成本。

props.name: with_now
props.description: 设置当前距离任务启动的毫秒进度。

props.name: with_task
props.description: 设置顶栏标题旁展示的任务说明。

props.name: with_live
props.description: 使运行中步骤条与耗时统计随实时时钟平滑推进。

motion: 当上游步骤超时变琥珀色或提前完成时，等待中步骤条与横轴量程通过 Slide 弹簧平滑滑移，悬停时由 PathBuilder 绘制正交依赖连线；开启减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::plan_vs_actual::PlanVsActual 导入；执行 kui add plan-vs-actual 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::plan_vs_actual::PlanVsActual 导入。
请确保每个 PlanStep 排在其 deps 依赖步骤之后，以保证向下绘制的依赖连线清晰准确。

lead.en: Schedule recurring agent batch runs against a 24-hour API TPM ceiling—hatching overlapping overflow peaks in red, dragging bars across hours, and spreading peaks out in one click.
lead.zh: 围绕 24 小时 API 每分钟 Token 限额编排智能体作业：超限峰值自动绘制红色斜线阴影，支持拖拽调整启动时刻与“一键错峰”削峰。

rule.en: Drag any schedule bar horizontally (or nudge with arrow keys) to watch the 24-hour aggregate TPM curve and red diagonal hatch respond live, or click Spread out to separate overlapping runs below the ceiling.
rule.zh: 横向拖动任意任务时间条（或用方向键微调）即可实时更新 24 小时聚合负载曲线与红色超限阴影；点击“一键错峰”可自动分散重叠高峰。

when: Ops and workspace settings pages where teams schedule cron agents, nightly evals, and enrichment batches under one shared API TPM ceiling.
Explaining why overlapping schedules trigger 429 rate-limit errors and letting users fix them visually.
not: Per-second live request telemetry dashboards, or weekly session-quota task packing (use ScheduledRuns).
en.apiLead: RateLimitPlanner models S-curve climb and exponential half-life decay per job, clips -45° red hatch lines above the ceiling via PathBuilder, and emits typed RunsChanged and SpreadOut events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a 24-hour planner preloaded with 4 overlapping agent runs peaking above 120k / min.

props.name: with_runs
props.description: Supply scheduled runs with start minute, peak TPM, climb duration, and decay half-life.

props.name: with_limit
props.description: Set the API rate limit ceiling in tokens per minute.

props.name: with_buffer
props.description: Set the safety buffer fraction above which the status badge warns Close to limit.

props.name: with_start_hour
props.description: Set the starting hour (0..23) of the 24-hour timeline.

motion: Spread out and keyboard shifts glide bars and smoothly morph the aggregate curve and hatched overflow via pro_spring_f32, while pointer drags track 1:1; Theme::reduced_motion disables spring travel and avatar twinkle.
ai: Import from kui::components::rate_limit_planner::RateLimitPlanner (library) or crate::ui::components::rate_limit_planner::RateLimitPlanner after running kui add rate-limit-planner.
Mark already-started jobs with with_pinned_running(true) so Spread out only reschedules upcoming runs.

when: 在运维或工作区设置页中，围绕共享 API 每分钟 Token 上限统筹定时智能体、夜间评测与线索批处理时间窗。
直观呈现多任务重叠引发 429 限流的根因，并支持拖拽或一键自动削峰。
not: 秒级实时请求监控大盘，或按周会话配额装箱拆单场景（请使用 ScheduledRuns）。
zh.apiLead: RateLimitPlanner 基于 S 形爬升与指数半衰尾迹合成全天负载曲线，使用 PathBuilder 精确裁剪超限红色斜线阴影，并发出强类型 RunsChanged 与 SpreadOut 事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 4 项重叠任务（峰值突破 120k/分钟）的 24 小时排程器。

props.name: with_runs
props.description: 传入包含启动分钟数、峰值 TPM、爬升时长与半衰期的任务列表。

props.name: with_limit
props.description: 设置 API 每分钟 Token 速率上限。

props.name: with_buffer
props.description: 设置安全缓冲比例（超出后徽标提示“接近限额”）。

props.name: with_start_hour
props.description: 设置 24 小时时间轴左起整点小时（0..23）。

motion: 点击“一键错峰”或方向键微调时通过 pro_spring_f32 平滑驱动时间条与超限阴影变形，鼠标拖拽保持零延迟跟随；开启减少动效时立即落位。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::rate_limit_planner::RateLimitPlanner 导入；执行 kui add rate-limit-planner 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::rate_limit_planner::RateLimitPlanner 导入。
对已在运行中的任务调用 with_pinned_running(true)，使一键错峰仅重排尚未启动的任务。

lead.en: Show how an agent spent its thinking time across Search, Read, Plan, and Verify—with cross-linked bar segments, model effort meters, token/cost disclosures, and collapsible sources.
lead.zh: 在一张紧凑卡片中浓缩智能体回答背后的思考分配：涵盖闪烁徽标、认知分段进度条、多模型推理强度与成本折叠详情，以及可展开检索来源与步骤轨迹。

rule.en: Hover any bar segment, cognitive kind, or participating model to isolate what belongs together; click a model for provider, tokens, and cost, or expand Searched sources and Steps below.
rule.zh: 悬停任意分段、认知类别或参与模型即可联动高亮关联项；点击模型行查看提供商、Token 与成本，或展开底部检索来源与步骤明细。

when: Compact provenance cards above or below an assistant answer showing how long reasoning took, which cognitive phases ran, and which models contributed.
Multi-model routed answers where users want effort levels, token counts, USD spend, and searched sources one click away.
not: Single-line inline streaming spinners (use ThinkingState), deep nested span trees (use TraceWaterfall), or full run billing breakdowns (use CostWaterfall).
en.apiLead: ReasoningSummary links cognitive step segments, 2-column kind totals, 4-bar model effort meters, and pro_fold disclosures with typed toggle events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a reasoning summary preloaded with a 5-step, 3-model run across 24 sources.

props.name: with_steps
props.description: Supply ordered Search, Read, Plan, and Verify steps with model links and durations.

props.name: with_models
props.description: Supply participating models with artwork keys, EffortLevel, token counts, and USD cost.

props.name: with_sources
props.description: Supply searched sources rendered in the stacked footer icons and Sources drawer.

props.name: with_source_count
props.description: Set the total searched source count (+ N more shown when larger than sources.len()).

motion: Active reasoning twinkles pro_agent_avatar, shimmers the header and active trace step, sweeps a specular sheen across the growing bar segment, and unfolds disclosures via pro_fold; Theme::reduced_motion renders static states.
ai: Import from kui::components::reasoning_summary::ReasoningSummary (library) or crate::ui::components::reasoning_summary::ReasoningSummary after running kui add reasoning-summary.
Set with_model(model_id) on every ReasonStep so cross-linked hover highlighting and per-model durations sum accurately.

when: 置于智能体回答上方或下方的紧凑溯源卡片，清晰呈现思考时长以及检索、阅读、规划、验证各阶段占比。
多模型协同路由场景，支持一键下钻查看各模型推理强度、输入输出 Token、美元开销与检索来源。
not: 流式生成期间的单行极简思考提示（请使用 ThinkingState）、多层嵌套调用链时间瀑布（请使用 TraceWaterfall）或完整账单成本拆解（请使用 CostWaterfall）。
zh.apiLead: ReasoningSummary 将认知分段条、双列类别统计、四格推理强度计与 pro_fold 折叠抽屉联动，并发出强类型展开切换事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 5 个认知步骤、3 款协同模型与 24 个检索来源的推理摘要卡片。

props.name: with_steps
props.description: 传入带有关联模型与毫秒耗时的检索、阅读、规划、验证步骤列表。

props.name: with_models
props.description: 传入参与模型及其徽标键、推理强度等级、Token 用量与费用。

props.name: with_sources
props.description: 传入在底部图标叠层与来源抽屉中展示的检索源列表。

props.name: with_source_count
props.description: 设置总检索来源数（超出列表长度时自动显示“+ 其余 N 个来源”）。

motion: 推理进行时 pro_agent_avatar 呈对角波浪闪烁，活跃分段伴随高光扫掠平滑延展，模型详情、来源与步骤抽屉通过 pro_fold 弹性展开；开启减少动效时立即呈现静态结果。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::reasoning_summary::ReasoningSummary 导入；执行 kui add reasoning-summary 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::reasoning_summary::ReasoningSummary 导入。
请为每个 ReasonStep 指定 with_model(model_id)，以确保跨维悬停联动高亮与分模型累计耗时准确闭合。

lead.en: Visualize a codebase as an LOC-proportional treemap where live coding agents hop between files, fill edited tiles bottom-up, dash read-only files, and blink orange on write conflicts.
lead.zh: 按代码行数比例将仓库绘制为目录分组树图：智能体像素徽标在文件间平滑跳跃，编辑文件自下而上着色流光，只读文件虚线描边，双智能体并发改写同一文件时呈橙色冲突闪烁。

rule.en: Hover or walk any file tile to inspect its path, LOC, diff counts, and active agents; click an agent chip to isolate its touched files, or press Step agents to watch avatars hop across the repo.
rule.zh: 悬停或用方向键巡检任意文件块以查看路径、行数、增删统计与活跃智能体；点击智能体胶囊可隔离高亮其触达文件，点击“推进跳转”观察跨文件跃迁。

when: Multi-agent coding workspaces where developers need to see each agent's footprint across folders and spot same-file write collisions before they merge.
Live run overviews where edited files retain each agent's color as work progresses across the repository.
not: Single-agent prompt token breakdowns (use ContextMap), linear commit histories (use CommitTrail), or line-by-line code hunks (use DiffTimeline).
en.apiLead: RepoMap computes a deterministic neighbor-preserving treemap grouped by folder depth, tracks concurrent write conflicts, glides agent pins via pro_spring_f32, and emits typed RepoMapEvents.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a repo treemap preloaded with 23 acme/web files and 4 active agents.

props.name: with_files
props.description: Supply repository paths, LOC counts, and historical agent edit stats.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Supply active coding agents with color slots, target file paths, and Edit or Read actions.

props.name: with_depth
props.description: Set how many directory levels group files into titled treemap regions.

props.name: with_branch
props.description: Set the Git branch badge shown beside the repository name.

motion: Agent avatars hop between tiles on pro_spring_f32 springs while twinkling in diagonal waves, newly entered edit tiles fill bottom-up with a sweeping sheen, and write conflicts pulse orange; Theme::reduced_motion disables sweeps, blinks, and spring travel.
ai: Import from kui::components::repo_map::RepoMap (library) or crate::ui::components::repo_map::RepoMap after running kui add repo-map.
Keep the file slice order stable across updates so treemap tiles preserve their neighbors without jumping.

when: 多智能体并行编码工作台：一眼掌握各智能体在目录树中的读写足迹，并在合并前提前发现同文件并发写冲突。
实时任务总览：随着编码推进，被修改过的文件保留对应智能体主题色，形成完整变更热力版图。
not: 单个智能体上下文窗口容量构成（请使用 ContextMap）、分支提交历史流（请使用 CommitTrail）或逐行代码差异对比（请使用 DiffTimeline）。
zh.apiLead: RepoMap 按目录深度计算保持邻接关系的确定性树图，自动检测同文件并发写入冲突，通过 pro_spring_f32 平滑驱动智能体跨块跳跃并发出强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载 acme/web 仓库 23 个文件与 4 个活跃智能体的代码版图。

props.name: with_files
props.description: 传入文件路径、代码行数（LOC）与各智能体历史增删统计。

props.name: with_agents
props.default: 鉴权、界面、测试、文档智能体
props.description: 传入活跃编码智能体及其配色槽位、当前所在文件与编辑/只读模式。

props.name: with_depth
props.description: 设置聚合为带标题目录区块的路径层级深度。

props.name: with_branch
props.description: 设置仓库名称旁显示的 Git 分支胶囊。

motion: 智能体像素徽标通过 pro_spring_f32 在文件块间平滑跃迁并对角闪烁，新进入编辑的文件自下而上注满色彩并扫过流光，写冲突块呈橙色呼吸闪烁；开启减少动效时立即落位且关闭闪烁。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::repo_map::RepoMap 导入；执行 kui add repo-map 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::repo_map::RepoMap 导入。
增量刷新时请保持 files 列表顺序稳定，使树图切分维持原有邻接布局而不发生跳动。

lead.en: Guide a single streamed agent answer through every state—smooth word-by-word arrival, exact-word Stop & Continue, mid-sentence Failure & Retry, and Done—with steer and queued message chips above it.
lead.zh: 完整呈现智能体流式回答的每个状态：逐词柔和显现、原词位暂停与继续、半句故障断点重试与完成态复制，并在上方清晰展示实时引导与排队消息胶囊。

rule.en: Keep the footer at a single stable 28px row across Streaming, Stopped, Failed, and Done so actions never jump vertically.
rule.zh: 在流式输出、暂停、故障与完成四种状态间保持底部操作栏 28px 恒定单行高度，避免界面上下跳动。

when: Agent chat feeds where each assistant message owns its own Streaming, Stopped, Failed, and Done recovery controls.
Displaying mid-answer Steer and Next-queued chips cleanly above the response alongside quiet steer-bend dividers.
not: Full composer decks with text input, Chat/Act mode, and permission menus—use RunControls instead.
Grounded Q&A cards focused on numbered source citations and thumbs feedback—use AiAnswer instead.
en.apiLead: ResponseStream parses prose and fenced code blocks into word-addressable segments, preserves exact word_cursor positions across Stop and Failed states, and emits ResponseStreamEvent.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a ResponseStream preloaded with Atlas's 3-step rollout plan, code block, steer chip, and queued chip.

props.name: with_text
props.description: Set the markdown-lite answer text (paragraphs and ``` fenced code blocks).

props.name: with_status
props.description: Set Streaming, Stopped, Failed, or Done.

props.name: with_chips
props.description: Display Steer and Next/Queued message chips above the answer.

props.name: with_controls
props.description: Show or hide the interactive lifecycle simulation bar above the turn.

motion: Newest arriving words settle over 180ms beside a breathing 2px blue caret while the 3x3 agent mark twinkles in a diagonal wave.
Lifecycle selector pills glide via pro_pill_indicator and Theme::reduced_motion renders crisp static words and caret.
ai: Import from kui::components::response_stream::ResponseStream (library) or crate::ui::components::response_stream::ResponseStream after running kui add response-stream.
Pass .with_controls(false) when rendering inside your own production message list.

when: 每条智能体回复自带流式输出、原词暂停续写、断线重试与复制重新生成的对话消息流。
需要在回复上方展示中途引导（Steer）与排队下一条（Next）胶囊，并在正文标注引导折点分割线。
not: 包含底部输入框、对话/执行模式切换与权限策略的完整控制台——请使用 RunControls。
侧重多信源编号引用卡片与点赞反馈的检索增强回答——请使用 AiAnswer。
zh.apiLead: ResponseStream 将段落与代码块解析为词级寻址片段，在暂停与故障状态下精准保留 word_cursor 断点，并通过 ResponseStreamEvent 派发事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 Atlas 三步发布方案、代码块、引导胶囊与排队胶囊的流式回答组件。

props.name: with_text
props.description: 设置回答正文（支持多段落与 ``` 围栏代码块）。

props.name: with_status
props.description: 设置当前生命周期状态（Streaming、Stopped、Failed、Done）。

props.name: with_chips
props.description: 配置回答上方的实时引导与排队消息胶囊。

props.name: with_controls
props.description: 显示或隐藏顶部的生命周期状态交互切换栏。

motion: 新到达词元在 180ms 内平滑显现，配合柔和呼吸的 2px 蓝色光标与 3x3 对角波纹智能体徽标。
状态模拟胶囊通过 pro_pill_indicator 平滑滑动；开启减少动效时文字与光标保持静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::response_stream::ResponseStream 导入；执行 kui add response-stream 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::response_stream::ResponseStream 导入。
嵌入生产对话流列表时调用 .with_controls(false) 即可仅渲染回答卡片本身。

lead.en: Sign off on high-volume agent proposals in a focused two-pane workspace—risk-sorted queue on the left, uncertain spans highlighted in amber on the right, single-key decisions, and an animated resolution stamp.
lead.zh: 在专注的双栏工作台高效签批智能体提案：左侧队列按风险分级排序，右侧琥珀色标出存疑片段，单键完成批准、行内编辑、驳回与撤销。

rule.en: Press A to approve, E to edit inline (⌘↵ saves & approves), R then 1–4 to reject with a reason, S to skip, F to inspect flagged spans, and Z to undo.
rule.zh: 按 A 批准，按 E 行内编辑（⌘↵ 保存并批准），按 R 加 1–4 选择驳回原因，按 S 跳过，按 F 检视存疑片段，按 Z 撤销。

when: Human-in-the-loop queues at volume where reviewers sign off on code diffs, migrations, contract redlines, plans, and refunds one after another.
Workflows where seeing why the agent wants an action—and which exact span it is unsure about—matters as much as the action itself.
not: Monitoring active background tasks without blocking approvals—use RunningNow instead.
Single prose paragraph rewrites where edits are accepted word by word—use InlineDiff instead.
en.apiLead: ReviewCenter sorts undecided proposals by risk or wait time, highlights uncertain ReviewSpan flags with Agent's note inspection, edits proposals inline via Editor, and emits typed ReviewCenterEvent verdicts.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a ReviewCenter preloaded with 8 canonical proposals across High, Medium, and Low risk.

props.name: with_items
props.description: Supply waiting code diffs, contract clauses, migrations, plans, or refund drafts.

props.name: with_reviewed
props.description: Set the baseline count of items reviewed earlier today for the header progress bar.

props.name: with_sla_mins
props.description: SLA window in minutes—waiting times turn amber at 75% and red at 100%.

props.name: with_default_filter
props.description: Set the initial queue filter (All, HighRisk, Unsure).

motion: Approving or rejecting stamps APPROVED or REJECTED onto the departing proposal card as it lifts away and the next item glides smoothly up from +10px.
Queue filter pills glide via pro_pill_indicator, progress fills via pro_spring_bar, and reviewed counts roll via pro_rolling_number; Theme::reduced_motion switches immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::review_center::ReviewCenter (library) or crate::ui::components::review_center::ReviewCenter after running kui add review-center.
Flag only genuinely uncertain expressions via ReviewSpan::flagged(text, note, source) rather than highlighting whole paragraphs.

when: 高吞吐量的人机协同签批场景：逐条审核代码变更、数据库迁移、合同红线、执行计划或退款草稿。
审核者不仅要看到智能体准备做什么，还需精准定位智能体自身存疑的参数或代码表达式。
not: 仅需在顶栏或侧栏概览后台运行任务进度——请使用 RunningNow。
针对单段文案逐词接受或拒绝 AI 润色修改——请使用 InlineDiff。
zh.apiLead: ReviewCenter 支持按风险或等待时长排序队列、琥珀色高亮 ReviewSpan 存疑片段、内置 Editor 行内改稿批准，并通过 ReviewCenterEvent 回调完整审批结果。
