props.name: with_items
props.description: 传入待审批的代码 Diff、合同条款、SQL 迁移、分步计划或回复草稿。

props.name: with_reviewed
props.description: 设置今日已完成审核的基数，驱动顶部进度条与滚动计数。

props.name: with_sla_mins
props.description: SLA 等待阈值（分钟），达 75% 变琥珀色预警，达 100% 变红色超时。

props.name: with_default_filter
props.description: 设置队列初始筛选标签（All、HighRisk、Unsure）。

motion: 执行批准或驳回时，离开的卡片会盖上 APPROVED / REJECTED 印章并轻盈上浮淡出，下一条提案随即从下方平滑升起。
筛选胶囊通过 pro_pill_indicator 滑动，进度条与已审计数平滑过渡；开启减少动效时立即切换。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::review_center::ReviewCenter 导入；执行 kui add review-center 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::review_center::ReviewCenter 导入。
使用 ReviewSpan::flagged(text, note, source) 仅标记智能体真正不确定的关键表达式或金额。

lead.en: Follow how an agent debugs a failed run as an OR/AND fault tree—checking hypotheses one after another, keeping ruled-out branches on dashed lines, lighting the causal path once confirmed, and surfacing diffs and Fix actions below.
lead.zh: 以 OR/AND 故障树呈现智能体排查运行失败的全过程：逐一验证候选假设、将排除分支保留在虚线轨道上、在定位根因后点亮向上回溯的因果链路，并在下方呈现差异证据与一键修复操作。

rule.en: Click any hypothesis card to inspect its verdict, touched files, and diff/log evidence below; use Step check or Auto to watch ruled-out branches dim and confirmed root causes light the path up to the failure.
rule.zh: 点击任一假设卡片在下方查看结论、涉及文件与代码差异/日志证据；使用单步验证或自动排查观察分支排除与根因因果链路点亮过程。

when: Showing how an autonomous debugging or SRE agent investigates a failing test suite or production incident across candidate hypotheses.
Run postmortems where causes combine via OR (one defect breaks it) or AND (multiple defects must occur together) with verifiable diffs and logs.
not: Showing parent-child sub-agent task delegation—use AgentTree instead.
Listing flat code review findings without causal gates—use AgentFindings instead.
en.apiLead: RootCauseTree lays out fixed-height symptom and hypothesis cards across OR/AND logic gates, evaluates causal chain satisfaction, and pairs the tree with a live evidence & remediation panel.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a RootCauseTree preloaded with the Checkout tests failing fault tree (OR + AND gates, 5 hypotheses).

props.name: with_failure
props.description: Supply a custom recursive CauseNode tree with CauseGate::Or / CauseGate::And, verdicts, and CauseEvidence.

props.name: with_demo_step
props.description: Set the initial step (0..=4) of the built-in investigation walkthrough.

props.name: with_live
props.description: Enable or pause automatic progression through candidate hypotheses.

motion: Actively checked hypotheses shimmer via pro_shimmer_text while ruled-out cards settle flat onto dashed connectors without shifting tree geometry.
Confirmed leaf root causes drive an upward blue pro_connector_pulse beam through satisfied AND/OR gates to the top failure; Theme::reduced_motion disables animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::root_cause_tree::RootCauseTree (library) or crate::ui::components::root_cause_tree::RootCauseTree after running kui add root-cause-tree.
Keep ruled-out CauseNode entries in children with CauseStatus::RuledOut rather than deleting them so operators see every hypothesis that was tested.

when: 展示自主调试代理或运维智能体针对测试失败或线上告警逐项排查候选假设的推理过程。
复盘由单点触发（OR 门）或多因叠加（AND 门）导致的故障，并附带可核验的代码差异与日志证明。
not: 展示多智能体之间的父子任务分派（请使用 AgentTree）。
平铺展示无因果组合关系的代码巡检问题列表（请使用 AgentFindings）。
zh.apiLead: RootCauseTree 自动排布固定高度的顶层故障卡、OR/AND 逻辑门芯片与多层假设节点，实时计算因果通路并在下方联动展示差异证据与修复按钮。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置“结账测试套件失败”排障场景（含 OR 与 AND 复合门及 5 项假设）的根因诊断树。

props.name: with_failure
props.description: 传入自定义递归 CauseNode 故障树，支持任意层级假设、逻辑门与差异/日志证据。

props.name: with_demo_step
props.description: 指定内置诊断演示的起始步骤（0..=4，第 4 步点亮完整根因路径）。

props.name: with_live
props.description: 开启或暂停候选假设的自动验证推进。

motion: 正在验证的假设标题呈现流光扫掠，已排除分支在原位柔和淡出并转为虚线连接，保持卡片高度与树形结构稳定不跳动。
确认叶节点根因并满足逻辑门条件后，蓝色脉冲光束自下而上点亮直达顶层故障的因果路径；遵循减少动效设置。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::root_cause_tree::RootCauseTree 导入；执行 kui add root-cause-tree 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::root_cause_tree::RootCauseTree 导入。
已证伪的假设请保留在 children 中并设为 CauseStatus::RuledOut，以便用户完整了解哪些方向已被排查排除。

lead.en: Unify every control a running agent needs inside one composer—stop, exact-word resume, error retry or dismiss, inline mid-answer steering, queued messages, Chat vs Act mode, permission posture, and context fill.
lead.zh: 在一个输入台集齐运行中智能体的全部控制项：随时停止并从断点原词续写、断线重试、中途插入引导胶囊、排队追问、对话/执行双模切换、权限档位与上下文占用环。

rule.en: Press Esc to stop mid-answer and Resume from that exact word; while running, Enter steers immediately and ⌥↵ queues for next.
rule.zh: 输出途中按 Esc 停止并可点击继续从原词位续写；运行中按 Enter 即刻插入纠偏胶囊，按 ⌥↵ 排入下一轮队列。

when: Assistant and coding-agent composers where streamed turns take time and users need to stop, redirect mid-sentence, or line up the next request.
Resilient streaming interfaces that survive manual stops or dropped connections without discarding already generated words.
not: Steering an explicit multi-step plan—use AgentSteering so notes attach to plan steps.
Rendering a standalone streamed answer without a composer—use ResponseStream instead.
en.apiLead: RunControls tracks exact word-cursor progress, inline RunSteerChip insertions, RunQueuedMessage trays, Chat/Act mode, permission menus, and context fill while emitting RunControlsEvent.

props.name: new
props.description: Create RunControls preloaded with the Trip planner streamed answer, one steer chip, and one queued message.

props.name: with_status
props.description: Set the turn lifecycle state (Idle, Running, Stopped, Error, Done).

props.name: with_mode
props.description: Select Chat (answers only) or Act (enables the permission posture selector).

props.name: with_permission
props.description: Choose AskFirst, AutoEdits, or FullAccess (rendered in alert red).

props.name: with_context_used
props.description: Context window share in 0.0..=1.0; turns orange at 80% and above.

motion: The 3x3 pixel mark twinkles in a diagonal wave and the block caret breathes while streaming; stopping swaps cleanly to Resume, Retry, and Dismiss.
Mode selection glides via pro_pill_indicator, the permission popover animates via pro_presence, and the context ring sweeps via pro_progress_ring; reduced motion disables continuous pulses.
ai: Import from kui::components::run_controls::RunControls (library) or crate::ui::components::run_controls::RunControls after running kui add run-controls.
Preserve word_cursor across Stop and Error states so Resume and Retry continue without repeating earlier paragraphs.

when: 生成耗时较长的智能体对话与编程工作台：支持中途打断、半途纠偏或提前排队下一条指令。
需要在手动暂停或网络闪断后保留已生成文本、从断点原词无缝续写的流式交互。
not: 针对带明确步骤列表的执行计划纠偏——请使用 AgentSteering。
仅展示流式回答本身而无需底部输入控制台——请使用 ResponseStream。
zh.apiLead: RunControls 维护精确到词位的流式游标、行内纠偏胶囊、待发消息托盘、对话/执行模式、权限菜单与上下文环，并通过 RunControlsEvent 输出强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 Trip planner 实时行程流、行内纠偏胶囊与排队消息的运行控制台。

props.name: with_status
props.description: 设置当前轮次状态（Idle、Running、Stopped、Error、Done）。

props.name: with_mode
props.description: 切换 Chat（仅问答）或 Act（激活工具与编辑权限选择器）。

props.name: with_permission
props.description: 设置权限档位：AskFirst、AutoEdits 或红色预警的 FullAccess。

props.name: with_context_used
props.description: 上下文窗口占用比例（0.0..=1.0），达到 80% 自动切换橙色预警。

motion: 流式写作时 3x3 像素徽标呈对角波纹闪烁且块状光标柔和呼吸；按停止后平滑切换为继续、重试与忽略按钮。
模式切换采用 pro_pill_indicator 滑动胶囊，权限菜单通过 pro_presence 弹出，上下文容量环经 pro_progress_ring 平滑过渡；减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::run_controls::RunControls 导入；执行 kui add run-controls 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::run_controls::RunControls 导入。
在 Stopped 与 Error 状态下保留 word_cursor，使继续与断点重试无需重头复述已有内容。

lead.en: Keep background agent work visible in one compact header or sidebar pill—"3 running · 1 needs you"—that opens into a live task popover with filling rings, sub-steps, Pause/Resume, and Open actions.
lead.zh: 用一枚静谧的顶栏/侧栏状态胶囊汇总后台智能体动态（“3 运行中 · 1 待你处理”），展开即可查看环形进度、当前子步骤、暂停/恢复与待办直达。

rule.en: Keep task rows in stable list order so pausing, resuming, or opening a blocker never shifts rows under the pointer.
rule.zh: 保持任务行顺序恒定不变，确保点击暂停、恢复或打开待确认事项时列表绝不在鼠标下跳位。

when: Application headers and sidebars that should continuously report how many background agents are running and whether any task waits on the user.
Quickly pausing, resuming, or jumping to a blocked background job from any screen.
not: Full-screen multi-agent topology and morning recap curves—use MissionControlBlock instead.
Signing off on detailed diffs and uncertain spans one by one—use ReviewCenter instead.
en.apiLead: RunningNow computes live running/needs-you/paused counts in the trigger pill and renders a 348px popover with pro_progress_ring arcs, expandable sub-steps, and typed RunningNowEvent callbacks.

props.name: new
props.description: Create RunningNow preloaded with 5 background tasks across Running, NeedsYou, and Paused states.

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: Supply ordered background tasks with step copy, sub_steps, done/total counts, and state.

props.name: with_open
props.description: Control whether the background tasks popover starts open.

props.name: with_align
props.description: Align the popover with the Start (sidebar) or End (header right) edge of the trigger.

props.name: with_header_chrome
props.description: Render inside a contextual app header bar (true) or as a bare standalone trigger + popover (false).

motion: Each task ring sweeps smoothly via pro_progress_ring and shifts color from orange to teal to blue as steps complete, while NeedsYou rows highlight in amber.
Popover presence animates via pro_presence, step transitions crossfade via pro_view_transition, and sub-step lists disclose via pro_fold; reduced motion disables continuous pulses.
ai: Import from kui::components::running_now::RunningNow (library) or crate::ui::components::running_now::RunningNow after running kui add running-now.
Pass .with_header_chrome(false) when mounting RunningNow directly inside your own top bar.

when: 需要在应用顶栏或侧边栏常驻展示后台智能体并发数与人工待办提醒的全局入口。
无需离开当前页面即可随时暂停、继续后台作业或直达卡点审批项。
not: 全屏查看多智能体主从编队与离线波峰复盘——请使用 MissionControlBlock。
逐条深度审查代码 Diff 与存疑表达式——请使用 ReviewCenter。
zh.apiLead: RunningNow 自动汇总胶囊内的运行中/待确认/已暂停计数，并在 348px 浮层内呈现环形进度、可展开子步骤与强类型事件回调。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 5 项涵盖运行中、待确认与已暂停状态的后台任务状态组件。

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: 注入带当前步骤文案、子步骤列表、完成进度及状态的有序任务。

props.name: with_open
props.description: 设置任务浮层初始是否展开。

props.name: with_align
props.description: 设置浮层对齐方向：Start（侧栏左对齐）或 End（顶栏右对齐）。

props.name: with_header_chrome
props.description: 是否渲染外层示例顶栏（嵌入业务自有导航栏时可传 false）。

motion: 每行进度环通过 pro_progress_ring 平滑扫过，随完成度从橙色过渡至青色与完成蓝，待确认项以琥珀色醒目标记。
浮层显隐采用 pro_presence，步骤文案通过 pro_view_transition 微移切换，子步骤通过 pro_fold 展开；开启减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::running_now::RunningNow 导入；执行 kui add running-now 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::running_now::RunningNow 导入。
嵌入应用自有顶栏或侧边栏时调用 .with_header_chrome(false) 即可仅渲染胶囊与浮层。

lead.en: Pack queued coding and research tasks into a week of quota-capped sessions—filling remaining gaps, splitting oversized tasks across windows, and staggering cards smoothly into place.
lead.zh: 将待办智能体任务装入一周的配额受限执行窗口：小任务自动填补剩余空隙，超限大任务跨相邻会话平滑切分，卡片依次滑入就位。

rule.en: Switch between Auto packing and Manual placement, click + Add task or Rebalance to watch cards stagger into free session gaps, or click any card and target cell to move it by hand.
rule.zh: 支持在“自动”装箱与“手动”排布间切换；点击“新增任务”或“重排均衡”观察卡片依次飞入空余配额，或点击任意卡片与目标窗口手动迁移。

when: Coding agents and quota-metered runners operating in fixed 5-hour or daily usage sessions across a multi-day backlog.
Showing users exactly which session will execute each queued task and which large tasks span two or more sessions.
not: Immediate FIFO worker queues with no session windows (use AgentQueue), agent-to-agent delegation chains (use AgentHandoff), or per-minute API rate ceilings (use RateLimitPlanner).
en.apiLead: ScheduledRuns exports the deterministic plan_week packer (never splitting tasks <= limit, respecting min_piece >= 15% on splits), animates slot meters via pro_spring_bar, and emits typed ScheduledRunsEvents.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a weekly session board preloaded with 9 coding tasks across Tue–Thu 5-hour windows.

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: Supply pre-booked and unbooked tasks with session usage shares and agent runner icons.

props.name: with_now
props.description: Mark the active running session (dimming earlier sessions and drawing the red Now boundary).

props.name: with_limit
props.description: Set the maximum usage capacity per session window.

props.name: with_min_piece
props.description: Set the smallest allowed slice when splitting an oversized task across sessions.

motion: Switching to Auto, adding tasks, or rebalancing staggers cards smoothly into their slots via PhaseClock + pro_ease while session usage meters glide via pro_spring_bar; Theme::reduced_motion places cards immediately.
ai: Import from kui::components::scheduled_runs::ScheduledRuns (library) or crate::ui::components::scheduled_runs::ScheduledRuns after running kui add scheduled-runs.
Call plan_week directly when you need identical server-side or CLI session packing outside a window.

when: 受单次会话配额（如 5 小时窗口上限）约束的编码或调研智能体，需将整周待办自动排入多日时间表。
在任务启动前清晰告知每项任务的预计执行窗口，以及哪些大型任务需跨多个会话接力完成。
not: 无会话配额概念的即时工作队列（请使用 AgentQueue）、智能体间任务移交（请使用 AgentHandoff）或每分钟 Token 速率削峰（请使用 RateLimitPlanner）。
zh.apiLead: ScheduledRuns 导出确定性 plan_week 装箱算法（单会话可容纳任务绝不拆分，跨窗切分严格遵守 min_piece 下限），配合 pro_spring_bar 配额条并发出强类型排期事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预载周二至周四 5 小时窗口及 9 项研发任务的排期看板。

props.name: with_tasks
props.description: 传入包含配额占比、智能体徽标及可选预订位置的任务列表。

props.name: with_now
props.description: 指定当前正在运行的会话窗口（自动淡化过往窗口并绘制红色当前时刻线）。

props.name: with_limit
props.description: 设置单个会话窗口的最大配额上限。

props.name: with_min_piece
props.description: 设置拆分超限任务时单个分片的最小配额下限。

motion: 切入“自动”、新增任务或重排均衡时，卡片通过 PhaseClock 与 pro_ease 错峰滑入目标窗口，底部配额条经 pro_spring_bar 平滑伸缩；开启减少动效时直接静态就位。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::scheduled_runs::ScheduledRuns 导入；执行 kui add scheduled-runs 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::scheduled_runs::ScheduledRuns 导入。
若需在服务端或命令行复用完全一致的排期结果，可直接调用公开函数 plan_week。

lead.en: See every tool an agent can reach around a central hub—distinguishing Active now, Used, Failed, Not used yet, and No access—and click any granted tool to inspect and replay individual calls.
lead.zh: 围绕中央智能体直观展示全部工具的权限与运行状态（调用中脉冲光束、已使用、失败告警、尚未使用与无权限虚线），点击任一已授权工具即可查看调用日志并修改参数重放。

rule.en: Switch agent tabs on top (or press Left/Right arrows) to compare tool permissions, click any accessible tool to inspect its call history, and edit input JSON before pressing Replay (⌘↵).
rule.zh: 通过顶部标签或左右方向键切换代理以对比工具授权边界，点击已授权工具展开调用记录，支持原地编辑输入参数后按 Replay（或 ⌘↵）单独重放。

when: Auditing at a glance which tools each agent in a multi-agent run is allowed to call, which ones failed, and which one is running right now.
Debugging a tool invocation by inspecting its JSON input/output and replaying it with original or tweaked arguments.
not: Visualizing parent-child delegation hierarchies across sub-agents—use AgentTree instead.
Rendering one inline tool call bubble inside a chat stream—use ToolCallCard instead.
en.apiLead: ToolAccessMap coordinates multi-agent tabs, fixed-footprint tool status cards, solid/pulsing/dashed hub connectors, and an inline Editor call-replay inspector while emitting typed events.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a ToolAccessMap preloaded with 4 agents (Researcher, Coder, Writer, Analyst) across 9 workspace tools.

props.name: with_tools
props.description: Define the global ordered catalog of tools laid out along the left and right rails.

props.name: with_agents
props.description: Provide per-agent model metadata, run status, task summary, and granted tool call histories.

props.name: with_default_agent
props.description: Select which agent tab starts active on initial mount.

props.name: replay_selected_call
props.description: Programmatically replay the active call with optional modified payload.

motion: Active tool calls drive a continuous blue glint pulse from the central hub card to the running tool, while ungranted tools stay dimmed on dashed gray lines.
Agent tabs share a spring pro_pill_indicator, hub content transitions via pro_view_transition, and the call replay drawer settles via pro_presence; Theme::reduced_motion disables animations.
ai: Import from kui::components::tool_access_map::ToolAccessMap (library) or crate::ui::components::tool_access_map::ToolAccessMap after running kui add tool-access-map.
Pass every run tool in with_tools and list only granted tools inside each MapAgent::tools so ungranted tools automatically render as No access.

when: 一眼审视多代理运行中各个智能体允许触达的工具范围、正在执行的调用以及失败报错的工具。
调试单次工具调用：阅读输入输出载荷，并在原地修改参数后单独重放验证。
not: 展示父子智能体之间的任务拆解与委派层级（请使用 AgentTree）。
在对话消息流中内嵌展示单次工具调用气泡（请使用 ToolCallCard）。
zh.apiLead: ToolAccessMap 集成多智能体切换标签、固定尺寸工具状态卡、实线/脉冲/虚线辐射连接器以及内置参数编辑器的调用重放抽屉，并发出强类型事件。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 4 个智能体（调研、编码、撰写、分析）与 9 项外部工具的访问图谱。

props.name: with_tools
props.description: 定义排布在左右两侧轨道的全局工具清单。

props.name: with_agents
props.description: 传入各代理的模型标识、运行状态、当前任务以及已授权工具的调用记录。

props.name: with_default_agent
props.description: 指定初始激活展示的智能体标签 ID。

props.name: replay_selected_call
props.description: 通过代码重放当前选中的工具调用（支持传入修改后的载荷）。

motion: 正在运行的工具连线会持续流淌蓝色高光脉冲，无访问权限的工具以半透明卡片配灰色虚线呈现。
代理标签采用 pro_pill_indicator 弹簧滑块，中央卡片切换采用 pro_view_transition，调用抽屉采用 pro_presence 进出场；遵循减少动效设置。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::tool_access_map::ToolAccessMap 导入；执行 kui add tool-access-map 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::tool_access_map::ToolAccessMap 导入。
在 with_tools 中列出本次运行的全部工具，在每个 MapAgent::tools 中仅传入该代理被授权的工具，未授权项将自动呈现为“无访问权限”。

title.zh: 智能体调用链路瀑布图

lead.en: See where the time and money of an agent run go—every LLM call, tool call, and nested sub-agent aligned on a live timeline with a SLOWEST bottleneck badge, branches that fold into their parent bar, and inline span inspectors.
lead.zh: 在实时时间轴上还原单次智能体执行全貌：按真实起止时刻对齐模型调用、工具执行与嵌套子智能体跨度条，内置最慢瓶颈标记、折叠至父条的子调用缩略块与内联跨度详情。

rule.en: Click any span row to unfold its Prompt / Response and error inspector, fold parent sub-agents to condense child spans into colored marks inside the parent bar, and use Arrow keys for tree navigation.
rule.zh: 点击任意跨度行展开耗时、Token、输入输出与错误详情，折叠子智能体分支可将子调用浓缩为父进度条内的彩色刻度块，支持方向键遍历调用树。

when: Debugging an agent run to see how long each step took, which branches ran concurrently, which retry failed, and which call is the latency bottleneck.
Live trace panels beside a chat or run log where spans start, stream, and finish along a shared time axis.
not: Pure cumulative budget step-downs without start/end concurrency—use CostWaterfall instead.
High-level BPMN ownership handoffs across human approval gates—use HandoffSwimlanes instead.
en.apiLead: TraceWaterfall computes hierarchical span rollup metrics, scales round time-axis intervals, flags the slowest finished LLM or tool call, embeds folded child marks inside parent bars, and unfolds span inspectors via pro_fold.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a TraceWaterfall preloaded with the concurrent "Launch the new pricing page" trace.

props.name: with_root
props.description: Provide the hierarchical root span tree with millisecond start/end offsets.

props.name: with_now_ms
props.description: Drive the live "now" cursor explicitly in milliseconds from run start for replays.

props.name: with_mark_slowest
props.description: Mark the slowest completed LLM or tool call with an amber SLOWEST badge.

props.name: with_min_range_ms
props.description: Minimum time-axis range in milliseconds before round auto-scaling expands.

motion: Active spans grow smoothly along the moving "now" line with a sweeping highlight sheen and glowing leading edge while live summary totals shimmer.
Folding a sub-agent branch condenses its children into colored mini-marks inside the parent bar, and clicking a span unfolds its inspector smoothly via pro_fold; respects Theme::reduced_motion.
ai: Import from kui::components::trace_waterfall::TraceWaterfall (library) or crate::ui::components::trace_waterfall::TraceWaterfall after running kui add trace-waterfall.
Keep failed retry attempts as separate sibling spans with distinct ids so transient timeouts remain visible alongside successful retries.

when: 排查智能体运行耗时与并发度：直观查看哪些子智能体并行执行、哪次重试超时失败，以及哪条调用是整体延迟瓶颈。
在对话流或运行日志旁实时观测跨度启动、延伸与收尾的执行追踪面板。
not: 不关心并发起止时刻、仅需查看累积预算阶梯消耗（请使用 CostWaterfall）。
展示跨团队成员与人工审批门的职责交接图（请使用 HandoffSwimlanes）。
zh.apiLead: TraceWaterfall 自动汇总父子跨度指标、自适应圆整时间刻度、标记最慢调用、在折叠父分支内嵌子调用色块，并通过 pro_fold 展开详情卡。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置并行“上线新版定价页并核验 Stripe 结账链路”的调用链路瀑布图。

props.name: with_root
props.default: 主控编排器 + 2 子智能体
props.description: 传入以运行起点为 0ms 基准的树形 TraceSpan 结构。

props.name: with_now_ms
props.description: 显式驱动相对于运行起点的毫秒级当前时间游标，适用于录像回放。

props.name: with_mark_slowest
props.description: 自动为耗时最长的已完成模型或工具调用添加琥珀色“最慢”徽标。

props.name: with_min_range_ms
props.description: 时间轴自动阶梯扩容前的最小显示窗口（毫秒）。

motion: 运行中的跨度跟随蓝色当前时间线动态生长并附带扫光与末端呼吸高亮，顶部实时统计数字呈现柔和微光。
折叠父分支会将子调用映射为父进度条内的彩色微缩标记，点击跨度通过 pro_fold 顺滑展开详情面板；支持 Theme::reduced_motion。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::trace_waterfall::TraceWaterfall 导入；执行 kui add trace-waterfall 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::trace_waterfall::TraceWaterfall 导入。
建议将失败的首次调用与重试成功的调用保留为独立兄弟 Span，完整还原线上排障故事线。

lead.en: Visualize a live voice call with an agent—dual scrolling audio waveforms with the turn-taking silence gap measured in ms, words firming up as spoken, and a stacked STT + LLM + TTS latency breakdown against a budget line.
lead.zh: 实时呈现人机双向语音通话：上下双轨声波精确标出轮次静音等待毫秒数，随播报逐词高亮字幕，并在预算标尺下拆解 STT + LLM + TTS 全链路延迟。

rule.en: Plot both voices on separate horizontal tracks so turn-taking silence pauses and over-budget latency spikes stand out immediately.
rule.zh: 将用户与智能体声波分轨平行绘制，让轮次切换间的静音停顿与超预算延迟峰值一目了然。

when: Live customer-support lines, phone agents, and realtime voice assistants where turn-taking cadence and latency matter.
Diagnosing voice-to-voice response times across Endpointing, STT, LLM, TTS, and Network against a target SLA budget.
not: Text-only streaming responses—use ResponseStream or RunControls instead.
Fleet-wide call center volume dashboards—use MetricsDashboardBlock instead.
en.apiLead: VoiceSession paints dual PathBuilder waveform tracks with automatic silence-gap brackets, reveals spoken words progressively, computes P50 turn latency, and emits VoiceSessionEvent on Pause, Barge in, and settings changes.

props.name: new
props.description: Create a VoiceSession preloaded with Atlas (Billing support) and Maya on Turn 5 (625 ms vs 800 ms budget).

props.name: with_turns
props.description: Provide spoken turns with optional VoiceLatencyBreakdown metrics feeding the P50 stat.

props.name: with_budget_ms
props.description: Target voice-to-voice latency budget in ms; exceeding it turns the pause pill and badge red.

props.name: with_show_transcript
props.description: Show or fold closed the live word-by-word transcript exchange above the waveforms.

props.name: with_paused
props.description: Start with waveform scrolling and call timer paused.

motion: Waveform bars scroll smoothly left every 90ms with a blue thinking shimmer along the agent track while spoken words firm up from faint to ink.
Latency slices and the budget marker glide via pro_spring_f32 and big ms readouts roll via pro_rolling_number; Theme::reduced_motion disables continuous sweeps.
ai: Import from kui::components::voice_session::VoiceSession (library) or crate::ui::components::voice_session::VoiceSession after running kui add voice-session.
Attach VoiceLatencyBreakdown::new(endpoint, stt, llm, tts, network) to each agent turn so P50 and slice proportions update automatically.

when: 实时语音客服、电话智能体与应用内语音助手：需要直观呈现谁在说话、停顿多久以及逐词播报进度。
对比目标延迟预算线（如 600ms / 800ms）实时诊断端点检测、STT、LLM、TTS 与网络耗时占比及通话 P50。
not: 纯文本流式对话输出——请使用 ResponseStream 或 RunControls。
呼叫中心多并发汇总报表——请使用 MetricsDashboardBlock。
zh.apiLead: VoiceSession 通过 PathBuilder 绘制双轨声波与静音间隔标尺，渐进点亮已播报词元，自动统计 P50 延迟，并通过 VoiceSessionEvent 回调暂停、插话打断与设置变更。

props.name: new
props.description: 创建预置 Atlas（账单支持）与 Maya 第 5 轮通话（625ms / 800ms 预算）的实时语音会话卡。

props.name: with_turns
props.description: 注入带可选 VoiceLatencyBreakdown 延迟拆解的历史与当前语音轮次。

props.name: with_budget_ms
props.description: 设置端到端延迟预算毫秒数；超出预算时静音胶囊与状态徽标自动变红预警。

props.name: with_show_transcript
props.description: 显示或通过 pro_fold 收起声波上方的逐词实时字幕。

props.name: with_paused
props.description: 设置初始是否暂停声波滚动与通话计时。

motion: 双轨声波每 90ms 平滑左移，思考阶段智能体轨道掠过蓝色流光，已播报词元从浅灰渐变为清晰正文色。
分段延迟条与预算标尺经 pro_spring_f32 弹性过渡，总毫秒数由 pro_rolling_number 平滑滚动；减少动效时自动静止。
ai: 库模式从 kui::components::voice_session::VoiceSession 导入；执行 kui add voice-session 复制源码后从 crate::ui::components::voice_session::VoiceSession 导入。
为每轮智能体回复附加 VoiceLatencyBreakdown::new(endpoint, stt, llm, tts, network) 即可自动更新分段占比与 P50 指标。
